articleTitle: Flight Control and Simulation for Quadrotors during Grasping Rigid Target
abstract: Quadrotors has been used as a research platform and equipment in many fields, such as grasping forbidden aerial vehicles and transporting emergent medicine. How to assess the grasping performance and how to assure flight safety becomes an emergent issue. In this paper the model of the quadrotors with grasping mission was derived, based on the simplified model, attitude stabilization controller and position tracking controller were proposed, then under the MATLAB environment, the flight simulation was performed and the simulation results validate the effectiveness of the presented controllers.

articleTitle: Calculation of Stabilizing PDμ Controllers for a Class of Fractional Order Systems with Time Delay
abstract: In this paper, a simple and effective stabilization method for a class of systems with time delay controlled by PD<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> controllers is presented. Based on D-decomposition method, the explicit formulae corresponding to Real Root Boundary(RRB) and Complex Root Boundary(CRB) are derived in terms of the PD<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> controller parameters. The stability region of the control system is determined by the implicit function theorem. The set of stability regions in (kd, kp)-plane when 11 equals to different values in (0, 2) can be obtained. To verify the accuracy of the proposed method, two examples are given. The simulations verify that the fractional order PD<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> controllers can provide larger stability regions, which is beneficial for designing the controller.

Author Keywords: fractional order systems with time delay

articleTitle: Electric Atuator Modeling Based on Modified Cuckoo Search(CS) Algorithm
abstract: The paper proposed a modified cuckoo search algorithm by studying the nonlinear modeling problem of electric actuator, and a neural network identification model of actuator is established. The algorithm makes the Levy flight mechanism adaptive by dynamically adjusting the step size. The proposed method is proved to be effective and feasible by simulation experiments and comparison with traditional algorithms. The simulation shows that the modified cuckoo search algorithm which is applied to the actuator modeling, can effectively improve the modeling accuracy and generalization ability.

articleTitle: An Improved Thrust Allocation Method Based on Genetic Algorithm and Pseudo Inverse
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of real-time thrust allocation for Dynamic Positioning (DP) marine vessels. An novel thrust allocation strategy based on pseudo inverse and genetic algorithm is proposed, which can eliminate thruster chattering and reduce the optimization time. First, a more realistic thrust allocation model is established by taking fuel consumption, singularity avoidance and actuator wear reducing into consideration. Then, through using pseudo inverse of the thruster configuration matrix, the two-variable optimization problem is simplified into two single-variable optimization problems. And genetic algorithm (GA) is utilized to find the optimal direction, while Quadratic Programming (QP) is used to find the suboptimal propeller force. Simulation examples demonstrate that the proposed thrust allocation strategy has better search performance and cost less time than traditional GA optimization.

articleTitle: YCbCr Color Space Based Image Segmentation Algorithm with Feedback in the Underground Cable Tunnel
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the image segmentation is affected by the intensity of illumination in the underground cable tunnel. An image segmentation algorithm with feedback based on YCbCr color space is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the color distribution characteristics of some equipment cables in the YCbCr color space is analyzed, and a threshold selection constraint for image segmentation is proposed. Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF (ORB) are used to feedback the matching results of the segmented images to achieve a fast feedback mechanism. Finally, the segmentation threshold is adjusted according to the feedback results, to improve the robustness of the image segmentation algorithm in the underground cable tunnel environment.

articleTitle: An Abnormal Working State Analysis of Y-Source Inverter
abstract: Through an in-depth analysis of the working principle and working process of the Y-source inverter, an abnormal working state of the Y-source inverter is found, which causes a large drop to the dc-link voltage of the inverter bridge when it operates in the active vector state. The article elaborates the circuit conditions of the abnormal state, and analyzes the relationship between the falling voltage amplitude and the shoot-through duty ratio. The relationship between other parameters in the circuit and the minimum free-wheeling inductance is discussed. The advantages and disadvantages of the two feasible methods are analyzed, and it is found that only changing the primary side inductance to be greater than the minimum freewheeling theoretical value that can fundamentally solve the discontinuity problem. Finally, the feasibility of the technical measures to avoid the abnormal state is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Off-line Parameters Tuning of Controller for Tension Control System
abstract: Aiming at the double motors tension control problem in industrial production, the principle of tension control system is analyzed. The hardware and software of tension control system using S7-300 PLC are designed. Aiming at problem that field tuning parameters of controller are dangerous and inconvenient, a method of off-line PID parameters tuning is proposed. The controlled object of tension control system is modeled. And this model is input into function block FB100. PID controller function block FB41 and function block FB100 are connected to each other. The simulation model of tension control system is constructed. By STEP7 software, the visual response curve of the tension control system is obtained. By parameters tuning of controller and observing the visual response curve, the control performance of the tension control system can be adjusted. Finally, PID parameters that meet the control requirements of tension control system are confirmed. The simulation debugging of tension control system is completed. The research results of this paper have high practical value for the design and application of tension control system.

articleTitle: A High-precision Backstepping Control Method of Flight Vehicles
abstract: In attitude control system of flight vehicles, there are problems of over-coupling and uncertainty in control models. This paper develops a high-precision backstepping control method of flight vehicles. Firstly, the attitude control model is reduced into a nominal model. The nominal model is then decoupled with backstepping design method. Secondly, we design the control law for the nominal model. Besides, the extended high-gain observer is designed for the attitude control model. The observer can estimate the uncertainty of the attitude control system, and compensate the uncertainty back to the original system. Due to that the performance of state feedback can be recovered by output feedback when the gain is high, the observed value is used instead of state value to output the feedback, thus completing the design of control law. Simulations are demonstrated to verity the conclusion.

articleTitle: An Improved Outlier Detection Algorithm Based on Distance Increment and Decision Graph Score
abstract: In recent years, outlier detection technology has played an important role in all aspects of real life. Faced with increasingly complex production datasets, how to find rare outliers quickly and efficiently is a huge challenge. In this article, we introduce an improved LOF algorithm which is based on increment of distance and decision graph score. Firstly, we use distance increment to calculate the local density of samples. Then we use decision graph score to quantify the anomaly degree of samples, which is the ratio of distance to local density. The higher the score, the more likely it is to be an outlier. Experiments show that this method has a good performance on both synthetic datasets and real datasets, and can effectively deal with complex datasets.

articleTitle: Synchronization in Networks of Linear Systems With Three Time Scales
abstract: In this paper, we study the synchronization for networks with three-time-scale linear systems. This article uses a fixed undirected graph to describe the topology of the network. Under mild assumptions, we perform a two-stage reduction on the singularly perturbed systems and get approximate systems. The analysis of the reduced systems shows the form of the state feedback controller that implements the asymptotic synchronization of the approximation system. The synchronization of the network is changed into achieve simultaneous stabilization of state using variable transformation. According to the reduced approximate system's relevance to the original singularly perturbed system, we design the state feedback controller which can achieve the asymptotic synchronization of the original networks. Our results are illustrated by a numerical examples.

articleTitle: PD Control at Hopf Bifurcations in a Neuron System with both Leakage and Distributed Delays
abstract: In this paper, a neural networks model with discrete and distributed delays is considered. For the sake of simplicity, a virtual neuron can be introduced to eliminate the influence of distributed delay, and a new equivalent system containing only one delay is obtained to study the bifurcation control problem of the initial neural network model with mixed delay. A PD controller is designed, and the leakage delay is used as the analysis variable. By analyzing the corresponding characteristic equations, the conditions for the existence of Hopf bifurcation are derived. In addition, the critical value is changed by regulating the control variable of PD feedback controller to achieve the desired dynamic behavior. The theoretical analysis is verified by numerical examples, and it is proved that the method can control the nonlinear dynamic behavior of the system.

articleTitle: A High Performance CMOS Voltage-Controlled Oscillator for Micro-resonant Infrared Detector Closed-loop/Self-excited ASIC
abstract: A closed-loop self-excitation/detection application specific integrated-circuit (ASIC) based on the phase-locked loop (PLL) used for micro-resonant infrared detector is designed to improve the measurement accuracy, miniaturization and integration. A switched capacitor array is proposed and used in the VCO to meet the requirements of the system. The VCO was implemented by 0.18 μm CMOS technology, the chip area is 1.1*0.9 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The proposed VCO can be operated at 2.603.38 GHz, the measured phase noise are -125.9 dBc/Hz@1MHz at 2.60 GHz and -123.3 dBc/Hz@1MHz at 3.38GHz respectively. The VCO draws 3.06 mW power consumption from a 1.8 V supply.

articleTitle: Research on Extending Person Re-identification Datasets Based on Generative Adversarial Network
abstract: Person re-identification(Person Re-ID) means that images of a pedestrian from cameras in a surveillance camera network can be automatically retrieved based on one of this pedestrian's image from another camera. The appearance change of pedestrians under different cameras poses a huge challenge to person re-identification. Person re-identification systems based on deep learning can effectively extract the appearance features of pedestrians. In this paper, the feature enhancement experiment is conducted, and the result showed that the current person reidentification datasets are relatively small and cannot fully meet the need of deep training. Therefore, this paper studied the method of using generative adversarial network to extend the person re-identification datasets and proposed a label smoothing regularization for outliers with weight (LSROW) algorithm to make full use of the generated data, effectively improved the accuracy of person re-identification.

articleTitle: Adaptive Fault-tolerant Control of Hypersonic without a Prior Knowledge of Control Direction
abstract: An adaptive fault-tolerant control (FTC) strategy that can solve the problem of stabilizing HSV attitude systems with the unknown control direction, as well as the actuator fault is designed. The key point is that an adaptive controller is able to keep the negative feedback control for closed loop system. Thus, such problem is coped with the mechanism of the Nussbaum-type function. For the unknown information, including system uncertainties and actuator fault, they are obtained by the adaptive radial basis neural network (RBFNN). Drawing support from the Lyapunov theorem of stability, the boundedness of the whole signals of closed-loop system is obtained. Finally, the simulation results prove the effectiveness of FTC developed in this paper.

articleTitle: Multi-robot Formation Control Based on Parameter optimization Algorithm
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-robot formation control algorithm. The controller is designed by the difference between the distance and the angle of the two robots. It is proved that the algorithm can guarantee the stability of the formation. Furthermore, the obtained formation control algorithm is tested on the software platform and Pioneer3-DX platform. According to the multi-robot formation control algorithm, a control method of adaptive parameters is proposed. The existing parameters are replaced by fitting equations, which improves the efficiency of parameter adjustment. Simulation and experimental results verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Distributed Model Predictive Control with Linear Gain and Mixed Performances for Positive Systems
abstract: This paper proposes a distributed model predictive control design approach to positive systems with disturbances. Using decomposition technique, a positive system are transformed into a distributed system consisting of positive subsystems. Polytopic uncertainty and norm-bounded disturbance are imposed on the considered systems. Different from tradition quadratic performance indexes, the performance index of distributed model predictive control of positive systems is defined via a linear form called linear gain performance. Using linear copositive Lyapunov functions, a control framework for the distributed model predictive controller of constrained positive systems is established. Thus, the required linear gain performance is satisfied under the proposed controller. Furthermore, a mixed performance index is introduced for positive systems. A distributed model predictive controller is designed to obtain the mixed performance index. The corresponding distributed model predictive control algorithms are given by virtue of some linear programming conditions. Finally, an simulation example is given to verify the presented design.

articleTitle: Green Power Certificates in China: A Study on Pricing and Transaction Decisions
abstract: The Chinese government has made many adjustments regarding the original green power certificate policies. Under the new policy, renewable energy power generation enterprises will face new green certificate pricing dilemmas and the quota subject will also face new transaction decision-making problems. Based on the existing market problems, this paper analyzes the positive impact of the new policy on the green certificate market and the main factors affecting green certificate pricing and trade decision-making under the new policy. It also establishes a dynamic marginal price model for quota subjects participating in green certificate trading. Finally, it puts forward relevant decision-making suggestions for promoting the vigorous development of the green certificate market in China.

articleTitle: Improved Generalized-Inverse-based Thrust Allocation for Dynamic Positioning Vessels with Rotatable Thrusters and Force Constraint
abstract: Thrust allocation is a challenging problem for dynamic positioning vessels, especially when considering rotatable thrusters and various constraints. This paper improves the generalized-inverse-based thrust allocation. A group of configurations are selected for rotatable thrusters by examining the singularity value of the thrust configuration matrix. A a cost function is designed. And the configuration with lowest cost will be chosen as desired. Then generalized -inverse-based thrust allocation is performed on the desired configuration, and results the thrust and azimuth angles for the thrusters. Comparing with the sequential-quadratic-programming-based thrust allocation method, the proposed method is significantly faster and easy to implement. Their accuracy of the allocation is similar. The proposed method is suboptimal in the power consumption.

articleTitle: A Subject-Transfer Study on Detecting c-VEP
abstract: Among all kinds of brain-computer interfaces(BCI), the BCI based on code visual evoked potential(c-VEP) distinguishes itself in stability and reliability. Generally, it is necessary to acquire training data for each subject before using c-VEP BCI. In order to facilitate the preparatory procedure, we have conducted a systematic research on subject-transfer problem about the detection of c-VEP. In this work, we proposed a similarity metric by which we can select the most suitable subjects for a new subject from our database, and developed a method to transfer a classifier from the selected subjects to detect the c-VEP of the new subject. We have verified our scheme using the data of 8 subjects. The results show that the classifiers that are transferred from other subjects work as well as those obtained by training on their own data.

articleTitle: Straight-line Path-following Control of an Underactuated Mobile Robot with Finite-time Convergence
abstract: In this paper, a finite-time bounded controller is proposed for the straight-line path-following system to steer an underactuated mobile robot (UMR) to move along the predetermined straight-line paths in the presence of systematical uncertainties and external disturbance. The construction of this controller consists of two steps. First of all, a local control law is constructed for the path-following system. The other step is to combine the local finite-time controller with the saturation function to construct a bounded finite-time controller, which ensure the path-following errors converge to origin. Simulation results are given to verify the validity and robustness of the proposed control algorithm.

articleTitle: PIDPlus Application under Wireless Measurement Environment
abstract: The use of wireless devices can greatly reduce project period and cables, and improve the flexibility of system design or redesign. However, wireless technology accompanied with uncertain delays is not reliable as wired transmission. Evident overshoot and oscillation or even instability appear in PID control with wireless measurements. According to the feature of PID control with wireless measurements, an enhanced PID controller, PIDPlus, is applied to get better control performance. In PIDPlus, the integral component stops working when there are no new measurements as expected and the derivative component is revised to reduce possible spikes when new values are transmitted suddenly. The result of simulation and experiment prove the effectiveness of the enhanced PID controller.

articleTitle: Study for Design and Detection Method of a Lightweight 3D Printing Unloading Flange of honeycomb structure
abstract: In order to solve the mechanical properties of lightweight unloading flange model, this paper presents a design method of lightweight honeycomb 3D printing structure unloading flange. The results of quantitative inspection and evaluation are given by scanning and testing the 3D printing unloading flange sample.

articleTitle: Observer-based event-triggered guaranteed cost control for networked control systems subject to random packet loss
abstract: This paper focuses on the observer-based event-triggered guaranteed cost control for networked control systems (NCSs) subject to packet loss. The event-triggered scheme, which aims at eliminating dispensable transmission and reducing the transmission burden of NCSs, is introduced to determine whether to transmit the current measured output or not. The released data between sensor and controller link and control signal between controller and actuator links may subject to the phenomenon of packet losses which are described as two mutually independent Bernoulli distribution. By constructing a new augmented system, a state observer is given to obtain the estimate values of system states. A sufficient condition is obtained to achieve the purpose of making closed-loop system asymptotically stable. On basis of this stability condition, the design problem of controller is addressed so that value of cost function does not exceed a specified upper bound. Moreover, the cone complementarity linearization algorithm is exploited to convert controller design problem into a convex optimization problem. Finally, a numerical simulation is presented to verify the effectuality of the provided method.

articleTitle: Multi-source Test Data Fusion and Evaluation Based on Improved p-Bayesian Method
abstract: An improved multi-source data fusion evaluation method based on p-Bayes method was proposed in the paper. In view of the deficiency of constructing the inheritance factor subjectively, this paper proposed to calculate the inheritance factor based on the mean square error(MSE).Combined with experience and inheritance factors, test data fusion from different sources such as multi-stage, different regions, modified products and similar products was realized, which effectively improved the evaluation accuracy of success or failure type indicators under small sample flying test, and to reduce the test risk.

articleTitle: Design of automatic parts monitoring system based on capacitance method
abstract: In the production practice, in order to complete the task of parts inspection with higher precision, higher efficiency, faster and more economical, a fully automatic part detection system based on capacitance method is designed. The mechanical structure of the system includes a degree of freedom motion unit and a part classification unit; the hardware part is composed of a main control module, an identification module, a motion control module, and a human-machine interaction module, and the main control module uses STM32VGT6 as a main controller; the software part is used. The PID algorithm and the Kalman filter algorithm enable the parts to accurately reach the measurement position and accurately measure the parts. The test results show that the automatic parts inspection system can accurately test the test parts by pre-recording the standard part specifications and the number of test parts, and separating the qualified parts through the part classification unit. The system is easy to implement and has the advantages of high test accuracy and fast test speed.

articleTitle: A novel roll stabilization controller with aerodynamic coefficient disturbance consideration
abstract: A roll stabilization controller considering aerodynamic coefficient disturbance for spinning flight vehicle is proposed in this paper by combining super-twisting-like (STA-like) algorithm and adaptive theory. Using the STA-like algorithm, the presented roll stabilization control scheme can drive both roll angle and rotation rate smoothly converge to the desired value. To select proper design parameters, the dual-layer adaptive scheme is employed. Theoretical analysis and numerical simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Standardization for Mechanical Analysis of Nuclear Power Equipment
abstract: In the design of nuclear power equipment, the traditional mechanical analysis is finite element modeling, loading, calculating and post processing by writing a personalized APDL command stream or operating ANSYS GUI according to the design standards and personal analysis experience. And the operation of ANSYS graphical interface is cumbersome and complex, resulting in low efficiency of modeling, large amount of work. By the command stream, the workload of modifying calculation file is large and the command code is plain, which is not conductive to the standardization of the analysis process, and easy to make human error, miss parameter modification and error modification commands, causing the analysis result to appear serious mistake. In view of the deficiency in the process of mechanical analysis, this paper takes the axisymmetric penetration of nuclear power equipment as the research object, based on the software engineering technology, using the technology of ANSYS secondary development, puts forward a standardized method to reduce human error, improve the accuracy and usability of mechanical analysis, and develops the mechanical analysis platform for axisymmetric penetration. The platform helps designers through a simple interface to quickly and efficiently complete the calculation and analysis of axisymmetric penetration, which unified the calculating process, reach the precipitation and sharing of the experience, improve the accuracy, reduce the workload of manual operation, enhance the work efficiency and provide practical experience for the popularization and application of standardization in verification and analysis of other nuclear power equipment.

articleTitle: Software and Hardware Design, Implementation and Algorithm Analysis of Marine RFID Automatic Information Monitoring System
abstract: This study applied radio frequency identification (RFID) and database technologies to monitor and manage multifarious information of cabin comprehensively, which includes the documents, temperature, humidity, personnel and so on of vessel, effectively improving the efficiency and effectiveness of ship monitoring system. In this paper, a unique marine automatic information monitoring hardware with RFID is designed and implemented, as well as a self-designed software with Visual Studio Professional 2017. An improved intensive label-reading algorithm for enclosed spaces (e.g. cabins) is proposed and applied in this software, greatly improving the speed and accuracy of label reading. Furthermore, the simulation test of label frequency and reading accuracy is carried out to get the most suitable frequency for cabin - intensive documents reading. Both the results and data analysis show that the proposed method and simulation test are effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Thermoacoustic Generation System for the Maximum Acoustic Power Capturing Based on Controllable Electric Load
abstract: An acoustic impedance matching method based on controllable electric load was proposed. This method can make TAEGS (Thermoacoustic Generation System) acoustic impedance matching so that generator captures the maximum acoustic power by the optimum design spring mechanical impedance and load capacitance. Firstly, according to similarity theorem and TAEGS acoustic impedance current source mechanism with the maximum acoustic power capturing electric load, the acoustic power model was established by the phasor method like in the circuit, the relationship of the acoustic power function with parameters of system components is derived. Secondly, the double threshold optimization design from generator spring stiffness coefficient and load capacitance parameter for the maximum acoustic power capturing was given, which regarded generator safe operation as the constraint conditions. Finally, numerical calculation and experimental verified the feasibility and validity of this method.

articleTitle: Fake Spike Removal Based on the Reconstruction Error of the KPCA
abstract: The effective detection of neuron spikes plays an important role in the brain-computer interface (BCI). In order to improve the reliability of spikes, the method based on the reconstruction error of Kernel principal component analysis (KPCA) is used to remove the fake spikes mixed in the detected spikes. Simulation experiments with different noise levels and different fake spikes ratios are carried out to verify the performance of the reconstruction error of KPCA. The results show that the KPCA method outperforms the traditional template matching method in removing fake spikes.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Small Object Recognition Based on TX2 in the Field Scene
abstract: In the field environment target detection, there are problems such as low grab rate due to fast moving objects and poor quality of acquired image data. Considering these issues, this paper designs a field small target detection system that is mounted on the TX2 embedded development board. To solve the problem of poor image data quality, a super-resolution method DRCN (deep-recursive convolutional network) is introduced to enhance the data clarity. Besides, the structure of DRCN is set to be deeper. To handle the problem of low capture rate of fast moving targets and the problem of memory shortage in TX2, a new method based on increasing inter-frame difference threshold judgment is employed. The new method namely the three-frame difference method based on difference threshold judgment can filter the "blank" differential image. Differential mapping preservation only when fast moving targets occur.It can improve the capture rate of fast moving targets and save storage space at the same time. Experiments show that the designed system can adapt to TX2 and effectively improve the effect of field environment detection.

articleTitle: Fuzzy adaptive extended Kalman filter SLAM algorithm based on the improved PSO algorithm
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the mobile robot simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) is difficult to establish an accurate priori noise model, an improved particle swarm tuning fuzzy supervised adaptive extended Kalman filter localization method is proposed. In the algorithm, the fuzzy system adaptively adjusts the observed noise covariance R in the extended Kalman filter algorithm to minimize the discrepancy between the theoretical and actual covariance of the innovation. The improved particle swarm algorithm is used to train the parameters of a fuzzy system. The improved particle swarm optimization algorithm introduces the population iteration success rate as the feedback parameter to adjust the global and local search ability of particle swarm optimization, and uses the chaotic interference factor to improve the particle swarm algorithm to prone to premature defects. The simulation and experimental results show the performance of the proposed improving algorithm comparing with the fuzzy supervisors for the adaptive extended Kalman filter localization algorithm, where the free parameters of the fuzzy systems are tuned using basic particle swarm optimization algorithm.

articleTitle: Soft Measurement Method Based on Conditional Mutual Information and Autoregressive Neural Network
abstract: In the actual industrial process, some parameters have a great influence on the production results but it is difficult to measure directly. The only way to solve this kind of problem is to use soft measurement to predict the target value. The two factors that have the greatest influence on the accuracy of soft measurement are the auxiliary variable selection and modeling methods. In this paper, a soft measurement modeling method based on conditional mutual information and autoregressive neural network was proposed. First, a mechanism analysis of the production process was performed to determine a set of candidate auxiliary variables that affect the measurement. Then used the conditional mutual information to further filter the auxiliary variables from the candidate auxiliary variable set., and determined the minimum input variables set for the soft-measurement model while ensuring measurement accuracy. This paper taken the measurement process of NOx generation of a 600MW coal-fired power plant as an example, and established a soft-measurement model by using autoregressive neural network. The experimental results showed that the prediction accuracy of the model is significantly improved and had better generalization ability after the input variables are filtered by the conditional mutual information.

articleTitle: Modeling of Big Data Database Based on Agricultural Basic Geographic Information
abstract: Supported by existing network facilities and based on agricultural geospatial information resources, a large data database of agricultural geographic information was designed to build a unified agricultural geographic information platform with strong openness and expansibility. The platform includes soil testing formula fertilization management module, cultivated land resource management module, agricultural disaster control module, agricultural regional layout management module, agricultural situation and production management module, agricultural construction achievement display module, operation and maintenance management module, etc.

articleTitle: Compliance control of connecting rod leg without force sensors
abstract: With the development and application of foot robots, the control of machine leg is becoming more and more important. Generally, the machine leg has multiple joints and is equipped with a force sensor. However, the number of force sensors is limited and the pressure at each location cannot be measured. To solve this problem, a new connecting rod leg is provided and a sensorless compliant control method is proposed. As follows, the mechanical leg has two joints controlled by two brushless motors. The current loop is controlled by PI control. The position control is realized by active disturbance rejection control (ADRC). The three-phase current of the motor is obtained by ADC sampling of the control board. The current I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</sub> and I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub> of the brushless motor can be converted from the three-phase current. The I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub> is used to estimate the output torque of the motor, and this torque is used instead of the pressure sensor. By establishing a D-H parametric model, it is possible to coordinate the control of two joints. The experiment verified that it has good anti-interference ability and buffer capacity.

articleTitle: A PLR-based method to speed droop ratio estimation for primary frequency control
abstract: The performance of primary frequency control (PFC) in power generation units is paramount important for power grids to suppress frequency fluctuations and preserve load-generation balance. The speed droop ratio is the most concerned primary frequency control performance index. This paper proposes a new method to estimate this index by extracting qualitative trends of involved signals. The proposed method is composed of three steps. The first step is to find the data segments including one PFC process from historical data of generated active power of power generation units according to variations in power grid frequency. The second step is to obtain piece-wise linear representations (PLR) of the selected generated active power data segments. The third step is to formulate the stages with PLRs, estimate the amplitude changes response stage, and calculate speed droop ratios for selected data segments. Simulated and industrial examples are provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, and compare with two existing methods.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis and Constrained Control of Interconnected Positive Systems with Delays
abstract: This paper goes into the stability issue of discrete-time and continuous-time interconnected positive systems with delays, and three equivalent and asymptotically stable results about the systems considered are established respectively. It should be noted that the stability conditions given in this paper are not same as the paper [1], [2], which proposes the results of the delay-free equations. Then controller devise of continuous-time connected positive equations with delays is addressed in this paper. The positive constraint and bounded control are investigated respectively. The former implies that the final loop equations are both stable and positive. The latter further requests that the solution of the loop equation is bounded by a defined boundary, if the started solution is bounded by the same boundary. Finally, one numerical example is given to verify the correctness of the results.

articleTitle: State-Predictor-Based Adaptive Neural Dynamic Surface Control of Uncertain Strict-Feedback Systems with Unknown Control Direction
abstract: This paper presents a state-predictor-based adaptive neural dynamic surface control (ANDSC) scheme for uncertain strict-feedback systems with unknown control direction. In practice, there always exists a compromise between the system transient performance and stability. In order to attain satisfactory performance, state-predictors are designed to produce two time scales, which improve the transient performance and reduce the tracking error magnitude without generating high-frequency oscillations. And the Nussbaum-type gain technique is introduced to handel the problem posed by unknown control directions. Besides, radial basis function neural networks (RBFNN) are used to deal with system uncertainties. By Lyapunov stability theory analysis, the proposed control scheme is proved to be capable of ensuring that all closed-loop signals are uniformly ultimately bounded (UUB). A numerical simulation example is given for illustrating the correctness and effectiveness of the theoretical result.

articleTitle: Design of Fuzzy Neural Network PID Controller for Hypersonic Vehicle
abstract: Hypersonic vehicles have the characteristics of complex flight environment, dramatic changes of aerodynamic parameters, and high requirements for aircraft robustness. In order to achieve steady state quickly and maintain high accuracy in complex flight environment, fuzzy neural network is added to hypersonic vehicle control. The fast and slow closed loop of the control system adopts fuzzy neural network PID control and traditional PID control respectively. This control strategy not only takes advantage of traditional PID, but also draws on the strong self-learning and adaptive ability of neural network and the online reasoning ability of fuzzy logic. Besides, it overcomes the disadvantage that traditional PID cannot obtain higher accuracy and stronger robustness, and realizes the online adjustment of controller parameters. The attitude simulation results of hypersonic vehicle have achieved better control effect and higher control precision, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Air Conditioning Noise Analysis and Calculation in Nuclear Power Flant
abstract: With the rapid development of nuclear power industry, people are paying more and more attention to the acoustic environment of nuclear power plants. Apart from the main control room <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>, the air conditioning noise of other plants in the nuclear power plant is basically calculated by designers manually or through empirical evaluation. However, different designers consider the system design noise from different starting points and perspectives, and the actual effect can only be tested in the application process. But at this time to adjust and modify the system, will bring serious losses. The three-dimensional layout design of nuclear power is the product of the comprehensive development of forward design of nuclear power and the high-speed advancement of the design work of three generations of nuclear power, such as HuaLong no.1 and AP1000, which has been widely promoted and applied. Based on the PDMS software of HVAC 3d layout design, a software for noise analysis and calculation of air conditioning system is developed. Designers can conduct noise checking while designing, so as to automate, intellectualize and visualize noise calculation, reduce manpower input and improve design efficiency. This paper will demonstrate it.

articleTitle: Investigating the pattern recognition based sEMG control scheme for long-term use
abstract: Surface electromyography (sEMG) plays a very important role in the human-machine interaction field. The application of pattern recognition based sEMG control scheme has shown massive potential in natural and robust myoelectric control. The classical pattern recognition model for myoelectric control includes two independent processes: training process and testing process. The rules creating the classical classifiers remain unchanged. Most powered devices based on the sEMG signals use the classical pattern recognition model to identify the users' upper-limb movement commands. Towards myoelectric practical application in future, identifying human movements stably and accurately for a long period of time is more meaningful. In this study, two experiment protocols for sEMG measurement are adopted. We investigate the recognition effect of classical pattern recognition model for myoelectric control systems in the shortterm and long-term use respectively. Three classical classification algorithms are applied in our investigation. Experiment results show the classical pattern recognition model works well at the early stage. However, there appears the declining tendency of recognition accuracy over time in the both experiment protocols. The results presented in this study can contribute to investigating the practical use of pattern recognition based sEMG control scheme.

articleTitle: Filter Design and Observability Analysis for Autonomous Orbit Determination of DSS with Periodic Measurements
abstract: Autonomous orbit determination of the distributed satellite system (DSS), which is responsible to estimate the absolute position and velocity of satellites by the sensors onboard only, is a basic requirement in many space missions. This paper considers a situation in which only limited sensors are working properly in the whole system, extremely speaking, just one relative measurement device remains. The remaining sensor has to measure other satellites in sequence. Under a periodic sequence assumption, the autonomous navigation was modeled as a periodic system to analyze the observability in this extreme situation. The filter of periodic system is presented and two unobservable situations are given.

articleTitle: Transient visual evoked potential -based method of detecting idle brain state in the event-related potential-based brain-computer interface
abstract: Setting up an asynchronous event-related potential based brain-computer interface system is a challenge, since low signal-to-noise ratio of event-related potential makes it hard to discriminate the work and the idle states of a brain. We find the visual interface based on an odd-ball paradigm can simultaneously evoke event-related potential and transient visual evoked potential. The frequency of the transient visual evoked potential is modulated by the flashing rate of the visual stimulus that is used to induce event-related potential. This paper proposes an asynchronous brain-computer interface system that combines these two kinds of induced potentials to detect the two mental states in the time-frequency domain. The novel method achieves an accuracy of 96.50%. Compared with the traditional method, it improves the accuracy of 46.50%.

articleTitle: Brain-Inspired Spatial Representation Based on Grid Cells with Finite-Spacing Firing Field
abstract: Grid cell is a kind of important neuron cell related to spatial cognition and navigation in animal brain. It has a hexagonal firing field extending to the whole space. Grid cells exist in the form of modules, whose number is finite, and the grid cells between adjacent modules have discrete firing- field spacing with constant ratio. The existing models can simulate the constant ratio discrete of firing-field spacing between modules, but the finite characteristic of firing-field spacing cannot be simulated. We propose a recurrent attractor network model of grid cell, which can generate grid cells with finite firing-field spacing by analyzing the connections between grid cells in a single network. Then, the grid cells in different modules could possess discrete firing-field spacing with constant ratio through the competition among the recurrent networks. The recurrent attractor network model can provide reference for the construction of brain-inspired navigation system of unmanned platform.

articleTitle: Dynamic Modeling of Quadrupedal Robot Based on the Screw Theory
abstract: In order to establish the kinematics and dynamics modeling of the quadruped robot, a dynamics modeling approach based on screw theory is demonstrated. Kinematics and the Jacobian matrix of single chain are obtained at first. Then, the dynamic modeling of single chain was established. All the 4 single chains are clustering together, and we get dynamics equation of the quadruped robot. The quadratic program solve an optimal control problem to track linear and angular acceleration of the body as closely as possible under the premise of satisfying a series of constraints of the full quadruped robot dynamics. Lastly, simulations and physical prototype experiment have been done to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis of ship rudder roll resistance based on rudder speed limit
abstract: In order to explore the relationship between the rudder damping potential and the rudder speed of the ship, the actual hull parameters of a ship are introduced into the ship motion model, and the ship rolling motion is simulated by Matlab. The main frequency range of the ship rolling motion caused by the ocean wave is determined by the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT), and the steering angle is obtained within the range to obtain the roll angle generated by the ship under different rudder speed limits, and the ship is affected by the waves. The roll angle comparison is used to analyze the rudder reduction potential of the ship in different sea conditions under the rudder speed limit. The simulation experiment shows that the rudder damping potential of the ship increases with the increase of the rudder speed; under the maximum rudder speed of 10°/s, the ship has good rudder anti-rolling potential under common sea conditions; continue to increase the rudder speed the tendency of the rudder anti-rolling potential to increase with the rudder speed becomes slower.

articleTitle: A new on-line wear debris detector in lubrication oil
abstract: Lubrication oil is widely used in machines, the debris particles which shed from the machine components in lubrication oil provide an important basis for understanding the machine structural health. Continuous monitoring of wear debris in lubrication oil is critical to avoid catastrophic system failure of machines. This article presented an on-line inductive debris detector. The detector is composed of five modules: sensor, excitation signal source, signal detection circuit, DSP (Digital Signal Processor) control circuit and display circuit. The sensor is driven by the excitation signal source. When there is a debris particle passing through the sensor, the particle‘s characteristic signal will be detected by the signal detection circuit and then output to the DSP control circuit to analyze. The parameters of the debris particle will be shown on the display circuit. A test platform is built to test the performance of this detector. Experiments have shown that this on-line debris detector run stably and has high measuring accuracy.

articleTitle: Temperature control system of hot extrusion equipment based on fuzzy control
abstract: A control unit that put forward a set of PLC as core has been proposed to solve the problems of slow response speed, large overshoot, and poor anti-interference ability and time lag in the temperature control system of automobile airbag hot extrusion equipment. Fuzzy adaptive PID control strategy is applied to realize the temperature control system of airbag hot extrusion equipment, which can accurately control the temperature of hot pressing furnace, monitor, diagnose and feedback regulation. Through the comparison of simulation and experiment, it is proved that the fuzzy adaptive PID controller proposed has the advantages of excellent dynamic performance, good robustness and high temperature control accuracy compared with the traditional PID controller, and the performance of the temperature control system of hot extrusion equipment has been improved.

articleTitle: The measurement matrix optimized by information operator improvement
abstract: The signal sample tool which is called measurement matrix or observation matrix is very important for the theory of compressive sensing. Decreasing the correlation between any two different columns of the information operator is the basis of the design and optimization of the measurement matrix. Based on it, the non-diagonal elements of the upper triangular matrix of the QR decomposition of information operator was set to zero to increase its minimum singular value and decrease the column correlation of information operator, and thus this method can enhance the performance of the measurement matrix. Experiments illustrate that when the algorithm of this paper is utilized, the recovery error of signals and images are both diminished.

articleTitle: Integral sliding mode control of low-speed wind turbine
abstract: In the wind turbine maximum power point tracking(MPPT) process, it is very important to design a controller which can not only achieve high efficiency of wind energy collection but also reduce the influence of mechanical load on wind turbine. Therefore, how to balance the efficiency of wind energy extraction and the load level of drive-train shaft has become a key problem. In this paper, An integral sliding mode power controller (ISMPC) is proposed to improve the efficiency of MPPT and reduce the transient load of the transmission system. Then, the effectiveness of the proposed controller is validated on FAST(Fatigue, Aerodynamics,Structures,and Turbulence) developed by the NREL(National Renewable Energy Laboratory).

articleTitle: Research and Simulation on the Spray Painting Trajectory of Manipulator for Rotational Artware
abstract: Based on the research of the mathematical model of the spray painting film thickness and the requirement of spray painting technology of rotational artware, the coordinate transformation of spray torch and the expression of the projection is derived. The way of turn-by-turn spray painting is adopted, and the rotation speed of artware and the trajectory of the spray gun are determined by the requirements of film thickness. By analyzing the impact of the spray painting starting point on the film thickness, the best trajectory of spray painting is achieved. The result of the simulation on the theoretical analysis indicates the feasibility and validity of the calculation method.

articleTitle: Optical plasma boundary reconstruction using visible image on EAST Tokamak
abstract: Visible cameras are routinely used for monitoring of plasma discharges on Tokamak. According to experimental observation, tangentially viewed images of plasma from high-speed cameras are regarded as potential data which could be used to reconstruct the plasma boundary. The visible imaging system has been installed and calibrated for optical boundary reconstruction on the Experimental Advanced Superconducting Tokamak (EAST) in 2018 experiment campaign. Exploiting the plasma's edge localized and toroidally symmetric emission profile, plasma boundaries were reconstructed from the detected image edge features. The results were compared with magnetic boundaries from the reconstruction code EFIT, showing good agreement in the area near mid-plane. The processing time from image to optical boundary is less than 1 millisecond with general desktop computer and this method is promising to be used for plasma control.

articleTitle: Research on Transient model of Transient Enclosure Overvoltage in UHV GIS
abstract: With the increase of voltage grade, the effects of electromagnetic transient process of power system should not be ignored. In order to provide the theoretical reference for UHV substation, continuous optimization models is very important. In this thesis, we do some calculations and analysis of the TEV which occurs in 1100kV substation of south district of Zhejiang province. Compare the actual characteristics of TEV with the theoretic characteristics of TEV. Conform to the theory of situation. The transient model can be trusted.

articleTitle: Network-based delayed H∞ controller for offshore platform with uncertainties
abstract: In this paper, the network-based delayed H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> control with uncertainties for jacket-type offshore platform subjected to irregular wave forces is investigated. First, a dynamical model of network-based offshore platform with time delay and parameters uncertainties is established. Then, the sufficient condition of existence of controller for the offshore platform system is derived based on Lyapunov functional, and control scheme is presented to reduce the effect of wave-induced vibration on offshore platform. As shown in simulation, networked-based delayed H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> control (NDHC) can reduce the amplitudes of vibration of jacket type offshore platform system.

articleTitle: A Post-accident Operating State Monitoring and Tracing System for Primary Circuit in Nuclear Power Plants
abstract: To fulfill the requirements of tracing and controlling the unit state for post-accident conditions in Nuclear Power Plants (NPPs), a post-accident primary circuit operating state monitoring and tracing system is designed based on the characteristics of the unit operation under Incident and Accident Conditions (IAC). The system, which will be integrated into the plants' Digital Control System (DCS), can automatically trace and display primary circuit state (pressure and temperature) to assist the operators to trace the state evolution process and trend of the primary circuit clearly and intuitively. In addition, the system zones the unit state under IAC into several operating ranges according to various limit conditions for post-accident operation, which can provide support for the operators while implementing Emergency Operating Procedure (EOP) as each operating range is assigned to a specific operation strategy. The system will be beneficial to improve the efficiency of EOP implementation, to effectively reduce the operator human errors under IAC, as well as to optimize the human-machine interface (HMI) design of EOP.

articleTitle: CMS R-CNN: An Efficient Cascade Multi-Scale Region-based Convolutional Neural Network for Accurate 2D Small Vehicle Detection
abstract: In recent years, 2D vehicle detection has experienced impressive progress. Despite of the outstanding performance achieved by the state-of-the-art methods, it is still very challenging to detect vehicles in real scene due to the existence of small targets in images. In this work, we propose a Cascade Multi-Scale Region-based Convolutional Neural Network method (CMS R-CNN) for accurate small vehicles detection. Our method combines two key insights: (1) we propose a efficient multi-scale feature fusion network, which combines spatial information of feature maps with all scales, to enhance the ability to detect small vehicles; (2) we introduce a novel cascade framework which consists of a sequence of detectors trained with the increasing IoU thresholds strategy to further achieve better detection performance. Experiments show that our method achieves a high accuracy on the benchmark of KITTI dataset (77.0% in difficult data of KITTI) and outperforms previous work by a remarkable margin (6.2% higher than Faster R-CNN in difficult data of KITTI).

articleTitle: MPPT Algorithm Based on Improved PSO and Fuzzy Algorithm
abstract: Under complex illumination conditions, photovoltaic cells in photovoltaic arrays will be occluded to varying degrees, and their overall output presents multi-peak characteristics. At this time, the traditional maximum power point tracking technology often falls into local maximum power point because it cannot achieve global judgment. Particle swarm optimization (PSO) can achieve global maximum power point search, but it’s tracking speed and environmental adaptability is not ideal. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a MPPT method which combines improved PSO algorithm with fuzzy algorithm. This method improves the speed and environmental adaptability of the algorithm by improving the motion mode of the optimal particle in the PSO algorithm based on the use of the fuzzy algorithm. The simulation model is built in MATLAB, and the simulation results show the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Route Planning of A Sanitation Vehicle in A Dynamic Traffic Environment
abstract: This paper investigates a new optimal routing problem of a sanitation vehicle. In this planning problem, during the operation times of this vehicle, time-varying properties of traffic flows are considered. We propose a time-space network (TSN) model for capturing the time-varying properties of traffic flows while routing the sanitation vehicle. The model provides a global route to avoid congested sections to ensure the shortest work time of the sanitation vehicle. A calculation case is used to illustrate the advantages of the model. Compared with the traditional time-invariant model, the proposed TSN model can minimize the completion times of all sanitation operations under real time-varying road conditions.

articleTitle: Short-term prediction of photoelectric power considering the influence of fog and haze
abstract: Accurate photovoltaic (PV) power prediction is an important basis for ensuring the safe and stable operation of high-permeability PV power generation systems. There are many environmental factors affecting the output power of PV power generation, and the influence of fog and haze on PV power cannot be ignored. In this paper the main factors of affecting PV power and the necessity of accounting for fog and haze in PV power prediction are described. The Air Quality Index (AQI) is selected as an indicator to measure the severity of fog and haze, and it is included in the historical data source of PV power prediction together with weather conditions. Aiming at the complex nonlinear problem of PV power prediction, a PV power prediction model based on BP neural network algorithm in fog and haze weather is established. In order to ensure the accuracy of PV power prediction, a training sample selection method based on ”similar time” is proposed. The analysis of the example verifies the necessity of considering fog and haze in the PV power prediction and the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Adaptive Backstepping Control for Spacecraft Hovering with Input Saturation and Parameter Uncertainties
abstract: In this paper, an improved adaptive backstepping controller with input saturation is designed to realize the spacecraft approaching and hovering control. The dynamics model for hovering with input saturation is established based on the first-order linearized relative motion model of elliptical reference orbit. An auxiliary system is introduced into the basic backstepping controller to compensate for the effect of input saturation. Then an improved backstepping controller with input saturation is designed and the corresponding stability analysis is also provided via the Lyapunov theory. In order to diminish the influence of parameter uncertainties, the Radial Basis Function Neural Network (RBFNN) is used to estimate the unknown parameters. Numerical simulations are conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, which can achieve better asymptotic stability than the original method.

articleTitle: Quasi-fixed Frequency and Phase Modulation Synchronous Control Based LCC Resonant Converter
abstract: This paper presents a novel quasi-fixed frequency based synchronous control scheme for the LCC resonant converter to suit the high frequency, low voltage and high current operating condition. Utilizing ZVS technique, the proposed method can guarantee the reliable load control ability and ensure the stable zero voltage by adjusting the frequency and the phase in the limited range. To show the effectiveness of the control algorithm, a LCC resonant converter with quasi fixed frequency (QFC) and phase modulation synchronous control is addressed in this paper. The LCC converter works in a continuous conduction mode near 700 kHz and implementing zero-voltage switching (ZVS) with 200-425 V input and 48 V/42 A output simultaneously, and it can suit the wide input/output range with high efficiency using the designed control scheme through the PSIM simulation results.

articleTitle: Fault location of measurement and control area based on universal gravitation search algorithm
abstract: When the distribution network fails, the operation and maintenance personnel need to quickly determine the fault location and minimize the scope of the inspection line so that the fault repair personnel can accurately reach the vicinity of the fault point to carry out work. Whether the fault location method is advanced and reliable directly affects the power failure time of the power supply user, and further affects the social, economic, and life aspects. Therefore, the fault location of the distribution network needs to satisfy both reliability and accuracy. It is the basis and premise for troubleshooting, isolating and restoring the power supply. Fault location of distribution network has important research significance. The universal gravitation search algorithm is used to locate faults in the non-measurement and control area of the distribution network, and the intelligent algorithm that meets the requirements of rapid positioning, accuracy and fault tolerance can improve the fault location efficiency.

articleTitle: Maneuvering Target Tracking based on Adaptive Cooperative Cubature Kalman Filter
abstract: For tracking a target with a sudden maneuver change by using multiple sensors, a distributed estimation approach based on adaptive cooperative cubature Kalman filter (ACCKF) is proposed. For alleviating tracking performance degradation caused by target abrupt maneuver, an adaptive cubature Kalman filter is designed by adding a time-varying fading factor, which can adjust filtering gain matrix in real-time. In ACCKF, a consensus-based distributed cubature Kalman filtering algorithm is developed, where a consensus weight matrix is present in the sensor network with communication topology. The ACCKF guarantees that all the local sensors can achieve a consensus in state estimation. Compared to centralized estimation approach, ACCKF can reduce the communication and computation burden. Simulation results show that ACCKF has good performance in tracking the target with a sudden maneuver change. Compared with the existing estimation approaches including the adaptive cubature Kalman filter, ACCKF has the best overall filtering performance.

articleTitle: Preprocessing Improvement in Mime Speech Recognition based on Surface Electromyogram
abstract: By extracting electrical signals on the surface of the speech-related muscles, which are, surface electromyography signals, information of the brain can be traced back to achieve silent speech recognition. Preprocessing is a crucial step for silent speech recognition and subsequent phases. In preprocessing of mime speech signals, baseline drift and active segment detection play an important role, but efforts in the direction are very limited. In this paper, the quadratic variation reduction separation baseline drift was introduced. On this basis, the three-parameter double threshold method based on autocorrelation function, band standard deviation, and short-time energy were used to detect the active segment of the surface electromyography signals, and good results were obtained. Finally, by extracting features, silent speech recognition was classified by the random forest algorithm. Experiments showed that the method described in this paper obtains 85% correctness in the data set of 9 words.

articleTitle: Improved Adaptive Bilateral Filter
abstract: Bilateral filtering is a non-linear filtering method that combines spatial proximity and pixel similarity of an image. It is good to preserve the high-frequency details in the image and smooth the number while preserving the strong edges. The traditional bilateral filtering algorithm needs to preset the spatial standard deviation and the gray scale deviation according to experience, the versatility is poor, the algorithm operation time is long and the effect is not ideal. Therefore, we proposed an adaptive bilateral filtering algorithm based on genetic algorithm. However, since the bilateral filtering preserves too much high-frequency information during denoising, the filtering effect on high-frequency noise is not ideal. Therefore, based on the bilateral filtering algorithm combined with wavelet threshold decomposition and least squares filtering method, an adaptive bilateral filtering algorithm based on wavelet threshold is proposed. Firstly, the low-frequency and high-frequency coefficients of the image are obtained by wavelet decomposition. Then the low-frequency part is processed by the adaptive bilateral filtering algorithm based on the genetic algorithm, and the least-squares filtering method is used to process the high-frequency part in this paper. The experimental results show that the proposed method has a good effect on the removal of random stationary noise.

articleTitle: Model-Based Event-Triggered Control for T-S Fuzzy Systems with Parameter Uncertainties
abstract: The MB-ETC (model-based event-triggered control) of continuous-time T-S fuzzy systems with uncertain parameters in network environment is the focus of this paper. To achieve the purpose of saving communication resources, the model-based control and event-triggered strategy are combined in this work. The control signal is generated by the states of the explicit model instead of the actual states of physical controlled plant, only when the difference between the estimated states and the actual states violates the event-triggered condition, then the actual states information of the physical plant will be transmitted through the network. Considering that it is difficult to obtain precise parameters of physical controlled plant model in engineering practice, a novel event-triggered condition concerning the parameters of the explicit model is proposed. In order to avoid the Zeno phenomenon, it is proved the periods between two successive triggered instants are always greater than zero. Finally, a simulation example is used to illustrate the effect of the model-based control for T-S fuzzy systems under the event-triggered scheme on reducing the communication frequency.

articleTitle: Research on Header Height Automatic Regulatory System
abstract: When combine harvester is working, manual regulation of the header height can't guarantee high instantaneity and precision. And its height data cannot be analyzed, which greatly reduces the harvesting efficiency. Therefore, the header height automatic regulatory system is particularly important. The system adopts an infrared sensor to measure the height. The infrared sensor acquires the height value of the current header from the ground. When the height is not suitable, it sends the signal to the single-chip microcomputer, to raise or fall the header through the hydraulic system and make the header at the suitable position. This design is of great reference significance for the header height automatic control.

articleTitle: Guaranteed cost control via dynamic output feedback for uncertain nonlinear system with data dropout and bounded disturbance
abstract: This paper investigates the dynamic output feedback guaranteed cost control for nonlinear uncertain networked control systems (NCSs) with data dropout and bounded disturbance. The data dropout process is able to be characterized by the Bernoulli stochastic variables. Considering the bounded disturbances, the conception of quadratic boundedness (QB) is invoked to depict system stability. The sufficient conditions are given to ensure the system stability and controller existence. Furthermore, the linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) technique is capable of transforming the controller design problem into a common and optimizable problem. Simulation of a continuous stirred tank reactor (CSTR) system can prove that the designed controller is effective.

articleTitle: Multi-attribute decision making method based on Pythagorean Fuzzy set and similarity measure
abstract: This paper proposes a new multi-attribute decision making method based on Pythagorean fuzzy set and similarity measure. Firstly, the decision scheme is represented by Pythagorean fuzzy numbers, and then their sizes are ranked by the Pythagorean fuzzy number ranking method, so as to determine the positive ideal attribute value and the negative ideal attribute value. Then, the similarity between each decision-making scheme and the ideal attribute values is calculated respectively. Finally, the relative closeness of each scheme is calculated, and the optimal ranking is made according to its size. The validity and reliability of the proposed method are verified by case simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Load Behavior Characteristics of Regional Distribution Network based on Data Mining
abstract: In active distribution network, power supply and load are the key elements to determine the operation of power network, at the same time, the randomness and uncertainty of power supply and load also bring challenges to the safe and economic operation of distribution network. How to explore the regularity of power supply operation, how to analyze the distribution load characteristics, adjustability and interaction with the power grid in depth is the key to realize the cooperative dispatching of active distribution network. In this paper, based on the existing and planned load of power grid, aiming at the new energy such as wind and light, the dispatching strategy of distribution network is studied, and the construction method of load data information is studied. Based on the data mining technology, the mathematical model of accurately predicting load output is established, and the typical load characteristics of the area are studied, and the response potential of all kinds of loads is studied, through which the mathematical model is studied. According to this order, the power grid dispatching center orders each generator set to arrange the power generation plan according to the dispatching plan, so as to realize the basic balance between the active power emitted by the power supply and the load in each period.

articleTitle: Method of parameters collaborative learning of multiple CAN node for industrial robots
abstract: Industrial robots usually divide some functions into modules in the form of multiple CAN nodes, set and use the same parameters to achieve specific motion control functions, and generally perform parameter learning through diagnostic services. In order to avoid all the CAN nodes to implement complex diagnostic protocols, the diagnostic protocols related to parameter learning are implemented on a single node, and the parameter learning and learning result verification of other nodes are dominated by dedicated CAN messages and protocols.It avoids the problem of repeated development of diagnostic protocols for multiple nodes. It is not necessary to modify the design of this method when adding or subtracting CAN nodes. It is also suitable for parameter collaborative learning of multiple CAN nodes in other CAN networks, and has strong versatility.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation Model of Electronic Instrument Component for Flight Simulator
abstract: In the simulation of electronic instrument, aiming at a large number of instrument parameters and displaying complex problems (parameters change with flight state), a model based on UML state machine and dynamic database is proposed to establish the instrument model. The UML state machine is used to normalize the display of the elements in the model display model, which enhances the portability of the model. The dynamic database is used to establish the message layered delivery mechanism of the instrument, and the dynamic information flow is layered to realize the hierarchical expression of the information flow on the simulation instrument. Finally, the hydraulic system display is taken as an example to verify the lower ECAM display function, which indicates the rationality and effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: IDA-PBC of the robot manipulator including actuator dynamics
abstract: In this paper, the trajectory tracking control problem of the manipulator including the dynamics of the actuator is studied. This paper chooses the permanent magnet synchronous motor(PMSM) as the actuator of the robot manipulator and combines the electrical subsystem equation with the mechanical subsystem equation. First, the combined equations are rewritten into port-control Hamilton(PCH) form. In order to obtain better tracking control effect, the traditional PCH model is changed into the Incremental model, and the track tracking controller of the system is designed by using the method of Interconnections and Damping Assignment and Passivity-Based Control (IDA-PBC). The control law designed by this method has a clear physical structure, global stability and avoids the divergence singularity of the control. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Publication of Technical Literature based on GJB6600
abstract: Technical literature is the bearing of the core knowledge of equipment, and it is the basis and support for the development of comprehensive equipment support. It is of great significance for equipment support. How to make the technical literature better play the inheritance, promotion and use efficiency of knowledge is the key problem to be solved in the comprehensive equipment support. The interactive electronic technical manual uses digital forms to store and manage technical literature in the form of text, forms, images, engineering graphics, sound, video, animation, and more. It is also viewed and used interactively to provide fault reasoning guidance and knowledge push services. In 2010, China released the interactive electronic technical manual National Military Standard GJB6600, which provides a good guide and specification for the use of military equipment technical literature, but lacks the support of a fully independent and controllable publishing platform. Under the background of domestically controllable domestic control, this paper analyzes the interactive publishing requirements of equipment developers and users for technical literature, gives the index of independent controllable technical literature publishing platform, and proposes an independent and controllable interactive publishing scheme based on GJB6600 technical literature. And proposed an interactive publishing platform construction facility that can guide technical literature.

articleTitle: A Novel Adaptive Neural Network-based Control for SISO Uncertain Nonlinear Systems
abstract: A unified neural control strategy is presented for uncertain nonlinear systems in this paper. Diagonal recurrent neural networks (DRNNs) with adjustable parameters are utilized to approach the unknown terms. By integrating the Lyapunov stability analysis with universal approximation performance of neural network, a stable neural control scheme is proposed to ensure that all the states of the control system are uniformly ultimately bounded (UUB). The novel design strategy contains the offline training of DRNNs and online adaptive control is utilized to reduce the computation of network training. Simulations experiments are given to illustrate the effectiveness of our approach.

articleTitle: Application of Process Analysis based on Value Objective Improvement in Risk Identification of Supply Chain
abstract: Identifying the source and driving factors of supply chain risk is the key to manage supply chain risk successfully. At present, most researches focus on specific methods for specific risks. These methods have a broad direction in the macro level, but are not specific enough to the specific point. The solution to problems can only be controlled in the macro level, and sometimes the effect is not obvious. In view of these problems, based on the process described by the supply chain reference model, combined with the process modeling method of value objects, this paper explores the specific internal risk points deeply, obtains the functional risk targets framework and the basic risk target framework, and decomposes the target frameworks simultaneously to establish the supply chain risk objective system. Finally, the application and benefit of this method are illustrated by an example analysis of the dairy supply chain.

articleTitle: Pose Detection of Object on Transmission Belt Based on R-SSD
abstract: The traditional object detection algorithm can only obtain the horizontal detection frame. In this paper, to solve the problem of large background noise and missing angle information in the detection frame, a bottle target detection model based on SSD (Single Shot multi-frame Detector) algorithm is proposed. The convolutional neural network is used as the feature extraction unit, which realized the gradient bounding box regression by introducing angle prediction. In order to improve the accuracy of the model, the feature pyramid structure is introduced into the feature extraction network, feature pyramid structure enables deep semantic information in the network to be combined with shallow layers. The prior box is determined by K-means clustering algorithm, it is used to make the network model more suitable for the bottle target. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is better than the original SSD algorithm, the AP value reaches 90.7%, and the real-time performance of the algorithm is also greatly improved.
