In this study, we examined acoustic velocity patterns in sound Melia azedarach trunk sections as well as the sections with artificial defects. Field testing was then conducted on Ginkgo biloba and Cinnamomum camphora trees to test the feasibility of using the measured acoustic velocity patterns to diagnose internal condition of the trees. The results confirmed that the acoustic velocities measured in sound trunk sections conformed to the second order polynomial relationships. Center rot caused significant changes in acoustic velocity patterns when the diameter of the hole reached 11 cm and beyond. Successful filed inspection cases indicate that acoustic velocity pattern recognition can be used effectively for inspecting trees in urban settings.

articleTitle: A New Method for Multiple Open-Transistor Fault Diagnosis in Photovoltaic micro-grid inverter by disposing the output current
abstract: Two-level inverter is extensively used in photovoltaic micro-grid power generation system. The transistor in the two-level inverter works under high stress and is prone to failure. In order to increase the practicability and reliability of photovoltaic micro-grid system inverters, it is necessary to study a fast and accurate fault diagnosis method for inverters. Therefore, this paper proposes a new open-circuit fault diagnosis method for photovoltaic micro-grid inverter. The proposed method has a simple calculation process and only needs to analyze the output current without the use of additional sensors, so the diagnosis cost is low. According to the different changes of output current, the diagnostic variables and adaptive thresholds are calculated for fault diagnosis and location. It can be seen from the simulation report that this method can diagnose the fault of transistor quickly and accurately, and it is robust to load disturbance.

articleTitle: Robust fault estimation based on Proportional Integral observer for Takagi-Sugeno fuzzy systems
abstract: The problem of robust fault estimation in studied in this paper for Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy systems with interval time-varying delays, external disturbances and faults. Assumed that faults are signals that change over time, in addition, their k-order derivatives are limited by a constant. Then a Proportional Integral observer is constructed to ensure the asymptotic stability of the error dynamic system under the specified H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through simulation results.

articleTitle: Self-learning Attention Global Pooling Based Image Representation for Visual Place Recognition
abstract: The visual place recognition is based on the image to determine whether the current scene match the scene in the index data set and localization. However, due to the scene appearance and the shooting position changing with time, such as distance, viewpoint, illumination, weather, season, traffic flow, etc., it is a challenge to extract more distinguishing and representative image representation by overcoming multiple variables. Recently based on convolutional neural networks, many global pooling methods have been proposed and reached the cutting edge of the state of the art, but they ignore the correlation of local regions in different channels. Therefore we propose a self-learning attention global pooling model for feature maps and performs end-to-end fine-tuning training for contrastive loss through Siamese network. The experimental results show that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art global pooling method on two public test datasets: ROxford and RParis.

articleTitle: The Design of The Human Condition Detection System Based on STM32
abstract: The human body condition detection system designed by STM32 consists of MCU, power supply module, ECG module, skin electricity module, body temperature module, wireless transmission module and liquid crystal display module. The power supply module provides power for the whole system. MCU centralizes the calculation and processing of the data information in the whole system. ECG module collects the ECG signal of users through AD8232 chip. The skin electricity module collects the skin electricity signal through L324 chip. The body temperature module collects the temperature signal through NTC thermistor and displays ECG waveform and skin temperature value on OLED. Wireless transmission module communicates with intelligent terminal through CC2540 chip. Users can know their health status in real time. The system has the advantages of simple structure design, low power consumption and low cost, which makes the medical service more portable, personal and family-oriented.

articleTitle: The Photovoltaic Intelligent Grid-connection System Based on Module Cascade Topology
abstract: We make a deep development on automatic switching interface based on inverter step-up transformer to settle the instability of the photovoltaic system voltage. We use PLC's ant colony algorithm to ensure that the power quality of each module can meet the corresponding requirements, in order to realize the photovoltaic intelligent grid-connection. This paper adopts Level 2 DC/DC boost inverter to raise the theory of voltage from DC480V to DC3kV and then to DC10kV. Finally, it incorporated into 110kV distribution network line in two steps used DC/AC inverter on 10kV. The system of this paper shows a certain stability in practical applications, but there is still a lot of room for improvement.

articleTitle: Fractional-order PD Control at Hopf Bifurcations In a Neuron System
abstract: The problem of bifurcation control is investigated for a delayed neuron system under a novel fractional-order controller. Taking discrete delay as a bifurcation parameter, we use a novel fractional-order Proportional-Derivative (PD) feedback controller to adjust the control parameter, so as to analyse the stability and Hopf bifurcation of the system. The effect on the system bifurcation point is studied in comparison with an integer-order controller. The stability of the system is judged by the Routh-Hurwitz criteria. Through calculation and analysis, we derive sufficient conditions of ensuring Hopf bifurcation to occur for this model. Finally, numerical simulation examples are presented to show the feasibility of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Saturation control for two dimensional disturbed crowd dynamic system
abstract: In this article, a saturation feedback control law is designed for a two dimensional disturbed crowd dynamic system. The disturbances of the system are caused by the influx of unexpected pedestrians. The crowd dynamic system model is based on the conservation law of mass. Control law is designed to make the pedestrians move smoothly in a set direction, and it solves the issue of control saturation successfully. The stability of the closed-loop system is proved by using the Lyapunov method. The modeling of the system and the proof of stability are all done within the scope of the distributed parameter system, avoiding errors caused by the model reduction. Finally, simulation example is used to verify the validity of the control law.

articleTitle: Singular Configuration Analysis of a Portable Exoskeleton Arm
abstract: This paper focuses on the analysis and simulation of singularity configuration of the portable exoskeleton arm. Firstly, the kinematic equation and the Jacobian matrix are deduced. The singular configurations of the redundant exoskeleton mechanism are obtained in a manner that resolves the sub-determinant. Secondly, the comparison between the singular configurations of the exoskeleton arm is made by the simulation of the dexterity index to demonstrate the effectiveness. Finally, the advantages and disadvantages of various dexterity indicators are analyzed in the light of the simulation results and the singular configurations. Simulation results of different dexterity indicators verified the correctness of the singularity analysis. The proposed method is helpful for the further trajectory planning research and singularity avoidance research of exoskeleton arm.

articleTitle: Research on Constant Power Control of Electric Vehicle Radio Energy Transmission Based on New Nonlinear PID Controller
abstract: Due to the rapid development of electric vehicles, the field of wireless charging of electric vehicles is the research direction of this paper. The wireless charging process has nonlinearity, time-varying and uncertainty. The traditional PID controller has been difficult to produce good control effects, so a nonlinear PID controller is introduced. Based on the circuit principle, the state space model is established. Based on the given parameters, the accuracy of the model is verified based on the simulation results. By establishing a good model, the nonlinear PID control of the DC/DC thruster duty cycle is carried out, and the constant power process of the electric vehicle is realized faster by adjusting the nonlinear PID parameters, thereby further improving the actual performance of the electric vehicle.

articleTitle: Descriptor Self-tuning Incremental Kalman Estimator
abstract: Under certain environmental conditions, the unknown system errors often occur and yield to larger filtering errors when the unverified or uncalibrated measurement equation is used. Incremental equation can be introduced, which will effectively solve the problem of state estimation for the systems with unknown system errors. For the linear discrete descriptor systems under poor observation condition, a descriptor incremental Kalman estimation algorithm is firstly presented under the canonical form. The state estimation problem for the descriptor systems with unknown measurement errors is solved. Furthermore, a descriptor selft-uning incremental Kalman estimator is proposed when the model parameters and noise statistics both are unknown. Based on dynamic error system analysis method, the convergence analysis is also carried out. The simulation example shows the effectiveness and feasibility.

articleTitle: H∞ Control for Second-order Multi-agent Systems With Markovian Switching Topologies
abstract: In this paper, we studies consensus problems for double-integrator multi-agent systems subject to external disturbances and randomly switching topologies which obeys time homogeneous Markov process. Building on the tenets of the stochastic stability theory and the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> control approach, the sufficient condition of consensus with H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance is derived for the systems. The control protocol presented is a common one which is not strictly dependent on random state. Finally, the theoretical results were verified by simulation.

articleTitle: DSNet:Multi-resolution Dense Encoder and Stack Decoder Network for Aerial Image Segmentation
abstract: Semantic segmentation in high resolution aerial image is faced with a challenge caused by ubiquitous fine-structure objects. Traditional encoder-decoder structure losses some detail information during the process of down-sampling, which is harmful to the location of fine-structure objects. In this work, we present a multi-resolution dense encoder and stack decoder network to deal with this problem. On the one hand, the dense encoder embeds shallow detailed feature into deep semantic feature through proposed information-reserved down-sampling method called CE-Pooling. On the other hand, the stack decoder gradually enhances the detailed feature through iterative attention fusion. Extensive experiments on several benchmark datasets have been conducted, which shows that our method is superior than the state-of-the-art approaches.

articleTitle: Modularity Analysis of Smart Building Solutions
abstract: This paper studies the modularity analysis problem for smarting building solutions. We utilize the modularization function that was originally introduced for analyzing the degree of modularity in a given product architecture. Traditional dedicated smart building solutions and a newly introduced mass customization solution called I<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>B are compared. The new solution performs better in managing complexity in new product development for smart building systems.

articleTitle: Study on Lightning Protection Design for Automatic Instrument System of Nuclear Power Plant
abstract: In recent years, there have been many signal interference events by lightning in the automatic instrument system of nuclear power plants at home and abroad, which affect the normal operation of nuclear power plants. Based on the specific lightning events in nuclear power plant, this paper analyses the causes of lightning impact on automatic instrument system, and puts forward the main measures of lightning protection for automatic instrument system in nuclear power plant from the aspects of lightning arrester, shielding, grounding and surge protection.

articleTitle: A Protocol Conversion Scheme Between WIA-PA Networks and Time-Sensitive Networks
abstract: With the development of industrial Internet of Things, many new industrial networks are emerging. Among these networks, the standard of Wireless Networks for Industrial Automation-Process Automation (WIA-PA) is one typical specification for industrial wireless networking, while Time-Sensitive Network (TSN) is another typical specification for industrial wired networking. A factory network often consists of multiple kinds of networks, including wireless media and wired media. Therefore, effective protocol conversion among different industrial networks becomes more and more significant. To address this issue, this paper presents a conversion scheme between WIA-PA and TSN based on data flow mapping. The proposed scheme is composed of a set of conversion methods, including priority conversion method, flow identification conversion method, address conversion method, cross-network clock synchronization method, and bandwidth reservation method. The conversion mechanism is designed in detail and implemented on experimental platform. Test results show that the mutual conversion of data streams of the two networks is achieved effectively by the proposed scheme, while the key network characteristics such as the data stream priorities are maintained.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Soil Strength Testing Device Based on STM32
abstract: A design of soil detection device based on STM32 single chip microcomputer is proposed The concept of “controller + function module” is adopted as a whole. STM32F103ZET6 single-chip microcomputer as the main control chip, integrated servo motor, HMI serial display, pressure sensor, ball screw and other devices. It can accurately detect the soil strength and display it in real time. With the traditional PID algorithm real-time adjustment of speed can be realized After testing, the detector has high practicability and reliability.

articleTitle: Leader-follower cooperative control of multiple marine surface vehicles with unknown disturbances
abstract: This article investigates the leader-follower cooperative control of multiple marine surface vehicles with unknown disturbances induced ocean environment. A nonlinear observer is developed to estimate unknown time-varying disturbances, and a rapid convergent cooperative controller is designed based on graph theory, backstepping technology and disturbance observer. The results show that the proposed cooperative controllers can achievement formation behavior control among vehicle for inaccurate dynamics model and any undirected connected communication topology of each vehicle. By using Lyapunov stability analysis, all signals of closed-loop systems are guaranteed to be uniformly ultimately bounded, and the tracking errors eventually tend to zero. Numerical simulation studies are demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Disturbance Rejection Predictive Control for Flue Gas Desulfurization System
abstract: The flue gas desulfurization system is vulnerable to various unknown or unmeasured disturbances. In reality, the type of disturbance is usually unknown or multiple disturbances occur simultaneously in the system. To cope with this issue, this paper proposes the disturbance rejection predictive control strategy based on the new augmented state space model. The new state space model is firstly augmented to reduce the modeling error and be convenient for practical use. To detect the type of disturbance, the disturbance model bank is then established and state estimation is applied to estimate the unknown disturbance model. Furthermore, the method of disturbance model weighting is provided. Finally, the objective function is modified to cope with the continuous effects of the disturbances. Based on the above procedure, a model predictive controller is designed. The validity of the strategy is demonstrated by simulation results.

articleTitle: Redundant INS/ADS System’s Fault Detection and Isolation Based on Dempster-Shafer Evidence Reasoning
abstract: In allusion to residual chi-square test method has low sensitivity for soft fault detection and cannot isolate the faulty system in integrated navigation system, a redundant INS/ADS fault detection and isolation method based on Dempster-Shafer (D-S) evidence reasoning is proposed in this paper. In this method, three INS/ADS and three INS/GPS sub-filters are constructed respectively by introducing intact GPS in the three redundancy INS/ADS system, and the difference between the residuals of each two sub-filters is used as evidence, then the fault detection of sub-filters is completed by using D-S evidence reasoning. On this basis, the fault isolation and system reconstruction methods are given, and the fault isolation of the INS/ADS integrated navigation system is realized. The simulation results show that the proposed method can not only improve the sensitivity of soft fault detection, but also isolate the fault system in integrated navigation system.

articleTitle: Research on Analysis Technology of Burglary Point Pattern Based on LGCP Model
abstract: Burglary is a violent criminal act that infringes on the property of others. In order to better understand the criminal model and make full use of law enforcement resources, this paper uses the space-time analysis technology to study the spatial distribution, spatial dependence and the rules of burglary cases in the main urban area of a city in 2016. The LGCP (Log-Gaussian Cox Process) model combines with the Bayesian framework to establish a continuous spatial random fields. The model is calculated using INLA(Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation) and SPDE(Stochastic Partial Differential Equations). Studies have shown that burglary cases have different trend values at different time points and different spatial locations, and have strong correlations in adjacent time periods and spatial random fields. The intensity of burglary and the spatial distribution of retail points and cultural education are linear relationship, and there is a complex nonlinear relationship with the spatial trend of sports and leisure points, but it presents a positive correlation in the whole, the more concentrated the sports and leisure, cultural education and wholesale and retail are, the higher the risk of burglary.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Calibration Algorithm for Shipborne Grid SINS Based on Double Calculating Circuits
abstract: This paper addresses an optimal comprehensive calibration algorithm (CCA) based on double calculating circuits to estimate the gyroscope constant drifts of shipborne grid Strap-down Inertial Navigation System (SGSINS). Two calculating circuits named navigation circuit and calibration circuit are defined. With the same outputs of Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU), the navigation circuit outputs the navigation parameters which can navigate in arbitrary working state; the calibration circuit works in non-damping state which is used to estimate the gyroscope constant drifts. On the basis of SGSINS error model, the gyroscope constant drifts are estimated by Kalman filter under the assistance of external position. The simulation results indicate that the proposed algorithm can estimate the gyroscope constant drifts accurately, compensating the gyroscope constant drifts can effectively suppress the drifted error in SGSINS. In the proposed CCA, the navigation circuit can navigate in arbitrary working state, meanwhile because the gyroscope constant drifts are estimated in non-damping state, the algorithm is not interfered by the maneuvering of the ship.

Author Keywords: shipborne grid Strap-down Inertial Navigation System

articleTitle: Moving Target Tracking of Nonholonomic Mobile Robots for with Anti-Interference via Finite-Time Control
abstract: A finite-time control strategy is presented in the paper to stabilize nonholonomic mobile robots for moving target tracking with external disturbance. On the one hand, we obtain the moving target tracking equation processed by polar coordinate method and creatively inject external disturbance as the control target of this paper. On the other hand, an appropriate finite-time controller consistent with stability requirements is designed to transform the proposed dynamics system model into a chained-form system. Therefore, we theoretically verify the validity of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Improved Autonomous Navigation Algorithms for Dual Satellite Formations with Online Observability Assessment
abstract: Over the next decade, more and more aerospace missions are expected to be implemented using distributed satellite systems. A variety of these missions put forward the requirement of determining the respective absolute orbit and relative orbit of satellite in a formation autonomously. This paper focuses on the method of estimating the absolute and relative positions of a dual satellite formation only based on measurements of the relative position vector from one satellite to the other. A new index which can reflect observability on line is proposed and applied to autonomous navigation filtering process. Improved UKF and CKF with on-line observability evaluation were designed and used as navigation algorithms for synchronous orbit estimation of the two satellites. Several simulations have been carried out, resulting that those improved navigation algorithms can obviously improve the accuracy of the autonomous navigation system for the dual satellite formation.

articleTitle: Dual-voltage power supply system based on Y-source bidirectional DC-DC converter
abstract: In order to improve the stability and the gain of traditional bidirectional DC-DC converter, a new bidirectional Y-source DC-DC converter is proposed. The new type converter has the advantages of small size, small weight, high voltage gain, stable input voltage and continuous input current. This paper analyzes the working process of the new type of converter in power forward transmission and power reverse transmission, adopts PWM method to control IGBT switch, and verifies the rationality of this new type of converter by Matlab/Simulink simulation.

articleTitle: Adaptive sliding mode control of uncertain nonlinear switched systems: A new design
abstract: This brief studied the adaptive control for switched systems with uncertainty through sliding mode technique. A linear sliding surface (LSS) is established as a result that the system in sliding phase are totally invariable to uncertainty. Then, in light of Lyapunov stability theory, linear matrix inequality (LMI) and average dwell time (ADT) method, the stability condition of the switched systems is derived. An adaptive controller is then developed to assure the finite-time accessibility of the predesigned LSS. Finally, the validity of developed scheme can be confirmed by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Feature Selection Algorithm based on Double-hook Function and TWSVM
abstract: Twin support vector machine (TWSVM) produces a pair of non-parallel hyperplanes in the progress of classification, which makes each feature correspond to two weights. While using the two weight vectors to select features directly is not possible. In this paper, a feature selection algorithm based on double-hook function and twin support vector machine is proposed, namely double-hook TWSVM algorithm. In this algorithm, combined with the characteristics of the double-hook function, the two weight vectors generated in the process of solving the linear TWSVM are merged into one single weight vector, which represents the corresponding feature’s degree of importance, so that this weight vector can be used to select the characteristics. Finally, the algorithm is analyzed by UCI dataset. To further prove the performance of our algorithm in the aspect of feature selection, it is then used to select color features from a real dataset of woodiness board and make classification. The experimental results show that the feature selection algorithm based on the double-hook twin support vector machine can remove the redundant features, reduce the dimension of features, and ensure a high classification accuracy, which means the algorithm has played a crucial role in the selection of features.

articleTitle: Robust Higher Desensitized Cubature Kalman Filter for Uncertain Parameter
abstract: A robust fifth-degree desensitized cubature Kalman filter (5thDCKF) is proposed to estimates nonlinear state with uncertain parameters. State error sensitivities of the states and covariance about uncertain parameters are propagated by using the fifth-degree cubature points with weights. Then, a novel cost-function is modified by penalizing cost-function, which only includes trace of the posteriori covariance, with state error sensitivities and their weights. A closed-form gain matrix is calculated by minimizing the novel designed cost-function, and this 5thDCKF algorithm is derived. Numerical simulation with a falling body model demonstrates the good performance of the presented 5thDCKF.

articleTitle: The Research of SPAD in Rice Leaves Based on Machine Learning
abstract: The purpose of this study was to explore the relationship between the leaf image parameters and SPAD values under RGB color space to provide theoretical basis for rapid and accurate acquisition of plant SPAD values and theoretical guidance for scientific fertilization. Based on Android, the image of rice leaves was acquired, and the color feature parameters of rice leaves were collected interactively by using JNI and OpenCV. BP neural network algorithm was applied to train the sample data of rice color characteristic parameters, and R, G and B were systematically acquired as input variables to predict the SPAD values of rice. The results showed that the RGB of the area which were circled manually were obtained using Android. And the root mean square error of which were 1.086, 1.413 and 0.8383, respectively; meanwhile, compared with other models, the BP neural network prediction model proposed in this study had the lowest root-mean-square error, which was 1.6679. The study can accurately obtain the RGB and SPAD values without contacting the leaf organs, providing a new universal method for the rapid and non-destructive measurement of SPAD values.

articleTitle: The Design of Automatic Monitoring System for Steel Structure Construction Safety and Its Application
abstract: In order to determine the safety of the steel structure during the construction, to evaluate whether the construction results meet the design requirements, according to the simulation results, the stress of the main rods of the structure during the construction process is monitored in real time. The stress strain automatic real-time online monitoring system is designed and integrated development, and applied to jiqing high speed rail Hongdao station south big wave steel structure project. The application results show that the system is stable, reliable and high accuracy, effectively guiding the construction of the project. It ensures the safety and quality of the structure during construction.

articleTitle: Networked guaranteed cost PID control via LMI approach for second-order processes
abstract: Networked guaranteed cost PID control via LMI approach for second-order processes is investigated in this paper. By using the augmented state space form to rewrite a typical second-order process transfer function and controller, the selection of PID tracking controller parameters is reduced to the solution of LMIs. Based on the free weight matrix, the reciprocal convex combination and the cone complementarity linearization method, the controller parameters which satisfy the tracking performance are obtained, and the traditional PID control method is adopted to realize networked trajectory tracking control. Finally, the validity of the proposed method is illustrated by the given experiment in this paper.

articleTitle: Gap-based Multi-model Predictive Control of a TITO System
abstract: Gap metric is widely used in multi-model control. It is used to carry out the multi-model decomposition and it is also used to realize multi-model combination. The multi-model predictive control method, which integrates the advantages of the model predictive control technique and the multi-model control method, has attracted much attention in nonlinear control systems. In this work, we present a gap-based multi-model predictive control (GMMPC) method and apply it to a two-input-two-output (TITO) nonlinear system.

articleTitle: Design of Composite Current Frequency Sensor
abstract: Based on the actual needs of many engineering applications, a Hall current sensor capable of simultaneously measuring current data and frequency is designed. The sensor uses the single chip STM32F373CT6 to connect multiple functional modules together and combines Fourier transform to complete the acquisition, processing and output of the measured signal. The system hardware block diagram and algorithm flow chart are given, combined with the system. The design scheme explains the main functional modules. The simulation and actual measurement show the rationality and feasibility of the sensor. It has the ability to simultaneously measure current and frequency, high integration, high measurement accuracy and wide measurement range.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Superheated Steam Temperature Control of Supercritical Boiler Unit Based on Elman Neural Network Inverse Models
abstract: The superheated steam temperature (SST) system of a large-scale supercritical power unit has the characteristics of nonlinearity, large time delay and strong coupling, thus it is often difficult to guarantee the SST control effect with only the traditional control method when a power unit works in deep peak load regulation condition, which often leads to large temperature control error and long settling time. The application of artificial neural network based intelligent strategy to improve the SST control effect has becoming an important research trend. In this paper, by analyzing the SST influencing factors and the characteristics of the water-spray desuperheating system of a 600MW supercritical power unit, appropriate input and output variables are selected and the inverse models for the two stages of water-spray desuperheating system are established with Elman-type recurrent neural network. Based on the developed ANN models, the neural network inverse control scheme for the water-spray desuperheating system is studied. Detailed control simulation experiments under large-scope load-changing dynamic conditions are carried out with a full-scope power unit simulator. The simulation results showed that the neural network inverse control approach proposed in this paper effectively improves the SST control quality, and enhances the flexibility of unit operation with well engineering application prospects.

articleTitle: Optimal Selection Method of Gyroscope Groups Based on Dedicated Observer Scheme
abstract: In this paper, an optimal selection method of gyroscope groups based on dedicated observer scheme and extended Kalman filter is proposed. According to the measurements of star sensors and gyroscopes, an extended Kalman filter is designed by the satellite attitude kinematic equation to estimate the attitude and generate the system residual. In addition, multiple sets of filters are built based on the redundancy of the gyroscope hardware. Three heads with the smallest error are selected to calculate the angular velocity of the satellite, achieving high-precision attitude determination. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Image Processing Algorithm and Visual System of Ship Segmentation Spraying
abstract: This paper introduces the algorithms of image processing of ship segments and designs the vision module of spraying robot. Firstly, the image of the target object is collected and gray-level processing is adopted. Then, the filtering and noise reduction operation is carried out. Several common filtering and noise reduction methods are compared to select the appropriate median filtering method in this paper. In addition, in the process of image segmentation, the threshold segmentation and various edge detection operators are expounded, and the advantages and disadvantages of the relevant methods are discussed in detail. Canny edge detection algorithm suitable for segmented spraying for ships is chosen. In feature extraction, hough line transform is selected to detect and extract the linear features of the target workpiece in this paper, and the visual measurement system is simply calibrated to obtain the pixel ratio value which can be used to measure the width and height of the workpiece. The parameters are provided for the path of piecewise spraying.

articleTitle: Real-time Production Monitoring for Chinese Pharmacy Based on Convolutional Neural Network
abstract: A deep monitoring architecture for extraction and esterification process monitoring in Chinese Pharmacy production based on convolution neural network is proposed and lightweight model is also researched. Different convolution kernel including 2D convolution, depth-wise convolution and 3D convolution is compared to improve the performance of monitoring. Experimental results show that accuracy of the designed extraction monitoring model is 98.95% using 3D convolution and esterification monitoring mode has the accuracy of 98.68%. Meanwhile, lightweight model using depth-wise convolution can reduce computation while ensuring accuracy.

articleTitle: Adaptive Fault-Tolerant Control for Free-Floating Space Manipulator with Parameter Uncertainties
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive fault-tolerant control scheme is proposed for the free-floating space manipulator (FFSM) with unknown parameters of dynamic model and actuator faults. In control design for the FFSM, because of unknown loads or tools attached to the manipulator, the structure parameters of the FFSM will change, which leads to uncertainties in the FFSM dynamic model. Meanwhile the space manipulator is prone to failure in the long-term operation. For the above two issues, we propose a control method based on direct adaptation of uncertainties with linear parametrization of dynamic model. Further, time-varying actuator faults are handled by estimating the bounds of unknown parameters in the fault model. Simulation is carried out to demonstrate the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Generation method for strict entry corridor of hypersonic gliding vehicles
abstract: Traditionally the upper boundary of an entry corridor is determined by quasi-equilibrium gliding condition (QEGC) which is a relatively `soft' constraint, leading to a loosen result. This paper presents an improved generation method in pursue of a stricter entry flight corridor of hypersonic gliding vehicles. Firstly, the path constraints during the entry phase are modeled and the traditional corridor generation method is briefly introduced. Secondly, based on the aforementioned constraints and the dropping trajectories of the vehicles, the innovated method is elaborated. Then, a safety factor is defined. Based on the safety factor, the emergence possibility of a certain velocity can be assessed. With the new generation method and the definition of the safety factor, the features of the entry flight can be better understood.

articleTitle: A Low Latency WuR Protocol in Multi-Hop Wireless Sensor Networks
abstract: This paper proposes a PCT-WuR protocol that can reduce the delay of packet communication in a DCT-WuR based tree network. According to the network traffic, it adaptively decides whether to send two data packets at the wake-up time of the node, thereby reducing the number of nodes containing wake-up receivers, packet communication delay and packet loss probability. Finally, this paper improves the node loss probability model to analyze the WuR MAC protocol based on the M/G/1/2 queue. The results show the efficiency of the proposed protocol, PTC-WuR reduced the packet loss probability by 23.09%, the delay by 21.48%, and the node packet processing speed by 11.36%.

articleTitle: Robust Control Method for Power Balance in Wind Energy Integrated in Power Systems
abstract: With the industry penetration of large-scale wind power, feature changes in reliable operation are induced by uncertain output, so adequate robust decisions are an inevitable way to secure utilization of wind energy security and stability. In light of the problem of tracking robust decision-maker expectations during uncertain demand for adequate dispatch, an adaptive dispatch mechanism for a ‘general adequacy-economy’ game is proposed. First, the ‘general adequacy-economy’ differential game model is designed, and a robust control theory is introduced to prove the existence of the differential game solution. Furthermore, the evolution vector and confidence interval is defined and an evolutionary feedback equation is established, cascading the differential game solution to obtain the adaptive game solution and revise its dynamic robustness in advance. Ultimately, a ‘general adequacy-economy’ dynamic dispatch is achieved in advance, which can satisfy decision-maker expectations for robust tracking during the most uncertain modes in adequacy resource demand. The proposed model for the mechanism and the method are applied to wind energy integrated in an actual grid operation, and the results demonstrate its robustness.

articleTitle: optimization Design of Coil of Magnetically Coupled Resonant Wireless Power Transmission System
abstract: Coupling coil is considered as the core link of the wireless power transmission system, and the optimal design of coupling coil the has a direct impact on the transmission efficiency and power of the whole wireless power transmission system. In this paper, we utilized ADS software to build a typical wireless power circuit based on the equivalent circuit model of the prototype system to simulate the energy transfer process and analyze the system transmission efficiency and power output which reduced the computational complexity and simplified the coil design process. In order to implement the optimized coupling coil of the wireless transmission system, coupling coil parameters are calculated to the determine the optimal resonant capacitance compensation, coupling coefficient, and radius of coil by the establishment of simulation model of circuit. The equivalent circuit model of the system has the wide applicability. The simulation results show that the design method can improve the transmission performance optimization of the magnetically coupled resonant wireless power transmission system.

articleTitle: Bumpless Transfer for Switched Linear Systems Under Unknown Switching Sequences by Controller State Initialisation
abstract: The bumpless transfer control problem for linear switched systems under unknown switching sequences is first proposed and studied in the framework of generated reference-tracking. Motivated by this case, we propose an approach consisting of a mode-estimator and controller state re-initialisation. The proposed approach aims at improving the tracking performance of a suitable candidate controller that has been determined for the current plant mode. The mode estimator selects the active mode from the measured data of the switched system. The controller state initialisation is proposed for complementing a simple bumpless transfer method by minimizing a quadratic cost function that combines two different error signals: tracking error and steady-state control output error. The result is that the supervised switching mechanism ensures both the stability of switched systems and the performance of bumpless transfer.

articleTitle: Research on Optimized Speed Measurement Algorithm Based on Error Correction
abstract: In this paper, for the non-contact speed measurement technology of maglev train, the speed measurement accuracy needs to be improved, and the relative positioning error is large. So the MEMS-IMU inertial measurement unit is introduced to compensate the speed of the original speed measurement system, and the error based on the MEMS-IMU speed measurement is performed analysis. Based on this, an error correction method based on wavelet threshold optimization and an optimized speed measurement algorithm are proposed to improve the speed measurement performance.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking of Intelligent Vehicle Using Model Predictive Control Based on Neural-dynamics Optimization
abstract: This paper proposes a model predictive control (MPC) scheme based on neural network optimization for trajectory tracking of intelligent vehicles. Firstly, the vehicle kinematics model is linearized to obtain the vehicle kinematic linear tracking error model, which can be used to predict the future movement of the vehicle. The control scheme combining a feedforward controller and a feedback controller is raised. In the objective function, the control increment constraint and relaxation factor are considered, thereby ensuring the smoothness of the trajectory. The MPC optimization can be iteratively transformed into a quadratic programming problem with inequality constraints, then it can be solved online using primal dual neural network. Finally, the effectiveness and stability of the control strategy are proved through experiments.

articleTitle: Micro Particle Diameter Detection with Electrostatic Sensor for Powder Feeding Pipeline
abstract: With regard to micro particle diameter in the powder feeding pipe, the paper puts forward a ring design structure of electrostatic sensor. The design of sensor is important in micro particle diameter detection. The designed sensor is adapted to a large signal bandwidth with random noise, so that more measurement signal information can be obtained by the sensor. And it can reduce the impact of external noise in the system. The sensing width of electrode in the ring-shaped electrostatic sensor should be moderate, ensuring that the sensor has higher sensitivity in practical applications. At the same time, the dynamic experimental measurement of the ring-shaped electrostatic sensor was carried out on the experimental platform built in the laboratory. The sensitivity and measurement accuracy were confirmed.

articleTitle: Reliable Stabilization of Delta Operator Switched Linear Systems with Persistent Dwell-time
abstract: Here, a persistent dwell-time(PDT) approach is employed for reliable stabilization of Delta operator(DO) switched systems. For DO switched nonlinear systems, the switching stabilization criterion is proposed by using PDT approach. Based on this stability criterion, the reliable controller and the switching law with PDT are designed to make sure that the closed-loop system is globally uniformly asymptotically stable(GUAS). The performance of the proposed approach is illustrated by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Brain Storm optimization Algorithm based on Prior Knowledge and Heuristic Crossover Operator for Traveling Salesman Problem
abstract: Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) is a classic combinatorial optimization problem. This paper proposes a Brain Storm optimization (BSO) algorithm based on prior knowledge and heuristic crossover operator (PKHDBSO) to solve TSP. The algorithm firstly uses the convex hull or greedy algorithm to initialize the population, which can improve the initial population quality. Secondly, a heuristic crossover operator is introduced in the process of generating new individuals to improve the search efficiency of the algorithm considering the characteristics of the TSP. The effectiveness and practicability of the algorithm are verified by a set of simulation example. The results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm have better performance in solving large-scale TSP.

articleTitle: On Electromagnetic Blank Holder Control System
abstract: Electromagnetic blank holder is an advanced control technology in deep drawing process. In this paper, the technology of electromagnetic blank holder control system is studied. Firstly, the mechanical model of electromagnetic blank holder control system is established. The simulation model of electromagnetic blank holder device is established using Maxwell software. The distribution of magnetic field and electromagnetic force are analyzed. Secondly, Matlab/Simulink software and Maxwell software are linked using Simplorer software. The co-simulation of the electromagnetic blank holder control system is realized for power supply, blank holder device and control system. Finally, the response curves of excitation current and electromagnetic force of electromagnetic blank holder control system are obtained by the co-simulation. The results show that the control system has a good performance of dynamic and steady. The blank holder force can be precisely controlled after researching the electromagnetic blank holder control system. It improves the wrinkling and cracking defects of cylindrical parts in the forming process. It can promote the development of deep drawing technology.

articleTitle: Method for Calculating Number of Backup Applications in Server Cluster of Regulation Cloud
abstract: Regulation cloud platform is clearly proposed in the 13th Five-Year Plan of State Grid Corporation of China’s informatization. In order to meet the growing demand for business and technology development. At present, applications of regulation cloud need to run in server clusters. To ensure the stable operation of the platform, each application needs to be backed up by several other machines. This paper proposes a method which can calculate the number of backup server for an application, make the use of hardware source more rational and the platform more stable.

articleTitle: Type Selection Design And Structural Optimization Of 66 Kv Transmission Line Tower
abstract: Whether the structure design of transmission line poles and towers is reasonable or not has a great impact on the construction cost of the whole power supply system. In this paper, the type selection design and structure optimization of 66 kV transmission line poles and towers are studied as the main content. Firstly, the data of pole and tower type selection and double circuit tower type of 66kV transmission line are given. Secondly, the selection of insulators and the optimization design of tower head clearance are carried out. Finally, the optimization design of pole and tower structure is carried out based on finite element method. The research results of this paper can provide a reference for the type selection design and structure optimization research of 66kV transmission line poles and towers.

articleTitle: AdvNet: Multi-Task Fusion of Object Detection and Semantic Segmentation
abstract: Environment perception is essential for autonomous driving vehicles (ADVs), and vision plays a vital role in environmental perception. Object detection and semantic segmentation as the basic computer vision tasks have become the significant technology in the ADVs' perception module. With the development of deep learning, the results of both tasks had an obvious leap. However, these advances have been driven by a powerful baseline system, which brings strict computing resource requirements. When deploying these two tasks on the same platform, real-time performance usually gets worse. In this paper, a method was presented for end-to-end lane segmentation and obstacle detection in real-time performance. In this method, a multi-task network was designed by fusing segmentation network architecture and detection network architecture. With a specific training strategy and a modified open dataset, this method has an excellent performance in detecting lane lines and obstacles simultaneously. When comparing with separately running detection and segmentation modules at the same computing platform, the method presented in this paper achieves better real-time performance and lower hardware requirements.

articleTitle: Event prediction via spatio-temporal sequence analysis
abstract: Event prediction often refers to the process of inferring dynamic information such as human pose change, object motion trajectory and event development direction from static images or partial video, which has broad application prospects in security monitoring, automatic driving, human-computer interaction and other fields. This article proposes the means of deep learning to conduct research on sequence images' event prediction in time and space dimensions. To solve the problem of missing semantic information and lack of external information in the current event prediction research, we propose to adopt human skeleton constraint as guiding information, then complete the task from two aspects: skeleton detection and prediction in two-dimensional sequence images, image generation under skeleton guidance. The sequence images event prediction and generation model can generate realistic images with good continuity and perfect details on the basis of reasonable prediction in a short time. To verify the feasibility of our algorithm, we carried out a series of experiments on multiple deep learning network structures. The experimental results of the traditional motion detection dataset and the automatic driving dataset show the theoretical and practical value of the proposed algorithm in the field of sequence image event prediction, which has great potential for development.

articleTitle: Stability and Hopf Bifurcation of Multi-ring Coupling Neural Network with Delays
abstract: Most previous studies with respect to bifurcation dynamics of neural networks are limited to low dimensional or simple single ring structure. It should be noted that neural networks are composed of thousands of neurons, and these network structures are so complex that cannot be accurate representation by a single ring structure or several nodes. Therefore, it has greater practicality and the potential to study the model of high-dimensional or multi-ring coupling neural network. However, how to obtain characteristic equations of high dimensional systems is an unavoidable problem for researchers. In current paper, a model with four rings coupling neural network is proposed, and the stability and Hopf bifurcation of this model are studied. In order to overcome the obstacle of solving characteristic equation by higher order determinant, the Coates flow graph method is used to obtain the characteristic equations of higher order neural network model. Finally, some numerical simulation examples are given to demonstrate the validity of proposed theoretical results, meanwhile the relation between the number of rings and bifurcation point is given by simulation.

articleTitle: Infrared small target detection based on local multidirectional gradient
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low detection rate of small infrared target under complex background and heavy clutter interference, an infrared small target detection method based on local multidirectional gradient is proposed. Firstly, Laplace operator is used to sharpen the image and enhance the target. Then, the local multidirectional gradient function is redefined by the gradient direction feature analysis of the image. And it improves the anti-jamming ability for strong clutter. Finally, the real target is extracted by adaptive threshold segmentation. The experimental results show that the method can effectively improve the target detection ability under complex background and strong clutter interference.

articleTitle: Formal Analysis for Automatic Train Operation System and Research on Diagnosis of Anomalies
abstract: The Chinese Train Control System (CTCS) with Automatic Train Operation (ATO) Function transmits the information through corresponding transmission channel to ensure the safety of the train operation. It is necessary to analyze the consistency of specification and implementation in information exchanges to promote the efficiency of subsequent maintenance. The formal method of communication sequence process (CSP) is selected according to the specification, and the time series of the test data are mapped to IOTS (Input-Output Transition System). The system-level fault diagnosis method is applied to the diagnosis of abnormal conditions in the information interaction. Finally, the state of the equipment is figured out based on test information quantitatively.

articleTitle: Distributed Estimation Fusion for Maneuvering Target Based on Consensus Method and Cubature Kalman Filter with Switching Topologies Network
abstract: This paper proposes a distributed estimates fusion algorithm for target tracking problem based on consensus method and cubature kalman filter with switching topology network. In order to get the accurate state information of maneuvering target via sensor network, this paper develops filter algorithm by taking the advantage of consensus method and cubature kalman filter. Firstly, each sensor node gets the local estimation by performing cubature kalman filter algorithm. Secondly, we develops a fusion protocol to fuse the estimates from each sensor node in the sensor network based on the consensus method. In this step, the switching topologies of sensor network is considered and the sufficient condition for the algorithm proposed in this paper is given. Besides, this paper analyses the boundedness of the algorithm proposed and gives the detailed proof of convergence. Finally, a simulation example is presented to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: The rolling optimization strategy of CCHP system based on the electric-thermal dual time-scale
abstract: The combined cooling, heating and power (CCHP) system, as one of the important development direction of distributed energy, has a excellent application prospect and development significance. Furthermore, the CCHP system itself is a complicated system with many kinds of energies coupling. Nowadays, with renewable energy such as photovoltaic and wind power developing rapidly, energy diversification and structure innovation have further intensified the coupling of energy systems. Considering that the user-side load demand and the renewable energy output have strong volatility, and the power scheduling can be completed in a few seconds, but the thermal energy scheduling has a large time delay so it cannot be scheduled in real time, a rolling optimization operation strategy for CCHP system based on electric-thermal dual time-scale has been put forward in this paper. Based on the comfort range of the house, the strategy establishes the electric-thermal dual time-scale rolling optimization model, aiming at the overall economic, energy-saving and CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission optimization of the system, solving the real-time output of each joint device to achieve collaborative optimization of electricity and heating on multiple time-scale. Simulation results show that the proposed strategy improves the efficiency and timeliness of the CCHP system.

articleTitle: Passenger Cooperative Guidance System for Urban Rail Transit Stations
abstract: Guidance is very important to improve the operational efficiency of urban rail transit stations (URTSs) and ensure the safety of passengers. Cooperation among different guidance modes can not only reduce the operational cost of the URTSs but also benefit the organization of passenger flow in the station. This paper presents a framework of passenger cooperative guidance systems under the influence of three guidance modes, i.e., the leader, sign and broadcasting. The cooperative guidance scheme is formulated by considering the cost and efficiency of different guidance modes. We also propose a modified social force model to investigate crowd dynamics taking into account the influence of leaders, signs, and broadcasting. A case study of passenger evacuation simulations at a URTS is conducted to evaluate the performance of the cooperative guidance scheme. Simulation results show that cooperation among different guidance modes can improve passenger evacuation efficiency and the utilization ratio of exits.

articleTitle: Hand motion identification from surface EMG signals based on multi-feature integration
abstract: Surface electromyography (sEMG) signals have been used as the inputs of many human-machine interface applications. Different methods for upper limb motion recognition are developed based on sEMG features. The sEMG feature extraction is the key issue in affecting classification performance in multi-motion pattern recognition. A number of features have been extracted to form feature combinations. However, these feature combinations are simple concatenation of multiple features. The combination weights for different sEMG features are equal. It may not help to design an effective multi-motion recognition system. In this study, to overcome the limitation and combine flexibly multiple features, we propose a multi-feature integration method based on multiple kernel learning (MKL) framework for motion recognition. The proposed method integrates the valuable information which can represent the motion patterns. Multiple kinds of features are fused together with optimal combination weights. In the experiment, we test the proposed method on multiple different hand motions. The corresponding experimental results show that the proposed method provides better classification performance than the other frequently used methods of feature combination. The results confirm that the proposed method is quite promising in integrating sEMG multi-features to advance the classification performance further for multi-motion recognition.

articleTitle: Study on fracture fault diagnosis online method of bogie of maglev train
abstract: It will be realized that automatic alarm and prediction for abnormal conditions such as structural cracks, if the state of bogie structure can be monitored during the operation of Maglev train, which can improve the safety performance of maglev train. The inherent characteristics of the structure are unaffected by the environment, such as modal frequency and damping. When the structure changes, the inherent characteristics change, so these changes can be used to diagnose structural cracks. Due to the system and measurement error existed, the sensitivity coefficient of each order modal frequency of the crack is different, so it is difficult to identify the fault by using the traditional threshold method. In view of this problem, the Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is introduced to extract the feature, and then the pattern classification is carried out by support vector machine (SVM). Simulation results show that this method is feasible.

articleTitle: Fractional-order Fixed-time Nonsingular Backstepping Control of an Incommensurate Fractional-order Ferroresonance System
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new incommensurate fractional-order ferroresonance system which can describe the loss in actual ferroresonance incidents. Some basic dynamic behaviors are investigated via time series of states, phase portraits and 0-1 test which all indicate that chaotic oscillation occurs. To suppress undesirable ferroresonance more quickly and avoid singularity in backstepping procedure, a new fixed-time reaching law is proposed. And then, a new fractional-order fixed-time backstepping controller of such incommensurate fractional-order system is designed. The global system can be stabilized within a fixed time by only one control input.

articleTitle: Improvement of Electrical Control of M7130c Horizontal Axle Moment Table Surface
abstract: Manufacturing industry plays an important role in the development of national economy. Every country focuses on the renewal iteration of Numerical control machine. Old ordinary machine tools have long been unable to meet the current needs of manufacturing and production. This paper analyses the characteristics of working and controlling system of the surface grinder, and combining the hardware of PLC, touch screen and frequency converter, tries to reform the machine tool function and improve the and reliability.

articleTitle: SCR System Design of Wartsila 4L20 Diesel Engine
abstract: The air pollution caused by diesel engine exhaust emission was studied. Firstly, the research direction of selective catalytic reduction technology (SCR) was determined by studying the current emission problems and the technological development status and regulations of various countries in the world. The exhaust emission datas of Wartsila 4L20 diesel engine were measured through the experiment, and the theoretical data of installing SCR system of this diesel engine was obtained through calculation. According to these data, the size of injection pump and catalyst were selected.

articleTitle: Method for Output Reconstruction of Relay Protection Simulation Signal Based on Wavelet Theory
abstract: Power system transient simulation software such as PSCAD and MATLAB is used as a signal source for a new generation of relay protection signal generators. In the simulation process, the external errors of the system model caused by different simulation algorithms will be generated, so the output signal has larger harmonics distortion. This phenomenon affects the actual value of the data and the accuracy of the experiment. Therefore, a signal detection method based on wavelet theory is proposed. Combined with the total harmonic distortion rate index of voltage and current, a complete detection and reconstruction method of output waveform is established to eliminate the non-source error caused by different algorithms in transient simulation. Tests were performed using simulated signals and the results show the proposed methodology to be feasible.

articleTitle: A parametric approach to design state feedback stabilizer for switched unified chaotic systems
abstract: In this research, a parametric approach for switched unified chaotic (SUC) systems is presented to design state feedback stabilizer. Based on the solutions of generalized Sylvester equation (GSE), the completely parametric form of unified state feedback stabilizer is obtained. With the presented approach, closed-loop system is transformed into a linear constant system with a desired eigenstructure. Further, a numerical simulation is put forward to verify the effectiveness of the parametric approach.

articleTitle: Identification of MSWI Furnace Temperature Model Based on Weighted Adaptive Particle Swarm optimization
abstract: In order to obtain the accurate dynamic model of the furnace temperature of a solid waste incineration plant, the intelligent algorithm based on weighted adaptive particle swarm optimization algorithm is used for parameter identification. First, the transfer function model of furnace temperature is determined by burning characteristic analysis. Then, the model parameters to be identified are determined. Finally, the parameters of primary air-furnace temperature channel transfer function model are identified by weighted adaptive particle swarm optimization using preprocessed data; In the iteration process, the algorithm can obtain the optimal weight value for each iteration adaptively according to the objective function value and maximum and minimum value of the weight, which improves the identification accuracy of the algorithm. The simulation results show that the established transfer function model can fully describe the dynamic characteristics of this condition, and proves the effectiveness of the weighted adaptive particle swarm optimization algorithm, which provides a basis for subsequent multi-channel model identification of furnace temperature.

articleTitle: Feed-forward decoupling control of solvent-based post-combustion CO2 capture system
abstract: Developing effective control strategy to achieve flexible operation of the solvent-based post combustion CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> capture (PCC) process is the guarantee for the application of the technology. However, control of the PCC process is challenging due to its complex behavior such as strong couplings and disturbances. This paper proposes an advanced control approach for the solvent-based post combustion CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> capture system. On the basis of the conventional PID control structure, decoupling technique is used to overcome the coupling issues among multi-variables and a feedforward controller is used to improve the response speed of the PCC system to the flue gas flow rate change. Moreover, the parameters of the PID controller is tuned through optimization using genetic algorithm. Simulation studies show the advantages of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Modeling and measurement internal threat process based on advanced stochastic model
abstract: Previous research on internal threats was mostly focused on modeling threat behaviors. These studies have paid little attention to risk measurement. This paper analyzed the internal threat scenarios, introduced the operation related protection model into the firewall-password model, constructed a series of sub models. By analyzing the illegal data out process, the analysis model of target network can be rapidly generated based on four protection sub-models. Then the risk value of an assessment point can be computed dynamically according to the Petri net computing characteristics and the effectiveness of overall network protection can be measured. This method improves the granularity of the model and simplifies the complexity of modeling complex networks and can realize dynamic and real-time risk measurement.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Attitude Control Thruster Based on the Extended State Observer
abstract: In this paper, the fault diagnosis of attitude control thruster based on the extended state observer is studied. The unexpected torque caused by the fault is regarded as a kind of interference, and the observation is made by the extended state observer, and the corresponding fault detection and positioning scheme is designed to achieve fault diagnosis accurately. Simulation results show that this method can diagnose the specific faults of attitude control thruster accurately and quickly.

articleTitle: An Improved State of Charge Estimation Method for Lithium-Ion Battery Used in a Wide Ambient Temperature Range
abstract: State of charge (SOC) is the key parameter of electric vehicle power battery. This paper proposes an improved SOC estimation method for lithium-ion battery used in a wide temperature range. First, a equivalent circuit is used to establish the mathematical model of power battery, the genetic algorithm (GA) is used to identify the model parameters at different ambient temperatures, simultaneously. Then, adaptive extended Kalman filter (AEKF) is utilized to estimate battery SOC at different ambient temperatures. The accuracy and robustness of the proposed algorithm are verified under different operating conditions and various initial SOC levels. It is found that the proposed SOC estimation method has the wide temperature adaptability, and could converge to the reference value gradually within the steady-state error 2%.

articleTitle: Sensorless Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Improved Model Reference Adaptive System
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of rotor position estimation and speed tracking in sensorless vector control system of permanent magnet synchronous motor(PMSM), an adaptive full-order observer is proposed based on model reference adaptive system(MRAS) method. This method combines the estimation equation and the calibration link to form the closed-loop estimation by introducing the correction term. The sliding mode controller(SMC) is used to control the rotation speed loop instead of the traditional PI controller to improve the anti-disturbance ability of the system. The simulation results show that the improved model reference adaptive system method can better estimate the rotation speed and rotor position in the case of motor startup, sudden change of speed and sudden change of the load torque. The method has good stability and robustness.

articleTitle: ShuDA-RFBNet for Real-time Multi-task Traffic Scene Perception
abstract: Traffic scene perception is key of autonomous driving. Computer vision and deep learning are popular basis of algorithms in this field. Current researches are mainly on single task, leading to high computing power demands and low operational efficiency. And algorithms may be trained on a small dataset, which means easier overfitting and more susceptible to noises. To overcome above shortcomings, we propose an end-to-end multi-task deep convolutional network model named ShuDA-RFBNet for multiple object detection and drivable area segmentation simultaneously. ShuDA-RFBNet adopts RFBNet for multiple object detection and DenseASPP for drivable area segmentation task. Both networks share a light-weight ShuffleNet V2 as the base net to extract features. ShuDA-RFBNet uses BDD100K to train, which is the current largest and diverse driving video dataset. Test results show that the mAP of multiple object detection task is 32.71% and the MOU of drivable area segmentation task is 82.67%. ShuDA-RFBNet can inference in real time.

articleTitle: Research on an Improved equivalent fuel consumption minimization strategy Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
abstract: In order to further improve fuel economy and control system stability of hybrid electric vehicle (HEV), the ant colony algorithm (ACO) is used to optimize the control strategy. Firstly, the logic threshold control strategy is combined with the traditional equivalent fuel consumption minimization strategy (ECMS). On this basis, the ant colony algorithm is used to optimize the charge and discharge equivalent factors of the improved energy management strategy. This research mainly seeks optimization under UDDS conditions, and finally simulates on the ADVISOR platform. In the final simulation results, the improved equivalent fuel consumption minimization strategy based on ant colony algorithm (ACO-ECMS) has higher fuel economy and emission control than the traditional equivalent fuel consumption minimization strategy.

articleTitle: Pedestrian-Aligned Multiscale Features Network for Person Re-identification
abstract: Person re-identification intends to seek out and match a target pedestrian from different cameras. In practice, images captured by different cameras typically have variances in complex scenes. In addition, large-scale datasets generally adopt automatic detectors to obtain pedestrian detection boxes, and detection errors can lead to image misalignment problems. Both complex scenes and detection errors reduce the robustness of pedestrian characteristics and exasperate the capability of pedestrian alignment. To tackle the above conundrums, we design a novel end-to-end method called Pedestrian-Aligned Multiscale Features Network (PA-MFN), integrating pedestrian alignment and multiscale features network through spatial transformer networks (STN). We employ pedestrian alignment network to work out image misalignment problems satisfactorily. Additionally, we carefully design multiscale features network to extract both global and local features. Comprehensive experiments indicate that our approach gains superior performance on Market-1501, DukeMTMC-reID as well as CUHK03 datasets.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of Diagnostic system for Integrated body Controller Based on CAN bus
abstract: In the development and design process of automobile electronic control unit, the bus simulation test tool CANoe, developed by Vector can monitor and simulate the electronic control unit in real time, which brings convenience to the development of electronic control system and bus system. In this paper, the CANoe simulation software is used to test the integrated body control system of a certain vehicle, and the CANoe electronic unit diagnostic test case is written according to the UDS diagnostic service, so as to realize the functions of automatic fault simulation, fault diagnosis and test result analysis. Shorten the development cycle of the product, reduce the cost of product development and manufacture, and improve the quality of the product.

articleTitle: Feature Points Extraction Based on Improved ORB-SLAM
abstract: In ORB-SLAM tracking threads of mobile robots, feature points extraction based on fixed threshold can cause large overlap and uneven distribution of feature points, and the number of feature points change sharply with the brightness changes. To solve this problem, a feature point extraction algorithm based on local adaptive threshold was proposed. Firstly, the algorithm filtered feature points by setting adaptive parameters and calculating each pixel threshold with dynamically local threshold, thus improving the extraction method of ORB feature points based on fixed threshold, overcoming corner loss or redundancy caused by improper selection of fixed threshold. Finally, by classifying the brightness of pixels, candidate feature points were screened layer by layer to achieve accurate extraction of ORB feature points. The experimental results demonstrate that the number of feature points of the improved ORB algorithm is not easy to fluctuate dramatically, and the accuracy gets improved, extracting time increases slightly, overall repetition rate is relatively high. These results are of reference value for the study of feature points matching, robot pose estimation and navigation.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Fault Detection for SOFC system based on Random Forest and SVM
abstract: Accurately detecting faults is essential for the development and maintenance of safe and reliable Solid Oxide Fuel Cell (SOFC) system. In this paper, A fault detection framework combining data generation and data-driven modeling for SOFC system is proposed: The most important features are selected based on Random Forest and the Support Vector Machine with radial basis kernel function (rbf-SVM) is applied to realize multi-fault classification. The experimental results demonstrate that the method is feasible and effective, significantly improving the performance of fault detection and isolation (FDI).

articleTitle: Distributed Fault Estimation for Uncertain Multiagent Systems With Directed Graphs
abstract: A distributed fault estimation observer (DFEO) for uncertain multiagent systems (MASs) is proposed in this paper. At first, based on the communication topology of MASs a relative output estimation error is defined. Secondly, in order to enhance the accuracy of fault estimation a DFEO with adjustable parameter (AP) is constructed. The gain of DFEO, based on H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> pole placement (PP), is calculated by multi-constraint design method. Finally, a more reliable and efficient DFEO is proposed by introducing AP,the feasibility was shown by simulation results. Keywords: Adjustable parameter, uncertain multiagent systems, distributed fault estimation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Autonomous Vehicle Platoon with Disturbance Based on PLEXE
abstract: The automation and coordination of vehicle has provided novel development opportunities for both the improvement of traffic efficiency and the efficiency and safety of vehicles within the platoon so that the research of related technology had becoming more and more popular. In this paper, we evaluate five traditional vehicle platoon auto-driving control algorithms in the sinusoidal scenario with disturbance. The simulation is realized in the PLEXE, which is an extension of the widespread vehicle network simulator Veins that allows the visually realistic simulation of platooning systems(i.e., automated car-following) and the analysis of mixed scenarios. For disturbance model in sinusoidal scenario, Gaussian noise is leveraged, which is a common disturbance of all kinds of system. Simulations' results indicate that, when the leader in the platoon driving with sinusoidal velocity with disturbance, Flatbed algorithm proposed by A. Ali, G. Garcia, and P. Martinet has higher stability and Anti-interference ability than the other four control algorithms. In addition, even under violent interference, this control law can maintain string stability (significant for platoon automation)and consistency of the platoon operations, such as consistent velocity and constant inter-vehicle gaps.

articleTitle: Backstepping Control of Flexible Manipulator for Printed Cloth Take and Release Based on Immersion and Invariance Adaptive
abstract: Aiming at improving the system stability and tracking accuracy affected by the nonlinearity and uncertainty of flexible manipulator in the process of printed cloth take and release, a backstepping control method based on immersion and invariance (I&I) adaptive is proposed. Firstly, a flexible manipulator model with unknown joint moment of inertia is established in the form of forth-order nonlinear differential equations. Then the I&I adaptive and backstepping method are combined to design the system control law and parameter estimation law. The proposed method can avoid over-parameterization and calculation explosion compared with traditional adaptive backstepping algorithm. Finally, the advantages of the proposed method in joint position tracking accuracy and parameter estimation performance are verified by simulation with Matlab.

articleTitle: Improved Two-Stage Gauss Pseudospectral Collocation Approach for Engineering Optimal Control Problems
abstract: To improve the optimization performance of Gauss pseudospectral method for bang-bang optimal control problems, a two-stage mesh refinement Gauss pseudospectral method based on the sensitivity is proposed. In the first stage, the state and control vector are approximated by global interpolation polynomials. The differential equations are approximated by orthogonal polynomials and the optimal control problem is then transformed into an NLP problem.
