To overcome this defect of slow convergence rate, this paper presents a novel q-Gaussian maximum correntropy criterion with conjugate gradient (QMCC-CG) algorithm. The proposed QMCC-CG algorithm accelerates the convergence and improves filtering accuracy compared to the conventional MCC algorithms in impulsive noises. Monte Carlo simulated results on system identification validate the superior performance of QMCC-CG.

articleTitle: Research on Moving Target Detection Method in Variable Background
abstract: It is the basis and research key of computer vision recognition to extract the moving target accurately and effectively from the video stream or image sequence. In this paper, a moving object detection method based on improved five-frame difference and edge detection is proposed to fit the motion target detection in the case of camera motion. By using the adaptive similarity threshold and the adaptive similarity preprocessing method based on fingerprint matching, the background overlap of the continuous frame image in the mobile background can meet the requirement of the frame background. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can improve the target recognition rate to 89%, and control the false positive rate to about 11%. It can detect the moving target accurately and meet the real-time requirement in the mobile background.

articleTitle: Inverse Linear Quadratic Control for Electric Looper in Hot Strip Finishing Mill
abstract: The control problem of looper and tension system in HSFM (Hot Strip Finishing Mill) is investigated in this paper. ILQ (Inverse Linear Quadratic) is used to design optimal linear quadratic regulator for electric looper. In the ILQ design concept, the optimal feedback control law is designed based on pole assignment and there is no need to solve the traditional Riccati equation. As a result, ILQ provides more freedom for electric looper control. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Quadruplet-Center Loss for Face Verification
abstract: Deep learning for face verification applications has proven to be productive. Most existing face verification methods focus on enhance the discriminative power of the deeply learned features with softmax loss or learning discriminative features with deep metric learning, which have their own advantages, but the combination of these two directions is more or less ignored. In this paper, a novel loss named quadruplet-center loss is proposed to learn more discriminative features for face verification task. The proposed quadruplet-center loss learns a center for deep features of each class, which forces the distances between the samples and centers from different classes are larger than those from same class and regardless of whether they contain different probe images or not. It is worth mentioning that a dynamic margin is presented based on the average distance between samples and corresponding centers for loss functions in a batch. Our method is evaluated on two widely-used benchmarks for face verification, which outperforms most of the state-of-the-art algorithms. The experimental results clearly demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed classification loss.

articleTitle: Adaptive Robust Synovial Electromagnetic Suspension Control Based on RBF Neural Network
abstract: The electromagnetic suspension control system is a complex nonlinear open-loop unstable system. At the same time, the uncertainty of the model and external disturbance will further increase the design difficulty of the controller. The sliding film control method requires a relatively large switching gain to deal with the larger Modeling uncertainty, which will bring about the problem of buffeting, so this paper uses the radial basis function (RBF) neural network adaptive approximation of the sliding film control strategy for electromagnetic suspension control, for complex nonlinear electromagnetic suspension systems Control can effectively guarantee the stability and convergence of the system.

articleTitle: RBF neural network PID trajectory tracking based on 6-PSS parallel robot
abstract: Aiming at the problems of trajectory tracking of six-degree-of-freedom parallel robots, this paper proposes a control strategy combining RBF neural network and traditional PID. According to the nonlinear characteristics of parallel robot, RBF neural network is used to approximate the characteristics of arbitrary nonlinear function. The RBF neural network is optimized by gradient descent algorithm. The neural network PID controller is designed to find the optimal PID parameters through the adaptive self-learning ability of the neural network, thus achieving better trajectory tracking effect.

articleTitle: Control Strategy of High Frequency injection method for permanent Magnet synchronous Motor based on improved sliding Mode Controller
abstract: In order to solve the problems of large overshoot, slow response and insufficient anti-interference ability of the traditional speed PI controller, the sliding mode variable structure controller is introduced into the high frequency voltage injection system. In this paper, the sliding mode controller is a second-order sliding mode controller based on super-twisting algorithm. A variable saturation function with boundary layer is introduced into the vector control system of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) instead of the traditional PI controller. At the same time, the rotor position and speed estimation by high frequency injection method are simplified. The simulation results show that the speed controller can adjust the speed loop of the motor efficiently. Compared with the traditional PI controller, the second-order sliding mode controller has better dynamic performance.

articleTitle: Improved visual-inertial navigation system using self-adjusting entropy difference
abstract: The visual-inertial navigation system of LK-Optical Flow is very sensitive to the environment of different light intensity. In this paper, an adaptive VINS, based on image entropy difference is proposed, which can adjust the emphasis of the weight in the optimization function at any time. The algorithm uses the entropy theory of continuous image to change little, constructs the weight factor of the visual estimation in the optimization function, adjusts the weight of IMU and visual online, and realizes the adaptive estimation of the position and attitude of the object. The method is applied to VINS, to overcome the problem that the poor image quality of the system leads to the degradation of system performance. Finally, the outdoor experimental results verify the performance of the proposed adaptive entropy difference VINS(EE-VINS).

articleTitle: Study on Energy Coordination of Building Power Supply System Based on Neural Network
abstract: In order to solve the problems of system instability and high energy dissipation in building power supply system using micro-grid structure and photovoltaic energy, an energy coordination strategy based on predicted value was proposed. According to the similar daily principle, BP neural network is used to predict photovoltaic power generation and building load on a day-ahead basis, and the predicted power generation is used as the benchmark to coordinate the power supply system, so as to ensure the power balance of source, network and load when the power supply system switches day and night under various weather conditions. The feasibility and reliability of the energy coordination strategy were verified by modeling the simulation system on MATLAB/SIMULINK platform.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation Modeling and Analysis Based on ELM Integrated AHP and PCA: Application to Food Safety
abstract: As an effective investigation, quality evaluation can summarize the various aspects of the corresponding evaluation objects. To reflect the true situation of the evaluation object more comprehensively and accurately, the focus of the evaluation process is how to effectively deal with the data of each evaluation indicator. To this end, this paper proposes a quality evaluation and analysis model, which is based on extreme learning machine (ELM) integrated principal component analysis (PCA) and analytic hierarchy process (AHP). The proposed model makes full use of the systematic and simplicity of AHP to assign weights to several important indicators, and uses PCA to eliminate the relevant impact of evaluation indicators, reducing the workload of indicator selections. Then the comprehensive quality score of the evaluation object is calculated according to the comprehensive evaluation function. At last, the generated new sample data set constitutes the training set of ELM, and finally the comprehensive quality evaluation model is obtained. To evaluate the performance of the proposed model, the proposed model is applied to the food safety data processing. Compared with the traditional food risk analysis model, the proposed model can get a more comprehensive result, which can enable decision makers to grasp the food quality information more accurately and comprehensively, and make corresponding feedback timely.

articleTitle: Research on KRT Monitoring Instrument Alarm Threshold in Main Control Room of Nuclear Power Plant
abstract: In this paper, the intake air gamma radioactive monitoring alarm threshold of nuclear plant main control room was studied for both under normal operation condition and accident conditions. According to two different layout schemes, gamma radiation dose rate of measuring point was calculated by the MCNP code under three typical accidents (including S3, DBA-LOCA and LOCA conditions). The results show that it is proper that to keep original value of the detector alarm threshold of improved main control room, it could provide effective radiation protection for indoor staff.

articleTitle: Decoupling Control of Temperature and Vacuum in Molecular Distillation System Based on Expected Dynamic Method
abstract: The wiped film molecular distillation system is a complex multivariable strong coupling system in which the temperature and vacuum in the evaporator are coupled. In this paper, based on the previous experimental data, the mathematical model of temperature and vacuum is established by the method of system identification. Secondly, the system model matrix is designed according to the actual decoupling system structure, the controller matrix is decoupled and the controller of the system is designed by the expected dynamic method to construct the decoupling control model. Finally, compared with the traditional PID controller, the simulation results show that the system with the expected dynamic method has faster response time, less overshoot and stronger robustness.

articleTitle: Research on Cooperative Dispatching Method of Distribution Network Considering Flexible Load
abstract: Replacing coal with electricity, large capacity storage and electricity heating making the composition and characteristics of conventional load change fundamentally. There are the larger changes in the overall features of the power load and the larger randomness and elasticity of loads. As a result, mastering users' characteristics and behavior habits of electricity can be effectively applied in the system of safety evaluation and operation plan. Power system load under the condition of new energy power complied with high permeability is influenced by a variety of external factors. We must take effective measures to fully exert the load ability of adjusting and scheduling, realize the coordinated scheduling of the distribution network. Therefore, the main research contents of this paper are as follows: (1) analyze the charging behavior characteristics of EV and establish the probability model of EV charging load; (2) analyze the control characteristics and operation mode of the heat and power storage boiler, then establish the thermo-electric regulation and control load model of the heat and power storage boiler; (3) analyze the working mode and operating constraints of energy storage battery, and establish the power regulation load model of large-capacity energy storage battery.

articleTitle: A Novel Ensemble Clustering Approach with Internal Weighting Strategy
abstract: Due to its strong robustness and high accuracy, the ensemble clustering has been extensively applied in many fields. Despite the significant achievements, there is a limitation need to be overcome. Most of the existing ensemble clustering methods commonly value all component clusterings equally regardless of their different quality. Therefore, low-quality component clusterings are very destructive for them. Although many modified measures have been adopted to weight each component clustering base on their quality, yet these measures have a tendency to treat each cluster as an unit and ignore the diversity of clusters belonging to same basis clustering. How to take into count the diversity of clusters and the internal structure of component clusterings to improve the consensus performance is a problem that need to be solved. In this paper, a novel ensemble clustering method is proposed to solve this problem. Firstly, We adopt five clustering methods to generate diverse component clusterings. Secondly, in order to build candidate component clustering pool, we propose a new method to discard low-quality component clusterings. Thirdly, we utilize a advanced method to evaluate the unreliability of clusters with respect to candidate component clusterings. Finally, we further utilize a accepted weighting strategy and a consensus function to obtain consensus clustering. We have conducted extensive experiments to demonstrate the superiority of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Quasi-optimal Fusion Incremental Kalman Filter with Correlated Noises
abstract: In this paper, the local incremental Kalman filter with correlated noises is firstly presented, which solves the state estimation problem for the systems with unknown measurement errors. Furthermore, a quasi-optimal fusion incremental Kalman filter with correlated noises is proposed. They effectively solve the state estimation problem for the multi-sensor systems under poor observation condition. The proposed algorithms have the advantages of simple form and small computational burden so that they can be easily applied in engineering practice. Two simulation examples show the effectiveness and feasibility of these algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on anti-noise performance of Digital Phase Sensitive Detection Algorithm in Magnetic Nanoparticle Thermometer
abstract: In a magnetic nanoparticle-mediated hyperthermia, the temperature is a key factor for thermal therapy to treat cancer. A harmonic amplitude detection algorithm determines the measurement accuracy of magnetic nanoparticle thermometer. In this paper, we introduce a harmonic detection algorithm, digital phase sensitive detection (DPSD), study DPSD how to affect the measurement accuracy of magnetic nanoparticle thermometer, and analyze the anti-noise performance of DPSD, including the static magnetic noise, industrial frequency magnetic noise, higher frequency magnetic noise, and Gauss noise. The optimum system parameters are proposed, and verified in numerical simulation experiments by use of MATLAB. The simulation results show that the DPSD with optimum system parameter can attach a high measurement accuracy of magnetic nanoparticle thermometer.

articleTitle: Assembly Control Strategy and Software Framework of Micro-accelerometer Based on Machine Vision
abstract: In order to realize the automatic assembly of micro parts in the production line, an assembly system was designed, which realizes the automatic assembly of parts through modular structure design and software framework based on image processing identification and positioning. The assembly system adopts modular design, which mainly includes four parts: assembly operation module, visual measurement module, assembly platform module and loading platform module, which can realize the automatic locking of the assembled parts and the interaction with the production line. In order to automate the assembly process, the position and pose information of the part is obtained by means of visual measurement, which ensures automatic detection of the assembly process and incorrect assembly judgment. The layered software framework is designed to achieve automatic assembly according to a predetermined assembly process and to adjust the error caused by the assembly process. The experimental results show that the assembly system can realize the task of automatic assembly of small parts.

articleTitle: The Research on Mechanical Properties Based on Entire Company Type Isolated Phase Closed Bus
abstract: Based on the whole company from phase enclosed bus as the research object, the application “diameter mapping method through the theoretical calculation analysis, analysis of three phase short circuit conditions, the stress state of busbar and its mathematical expression force. Application of MATLAB software, respectively, and the bus bar a maximum of electric power, at the beginning of the current phase Angle and time, and comparing with the approximate calculation formula. The results show that the approximate calculation of the maximum electric power and current phase angle error is bigger, at the beginning of MATLAB software are used to calculate the result more accurate. Therefore, the application of theoretical calculation method is put forward in this paper can accurately calculate the entire company type bus when you leave the phase enclosed bus three-phase short-circuit the value of the electric power and other related parameters.

Author Keywords: the entire company from phase enclosed bus

articleTitle: Further results for the equivalent-input-disturbance approach and application to decoupling control
abstract: This paper extends the equivalent-input-disturbance (EID) approach to handle a non-strictly proper system and applies this method to decoupling control of a multiple-input, multiple-output (MIMO) system. First, the configuration of the control system is constructed, and a stability condition of the system is derived. A design method is developed under the guarantee of the stability condition. Then, the undesirable coupling parts and disturbances in an MIMO system are treated as an integrated disturbance. The disturbance is rejected using the EID approach. Finally, simulations demonstrate that the method achieves good effect for both disturbance rejection and decoupling control.

articleTitle: Dynamic process fault detection based on D-SVDD
abstract: There are dynamic and non-linear characteristics in industrial processes. These features make the faults difficult to be detected. To improve the situation, the dynamic support vector domain description (D-SVDD) is proposed. This method is based on dynamic expanding matrix and the support vector domain description (SVDD). Compared with the traditional support vector domain description method, the new method takes the sequence correlation between variables into account. So it is more suitable for dynamic process data than traditional method. And it builds a more accurate model. First of all, the appropriate number of dynamic steps are chosen and the dynamic augmented matrices are constructed. Then the dynamic augmented matrices are used to calculate the boundary of the minimum hypersphere by means of SVDD. In this way, the distribution range of the data is described. In the end, the monitoring statistics of new samples are calculated. And the monitoring statistics are compared with the control limit obtained in the previous step to determine whether there are faults or not. The proposed method is applied to the Tennessee Eastman Process. The results show that the fault detection effect of D-SVDD has been significantly improved.

articleTitle: A Multi-Objective Feedback Teaching-Learning- Based optimization Algorithm
abstract: In this paper, we propose a multi-objective feedback teaching-learning-based optimization (MOFTLBO) direct at multi-objective optimization. A feedback phase is added after learner phase in view of the mechanism of communications between teachers and learners, which increases the learning style of learners as well as the global search ability of the MOFTLBO algorithm. In the feedback phase, all learners communicate with the teacher according to personal score and the average score, which rapidly improves the individual performance and improves the optimization accuracy of the algorithm. At the same time, the concept of non-dominated sorting and the crowding-distance calculation are adopted to apply the proposed algorithm into multi-objective optimization. Five constrained standard test functions are utilized to simulate the MOFTLBO algorithm and compare with the original algorithm, which testifies the validity of the proposed MOFTLBO algorithm.

articleTitle: Time Prediction of Logistics Distribution Based on BP-SVM
abstract: Logistics distribution Time prediction is considered as an important role in logistics planning, because of the complexity of urban transportation system and the sudden nature of traffic accidents, it is difficult to predict urban logistics distribution time. This paper presents a method for the problem of inaccurate prediction of logistics vehicle distribution time. Based on the static characteristics of urban traffic (date, weather, time period, etc.) and the dynamic characteristics of vehicle operation (average speed of front car), this method establishes two predictive models of SVM and BP Neural network, and distributes the weight of two predictive models through the variance-weight allocation method, gets the combined prediction value. The combined prediction results are compared with the predicted results of a single model. Experimental results show that the combined prediction improves the prediction efficiency, can effectively deal with the unexpected situation, and enhances the adaptability of the prediction model.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing Image Scene Classification Based on Combining Multiple Features
abstract: Aiming at the problem that single feature cannot fully express remote sensing scene images, this paper proposes a classification method combining multiple features. Image depth features are extracted by convolutional neural network, and combined with PHOG features. The combined features are classified by random forest classifier. Experiments were carried out on UCM Land-Use and NWPU-RESISC45 of remote sensing image data sets, and the classification accuracy reached 99.29% and 94.63%, respectively, which improved the classification accuracy compared with other existing methods.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy Multi Objective Unit Commitment Model Based Source Grid Load Interaction
abstract: In this paper, a fuzzy multi objective unit commitment model based on source grid load interaction is introduced. This model fully considers the interaction between economic and environmental indicators; the model also studies the power interaction between supply and demand. In addition, the modeling method based on the niche genetic particle swarm optimization algorithm is given and the satisfaction model of three indexes is built, which are economy, environment and demand response. MATLAB simulation was used to verify the effectiveness of the model and algorithm. The results show that the unit combination scheme obtained by this model can effectively complete the triple optimization which is an optimum plan in economy, environment and user satisfaction optimization. It also shows that the interaction of source grid load has great significance on the economic and environmental aspects in the process of power grid optimization.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Simulation Platform for Analog Circuits Based on SimElectronics
abstract: A virtual simulation experimental platform based on Simulink/SimElectronics is designed and implemented to improve the learning effect and scientific research efficiency for students, so that simulation of various analog circuits can be completed by MATLAB, the commonly used software. The method and process of simulation experiment on the platform are shown through the example of a negative feedback amplifier. The experiment can simulate the actual situation of the circuit and the data and signal waveforms of quiescent and dynamic operation analysis can be achieved, the influence of negative feedback to the circuit performance are verified just as the theoretical analysis. The results show that the process of simulation based on this platform is the same with that of actual hardware experiments with clear, visual and accurate results. This kind of experiment also can reduce the cost and improve experiment flexibility.

articleTitle: Individual Travel Transportation Modes Identification Based on Deep Learning Algorithm of Attention Mechanism
abstract: This paper proposes a novel deep learning method to identify individual travel modes. Firstly, in order to capture the key trajectory characteristics, based on the individual travel GPS trajectory data collected by smartphone APP, this paper applies Attention Mechanism to assign different weights to different parts of the trajectory data. Secondly, by combining convolutional neural network(CNN) with attention mechanism based BiLSTM network, a deep learning method is proposed to identify individual travel modes. In order to verify the effectiveness of this method, five other deep learning approaches were tested simultaneously. Finally, the results show that ABLCNN method can identify four transportation modes more effectively and accurately: car, bus, walking and bicycle.

articleTitle: Simulation of Sliding Mode Control for PMSM on Account of Variable Exponential Approach Law
abstract: Aiming at such control requirements of the permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) as smooth accurate speed regulation and anti-interference in integrated injection molding machine, a SMC method on account of variable exponential approach law is put forward in this paper. It is applied to the speed loop of the PMSM servo system. Firstly, the sliding mode speed controller on account of variable exponential approach law is design. Then, the sliding mode speed controller of PMSM servo system is implemented. Finally, the simulation is performed by MATLAB. The simulation results prove that the method is more effective and suppresses the chattering of sliding mode control, improving the dynamic quality and robustness of the PMSM servo system.

articleTitle: A New GPS/BDS precise point positioning Algorithm Based on Helmet Posteriori Method
abstract: The precise point positioning(PPP) based on GPS takes about 30 minutes to obtain centimeter-level accuracy. The accuracy of positioning is also subject to the number of satellites. In this paper, we firstly realize the PPP based on Beidou satellite navigation system(BDS). Secondly, we use the Helmet posteriori weighting method to establish a stochastic model, and set up a whole PPP system of GPS and BDS. By using the combined observations of BDS/GPS, the number of visible satellites is increased, which ameliorates the result of PPP in complex environments. The system is used to make a solution of PPP for eight observing stations distributed around the world. The result of PPP based on the ambiguity fixed solution is better than the result based on the ambiguity floating solution. Compared with single system PPP, dual-system PPP performs better in speed of convergence and accuracy of positioning. The error in the E and N directions is less than 1cm.

articleTitle: Driver Design for High Frequency Servomotor of Soft Magnetic Composite Material
abstract: Design of High Frequency Servo Motor Driver Based on Soft Magnetic Composite MaterialPermanent magnet brushless AC servo motor based on Soft Magnetic Composite (SMC) is superior to laminated silicon steel motor at high frequency (near 1000Hz), but this brings the challenges of its servo drive dynamic response speed and power consumption. In view of this problem, this paper will study the high-frequency motor controller based on soft magnetic composite material. The controller power board adopts aluminum substrate structure with multiple MOSFETs in parallel. In order to reduce the switching loss of the power tube in the chopper process, a vector control algorithm and a current decoupling control algorithm are designed. Firstly, the power generation test of the motor using soft magnetic composite material proves that the motor has good performance, and then the motor is tested with the designed controller. It proves that the controller can guarantee the normal operation of the SMC permanent magnet brushless AC servo motor and has higher efficiency.

articleTitle: Study on Human Simulated Operation and Intelligent Optimization Method of Mechanism Mathematical Model
abstract: It is a heavy workload in modeling for thermal equipment, and the parameter adjustment is usually repetitive. In order to improve the parameter debugging efficiency, a human simulated operation and optimization method is proposed based on virtual operation robot. On the platform of simulation support system (independent software), the simulation modeling and optimization process of designers are analyzed. The virtual operation robot is designed to simulate the designer's action in parameter adjustment, such as mouse and keyboard input. PSO algorithm is applied to get the best value of model parameters, its target is to minimize model error. This method is adopted to optimize model parameters of superheated steam system in power plant. The results show that the model error meets the specified requirements, and the parameter adjustment is done automatically during the process of model error calculation, computing new parameters and inputting parameters into model. It is a new human simulated operation and intelligent optimization method in model parameter adjustment, which realizes the automatic parameters optimization on independent software platform. It is able to replaces repetitive work of designer to some extent and reduces designer's workload.

articleTitle: A Method to Velocity Measurement of Clouds Based on Genetic Algorithm Threshold Segmentation
abstract: Aiming at the problem of cloud coverage over the heliostats field of solar power tower plant, a velocity measurement method for predicting the moving cloud over the heliostats field is proposed. The image of the moving cloud layer is taken by the camera, which is treated by a series of image processing methods such as threshold segmentation, morphological operation and rectangular contour marking to obtain the central coordinate of the moving target. The speed and direction of the moving cloud layer are gotten according to the coordinates of the acquired center point through the calculation formula. The experimental results show that the method is effective with higher accuracy and less calculation, providing an effective and reasonable application scheme for solar thermal power generation technology.

articleTitle: Prediction of college students’ physique based on support vector regression
abstract: In order to further strengthen physical education in colleges and universities, timely monitoring of prediction of college students’ physique has become a very important task. In this paper, a prediction method based on support vector regression (SVR) is proposed to predict the college students’ physical measurement data. Firstly, according to the gender and class characteristics of college students, the physical measurement data of college students are classified. Pearson correlation coefficient is used to analyze the characteristics of college students’ physical measurement data. Then, the physical characteristics of college students are extracted. A SVR-based prediction model of college students’ physical indicators is established. It can predict the individual index data of college students’ physical measurement data. Lastly, the validity of the prediction model is verified by the simulation of a college student sports test data.

articleTitle: Self-tuning Incremental Kalman Filter under Poor Observation Condition
abstract: Under poor observation condition, a single-sensor self-tuning incremental Kalman filter is proposed for the incremental system with unknown model parameters, and its convergence is proved by the dynamic error system analysis (DESA) method. As an application in signal processing, three algorithms for estimating the parameters of autoregressive (AR) signal model based on incremental model are proposed for AR signals with white noise. Based on this, a self-tuning incremental Kalman filter for AR signals is proposed. A simulation example proves its effectiveness and feasibility.

articleTitle: Modelling of gas turbine via discrete state-space neural networks
abstract: In this paper, one kind of multivariate system identification algorithm based discrete state-space neural network (DSSNN) is presented for modelling gas turbine systems with non-Gaussian disturbances. An improved performance index is proposed to train DSSNNs by using Survival Information Potential (SIP) of identification errors. Compared with the traditional Mean Square Error (MSE) based identification algorithm, simulation results demonstrate that the proposed system identification algorithm can obtain better model for 8OkW gas turbine.

articleTitle: Singular value decomposition based functional link learning machine and its application to process modeling
abstract: Process modeling plays a very important role in process system engineering. However, it is more and more difficult to develop an accurate model for a complex chemical process due to the highly nonlinear and complicated process data. For the purpose of handling this problem, an improved functional link learning machine using singular value decomposition (SVD-FLLM) is presented to develop accurate models for complex chemical processes. In the proposed SVD-FLLM model, singular value decomposition is adopted to reduce the expanded variable dimension. Then, the least square algorithm is used to build a regression model between the reduced outputs and the expected vectors. For the sake of validating the testing effectiveness of the proposed SVD-FLLM method, a UCI dataset named Airfoil Self-Noise is first selected. Then the proposed SVD-FLLM is used to develop a model for an actual complex chemical system. Simulation results indicate that, compared the traditional functional link neural network (FLNN), the improved SVD-FLLM can achieve higher accuracy and faster convergence.

articleTitle: State estimation of unmanned vehicles in GPS restricted environment
abstract: In this paper, the Extended Kalman Filter(EKF) navigation algorithm method is presented using the data of the inertial measurement unit(IMU) and the encoder aiming at a situation that the external sensors (such as laser, GPS, ultrasonic, etc.) are not available. The IMU mounted on the vehicle is a nine-axis inertial navigation that provides measurements of acceleration and angular velocity. The encoders mounted on the four wheels provides the speed measurement of the each wheel. This experiment is implemented on the (robotic operation system(ROS), and the data of the vehicle is obtained from ROS nodes. Compared with the traditional GPS or laser positioning methods, the EKF navigation algorithm reduces the cost of equipment and can be applied to GPS and lidar positioning failure scenarios. The experiment compares the actual trajectory of the vehicle with the predicted position and orientation of the navigation algorithm, illustrates the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Steering Law of Control Moment Gyros for Reducing Singularity Measure Conservativeness
abstract: The two main types of real-time computational steering laws of control moment gyros (CMG), including null motion and singular robust (SR) inverse methods, have their deficiencies and limitations. A novel steering law is proposed to reduce further the conservativeness of singularity measure based on gimbal angle combination. Based on SR steering logics, the angle between commanded control torque and the singular vector is considered to determine the magnitude of the introduced error, thereby reducing the unnecessary torque error. And by introducing an additional term in the gimbal rate command, the CMG cluster is always driven to track the desired torque as much as possible. Several numerical simulations including comparisons with existing steering laws are presented to demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimization of Sintering Ratio Control Based on Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
abstract: In an ironmaking sintering production process, the accuracy and consuming time of sintering raw material ratio control determine the sintering production efficiency and finished product quality. An optimization of sintering ratio control based on improved ant colony algorithm is proposed. It is fused by the strong search function characteristics of beetle antennae search (BAS) algorithm in the early stage, and then the timeliness of the sintering ratio control process with fused ant colony algorithm is improved. By using the matching process data collected by a sintering raw material ratio control experiment system, comparative analysis between traditional ant colony algorithm and BAS algorithm is carried out. The simulation results of improved particle swarm optimization, BAS algorithm, linear programming algorithm, fuzzy control method, ACO algorithm and fusion algorithm show that the fusion algorithm has higher matching accuracy and shorter matching time after 50 iteration searches, which indicates that the fusion algorithm is superior to the algorithm in matching accuracy and matching time.

articleTitle: Two-stage Production Scheduling Model Based on Nested Ant Colony Algorithm
abstract: The problem of scheduling has always been a hot topic of people's research. Reasonable scheduling often saves a lot of time and money. In this paper, an improved two-stage model is established for an artifact sorting problem with some constraints, and the nested ant colony algorithm is used to solve it. The results show that the model can improve the speed of sorting and has great advantages in practical application.

articleTitle: Adaptive classification in EMG pattern recognition for myoelectric control
abstract: Myoelectric control based on pattern recognition technology is largely influenced by intrinsic and extrinsic factors over time in practical application, which often result in performance degradation. The aim of this study is to develop an adaptive classification scheme based on linear discriminant analysis (LDA) for myoelectric control system. The proposed adaptive LDA classifier based on training dataset selection and probability weighting is applied to improve the performance of myoelectric control system in changing environment. Preliminary study on the long-term use in real clinical implementation is conducted to verify the performance of proposed adaptive LDA classifier. The correct recognition rates of motion recognition of the proposed LDA classifier and conventional LDA classifier are compared. The experimental results show that compared with the conventional LDA, the proposed LDA significantly improves the classifier performance. Experiment results show the proposed scheme is a practical approach for developing myoelectric control systems with strong robustness.

articleTitle: A View-invariant Skeleton Map with 3DCNN for Action Recognition
abstract: Skeleton based human action recognition is a challenging task in the field of computer vision, which is easily affected by variant camera viewpoint. A novel view-invariant feature is proposed in this paper. We encode the spatial-temporal information of skeleton joint points sequences into a view-invariant skeleton map (VISM), and employ a 3D convolutional neural network (3DCNN) to exploit features from VISM for 3D action recognition. Experimental results on the NTU RGB+D dataset have demonstrated the efficacy of the proposed method, and the robust to the variant viewpoint problem.

articleTitle: Integer programming model for two-dimensional cutting problem of plank
abstract: Plank Cutting Problem is a classic case of the two-dimensional shearing problem, which has broad application prospects in real life. In this paper, the integer programming model in the plank cutting problem is established, and the verification calculation is carried out by the example in the practical production. Using the LINGO solution, the global optimal solution can be obtained under various constraints.

articleTitle: Research on online calibration system based on ABB industrial robot
abstract: ABB robot is used as the main body to construct a high-precision online calibration system for the inefficiency caused by the traditional programming robot field programming operation, the workpiece calibration offset during operation and personal safety. ABB industrial robots have a powerful secondary development function package, so that users do not need to understand the internal structure and principle of the robot, they can write code according to the software function package to remotely control the robot to perform online coordinate offset correction. In the C# environment, the PC SDK library file provided by ABB robot is called to complete the function module programming of the human-computer interaction interface, solve the coordinate offset correction problem in the current remote control robot process, and realize the remote network control of the robot, real-time data reading. Take, on-site safety monitoring, provide technical support for robot programming in the actual factory production process.

articleTitle: Flexible Generator: Synchronous Generator Enhanced by Energy Storage System
abstract: Thanks to its rapidity and controllability, energy storage system (ESS) has participated in the grid frequency control and assisted synchronous generator (SG) in improving systems stability. In this paper, a control strategy that integrates one SG and ESS as one single generation unit named flexible generator (FG) is proposed, allowing ESS to participate in primary frequency control. FG can avoid the problem caused by lumped ESS's bidirectional power flow. The main novelty is that the proposed flexible control adopts SG's frequency together with FG's total output power to control FG's ESS. The dynamic model of FGs which have more substantial damping and stability is derived so that FGs can be analyzed and applied directly by the legacy power grid. Simulation results of a simple two FGs system demonstrate control terms of the proposed flexible control. Simulation results of the Western System Coordinated Council (WSCC) standard 9-bus system verify advantages of FGs both in load changes and faults.

articleTitle: Tropical Cyclone Risk Assessment Based on Information Diffusion Theory
abstract: Tropical cyclones and other meteorological disasters are often accompanied by wind, rain, waves and storm surges, which will also cause serious geological disasters such as landslides and debris flows, bringing huge economic losses to the country and people. Therefore, risk assessment of tropical cyclones has become a research topic of many scholars. This study collected the best path data of CMA tropical cyclone and based on the information diffusion theory. The risk assessment model was established to effectively assess the risks caused by tropical cyclones in coastal provinces. The results of this study can provide some scientific basis for the prevention of tropical cyclone disasters in China.

articleTitle: Image matching algorithm based on optimal sampling RANSAC
abstract: The paper proposes an image matching algorithm based on optimal sampling random sample consensus (OSRANSAC) to handle the shortcoming (eg. high computational costs and poor system performance) for visual positioning system. Scale-invariant feature transform (SIFT) algorithm is used to extract feature points and generate feature descriptors, Meanwhile, the fast approximate nearest neighbor algorithm is adopted to complete rough matching of feature points. In order to reduce the number of iterations, we employ in cross-combination resampling algorithm to calculate model parameters by the new selected sample set, and apply pre-test method to choose the best model parameters. Simulation results confirm the superiority of the proposed methods in comparison with classic ones in terms of the accuracy rate and real-time performance.

articleTitle: Research on Vehicle Routing Problem Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
abstract: Considering the impact of the complexity and dynamics of urban traffic network on vehicle route problem of urban logistics distribution, this paper puts forward a two-stage service model of vehicle route problem. This model takes into consideration the influence of actual traffic flow on driving speed, differentiates the driving speed of different sections in respective time periods, as well as establishes a static vehicle path planning model. Gauss function has been applied in fitting the travel time of vehicles in the actual road network, to get the road travel time function. The genetic algorithm is the solution of the problem, which is verified by the example data. The experiment show that the improved algorithm can better reduce the time of path planning.

articleTitle: Integration of Optimal Experimental Design and Process Optimisation to An Enzyme Reaction System
abstract: A multi-objective experimental design strategy is proposed for a kinetically controlled synthesis process system by considering both the parameter estimation and the desired production yield. The input design is focused on maximising the desired production yield while the observation design is aimed at minimising the parameter estimation uncertainties. This multi-objective experimental design strategy is compared with the integrated experimental design method in which all design factors are optimised to improve parameter estimation quality. The optimal experimental design (OED) problem for observation design is relaxed to a semi-definite programming problem which is solved via interior-point method. Numerical studies demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed OED strategy as well as keeping high production yield. Parameter estimation uncertainties have been reduced significantly and they are near to those from integrated experimental design. The main point of this work is to introduce the idea of combining process optimisation with system identification so that the proposed model is closer to the real operation conditions in chemical processes.

articleTitle: Disturbance observer design for nonaffine nonlinear systems with possibly unbounded or non-differentiable conditions
abstract: A novel adaptive disturbance observer design method is presented for a class of nonaffine nonlinear systems in the presence of disturbances possibly being unbounded or non-differentiable. Sliding mode differentiator is constructively introduced to estimate the compound disturbance without any prior knowledge. The general assumption needed for the traditional method dealt with the nonaffine functions is relaxed and meanwhile, the restrictive assumption is removed so that the compound disturbance is no longer necessarily to be bounded or differentiable. The tracking error can be render to arbitrarily small through stability proof and meanwhile, the tracking performance can be guaranteed. Finally, simulation result is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of designed approach.

articleTitle: Random forest-compressed sensing method for pulsar recognition
abstract: For the pulsar recognition, there are several problems such as large data volume, high feature dimension, large computational complexity and low recognition rate. A random forest-compressed sensing method for pulsar recognition is developed. Compressed sensing can achieve the fast compression of the raw pulsar data. And random forest has a good classification capability. In this paper, the random forest algorithm is used as the reconstruction algorithm in compressed sensing. Based on their advantages, a random forest-compressed sensing algorithm is developed to apply in the pulsar recognition. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional pulsar recognition algorithms, the proposed algorithm has a higher recognition rate and a smaller computational complexity.

articleTitle: PI Observer Design in Second-order DLS
abstract: A kind of proportional-integral (PI) observer for second-order descriptor linear system (DLS) is introduced. A parametric method for the observer design problem is presented based on the general solution to second-order Sylvester matrix equation (SME). This method not only provides the parametric expressions of the gain matrices and the corresponding finite left eigenvector matrix, but also ensures the regularity and impulse-freeness of the expanded error system. A numerical example is given to explain the process and clarify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Extended Kalman Filter for Non-Gravitational Acceleration Elimination in AHRS
abstract: Attitude and heading reference system (AHRS) is ubiquitous in the navigation system. Generally, quaternion-based extended Kalman filter (QEKF) is applied to implement attitude estimation by integrating data collected from gyroscopes, accelerometers, and magnetometers. However, accelerometers are sensitive to both gravity and external acceleration, which will reduce the performance of QEKF in dynamic conditions. In order to improve accuracy of attitude estimation, we propose a novel algorithm for non-gravitational acceleration elimination in AHRS. The algorithm detects whether there exists external acceleration which can be used flexibly in a variety of dynamic situations, and then adaptively adjust the noise variance of the extended Kalman filter for compensate external acceleration under dynamic conditions. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm achieve small average estimation error when compared to standard EKF and the state-of-the-art attitude estimation algorithm in the scenario existing non-gravitational acceleration.

articleTitle: Improvement of Speech Preprocessing Model Based on Linear Prediction
abstract: With the rapid development of information society and communication technology, human-computer interaction becomes more and more important. Therefore, the recognition rate of speech signal becomes the target that people pursue. Speech preprocessing plays an important role in achieving this goal. In this paper,we firstly analyze the conventional linear prediction model and propose a new speech signal regression linear prediction model based on the linear prediction model algorithm, Type by regression forecasting model to forecast the speech signal processing, can more quickly identity, by the MATLAB simulation results show that the new type regression forecasting model performance than conventional linear prediction model is nearly 200 ms of acceleration performance, and greater effectiveness of improved prediction model, namely the pitch detection in the detection performance of speech waveform change processing, greatly improves the speech recognition rate.

articleTitle: State evaluation of energy storage capacitors for maglev train’s levitation chopper
abstract: The energy storage capacitor is the key component of the levitation chopper in the maglev train, and its state is related to the safe and stable operation of the maglev train. Based on the operating principle of the levitation chopper, this paper analyzes the main degradation mechanism of the storage capacitor, selects the capacitance capacity and the equivalent series resistance as the characteristic parameters, and proposes a state evaluation method of energy-storage capacitor based on the neural network. The capacity of the energy-storage capacitor and the equivalent series resistance are identified by the bus voltage, the bus voltage ripple and the load current. The effectiveness of the evaluation method was verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Hybrid control on stability and bifurcation for a single neuron network affected by distributed and leakage delay
abstract: In this paper, a neuron system with leakage and distributed delay is considered. This paper investigates classical dynamical problems such as local stability and Hopf bifurcation. Then, the Hopf bifurcation of the single neuron network is controlled by designed controller. By using the leakage delay as the bifurcation parameter and analyzing the associated characteristic equation, we find that when the bifurcation parameter passes through some critical value, the system come into being a Hopf bifurcation. Besides, by changing parameter of the feedback gain, the position of the bifurcation point can be changed by the controller and desirable dynamics can be achieved. Finally, numerical simulations are given to substantiate the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control-based Path Tracking Using Steering Torque
abstract: Path tracking has become an important obstacle avoidance control method for autonomous vehicles. In this paper, a model predictive control-based path tracking controller is proposed with steering torque as a control input. The reference trajectory is defined on the basis of a sigmoid function. The proposed method integrates the steering model and two-degree-of-freedom bicycle model into a vehicle dynamic model. The integrated model tracks the desired yaw angle and lateral displacement by optimizing the steering torque. Simulation experiments using MATLAB/Simulink and CarSim are conducted to verify the performance of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Optimal control of missile interception process based on adaptive dynamic programming
abstract: An optimal control strategy based on adaptive dynamic programming (ADP) algorithm is proposed for the typical optimal control problem of missile interceptor with control constraints. This method is based on ADP algorithm control architecture and using BP neural network has great advantages in approximating nonlinear systems to approach the cost function and optimal control strategy by on-line iteration. Experimental results show that: Compared with the traditional control policy, this controller improves the control accuracy of missile interception process, and the system robustness is also significantly enhanced, and the control performance is better.

articleTitle: Research on Path optimization Algorithm of the 6-DOF Manipulator
abstract: In order to ensure the continuous change of motor torque in the actual system of the 6-DOF manipulator and reduce the equipment life loss caused by the rigid impact at the joint of the manipulator, an improved trajectory planning method is proposed in this paper to improve the pulsation characteristics during the movement of the manipulator. The space-optimized 7-5-7 polynomial interpolation method is used in the joint space for trajectory planning, and the trajectory reprocessing is performed near the switching point. The simulation results show that the optimized motion path of the manipulator not only reduces the mutation of the angular position curve near the original switching point, but also optimizes the velocity, acceleration and pulsation characteristics.

articleTitle: Robust Adaptive Consensus for Multi-agent Systems Subject to Saturation Constraints
abstract: In this note, a type of consensus control problem of multi-agent systems (MASs) subject to saturation constraints has been investigated. In the design of robust adaptive consensus schemes, the actuator and system state saturation are considered simultaneously, and this idea is different from that in this literature and much more suitable for practical application. Under the proposed adaptive parameter design protocol for consensus schemes, the undirected MASs with fixed and switching topology are analyzed, respectively. Illustrative example are taken to verify the proposed schemes.

articleTitle: Command Filter-Based Backstepping Sliding mode Control for the Position tracking of the AC Asynchronous Motor Using Disturbance Observer
abstract: In order to improve the position tracking control performance of the alternating current (AC) asynchronous motor under the uncertainties caused by parameter perturbations and load disturbance, a command filter-based backstepping sliding mode control strategy is proposed using nonlinear disturbance observers (NDOs). Firstly, NDOs are designed to observe the system uncertainties, which improve the position tracking control precision of the system effectively. Secondly, the rotor flux linkage-oriented vector control scheme is adopted, and the backstepping sliding mode controllers are designed for the position subsystem and the flux linkage subsystem, respectively, which improve the dynamic and static performance and the robust stability of the system effectively. Besides, during the design processes of backstepping sliding mode controllers, command filters are adopted to estimate the virtual control inputs and their first time derivatives, which eliminate the “explosion of complexity” problem. Theoretical analysis shows that the resulting closed-loop system is bounded stability. Finally, simulation results show the superiority of the proposed control strategy in comparison with the proposed strategy without NDOs and the command filter-based backstepping control strategy.

articleTitle: Design of Pouring Cup Liquid Level Control System in Sand Casting
abstract: In this paper, aiming at the low degree of automation of the sand casting in gravity casting, the mathematical modeling and simulation of the pouring part of the plug-in casting machine is carried out, and the control of the bottom-injection casting machine based on machine vision is designed. System-The closed-loop gating system controlled by PID is obtained by obtaining the ratio of the area of high-temperature molten iron in the sand-type pouring cup to the total area of the pouring cup. The hardware platform was built, and the solution for automatic control of the pouring cup liquid level in the sand casting was given, which greatly reduced the labor of the workers and improved the production efficiency of the sand casting.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Affecting the Gain Pattern of Phased Array Antenna
abstract: In recent years, with the development of ultra-high speed aircraft, rocket, missile and artificial earth satellite technology, higher requirement have been put forward for radar's coverage of airspace, target tracking ability and multi-target tracking technology. Phased array radar has gradually replaced the traditional mechanical scanning radar due to its excellent tracking performance, which plays an important role in more specific fields. In this paper, the influence of different factors on the gain pattern of phased array antenna is analyzed in detail using theoretical calculation and simulation research methods for several types of phased array antenna. Research shows that the factors such as the number of array elements, the spacing of array elements and the scanning angular position determine the maximum value, main lobe, grating lobe, side lobe and the zero point of the gain pattern. Finally, a parameter calculation scheme is designed, which has certain reference value for the design of phased array antenna.

articleTitle: New Energy Accommodation and Interaction Technology based on Load Sequential Decomposition
abstract: With the large-scale wind power penetration, the power balance of source-grid-load system was changed. For power system operation and control, two kinds of uncertainty and unknown variables appeared in the balance equation, namely large-scale intermittent wind power and load. It's the key of the paper, that the uncertainty load was transparently solved. Firstly, the wind power accommodation capability evaluation was established, the system accommodation capability was quantitative evaluated. The key factors of source-grid-load accommodation were analyzed. Secondly, for interaction load, feature identification function was proposed, the interaction load observer was established; the interaction load controller was established, which consisted of discrimination matrix and peak-valley interaction model. Thirdly, the integral control of interaction load was designed by inner-outer control loop. Based on the actual grid, focusing on source-grid-load coordination and the interaction load response, the effectiveness of the proposed solution measures was verified through simulation.

articleTitle: Dynamic Jump Motion Control of a Jumping Spider Robot with Redundant Degrees of Freedom
abstract: Aiming at the disadvantages of the traditional jumping robot, such as single jumping form and low movement efficiency, a hexapod robot based on jumping spider is constructed, which can realize multi-direction jumping. Firstly, the mechanical structure design of the robot is completed, and then the forward kinematics analysis of the robot is carried out. By combining algebraic and geometric methods, the inverse kinematics model of the legs of the robot with redundant degrees of freedom is established, and the dynamic model is established by Lagrange formula. The dynamic control system was built, and the joint simulation experiment of MATLAB and Adams was finally carried out for the multi-direction jumping movement of the robot. The simulation results are consistent with the expected results.

articleTitle: Benign and Malignant Diagnosis of Hepatocellular Carcinoma on CT Images Based on Fusion Network
abstract: Deep convolution neural network (CNN) is an important technology tool for classification of 3D-CT images. Because the training of 3D-convolution network requires a large number of labeled samples, this study proposes a method of multi-2D-convolution neural network fusion to classify benign and malignant hepatocellular carcinoma 3D-CT images. In view of the characteristics of liver CT images, this study proposes an algorithm of representing 3D-CT images from 2D-images, and then multi-network fusion method is used to distinguish two-dimensional images. In addition, this study, in conjunction with a 3A hospital, contributed a practical diagnostic data set containing more than 7000 samples of CT images of hepatocellular carcinoma. Experimental results on our datasets demonstrate validity of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Three-phase Cascaded quasi-impedance-source AC/AC Converter
abstract: Two kinds of three-phase cascaded quasi-Z-source AC/AC converter topologies are proposed in this paper, which overcome the shortcomings of traditional three-phase chopper controlled AC/AC voltage regulator and three-phase voltage type quasi-Z-source AC/AC converter. Analyze its circuit structure and working principle, The relationship between duty ratio and output voltage, as well as capacitance voltage stress, is derived using Kirchhoff's law and the volt-second balance principle. MATLAB/Simulink is used to simulate the two topologies, Pulse width modulation (PWM) is used to control the duty ratio. Finally, the simulation results verify the correctness and feasibility of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Obstacle Detection and Tracking Method of Unmanned Sailboat Based on Millimeter Wave Radar
abstract: Unmanned sailboats provide a new observation platform for marine environment monitoring. Obstacle detection and tracking is the basis for the independent navigation of unmanned sailboats. Based on the comparison of common obstacle tracking sensors, this paper focuses on the detection and tracking method of unmanned sailing obstacles based on millimeter wave radar. This method can identify obstacles in the detection area and track them. Tracking can provide a basis for autonomous obstacle avoidance planning. The millimeter wave radar detection system is constructed and experiments are carried out. The results show that the method has high recognition accuracy and good tracking effect, which can provide basic information for unmanned sailing obstacle avoidance path planning.

articleTitle: Synchronization Criteria for Delayed Fractional-Order Neural Networks via Linear Feedback Control
abstract: In this paper, the synchronization problem is addressed for delayed fractional-order neural networks (FNNs). First, a simple linear feedback controller is constructed, which is easy to be implemented in practical application. Then, by using appropriate fractional-order Lyapunov functions, fractional Halanay inequality and inequality techniques, two novel synchronization criteria are established, respectively. Numerical examples are finally offered to display the effectiveness of the developed methods.

articleTitle: Wireless Sensor Networks clustering Routing Protocol for Smart grid
abstract: In order to meet the Ubiquitous Power Internet of things (UPI) which can holographic sense power data, a new wireless sensor network(WSN) clustering routing protocol which based on Smart grid is proposed to solve the problem of data loss, retransmission and invalidation in the power communication network of Smart grid. Firstly, the algorithm uses the combination of Quantum optimization algorithm and particle swarm optimization algorithm to construct a network model of dual cluster heads to improve the robustness of the system. Then the adaptive value function of main and sub-cluster heads is optimized to make them cooperate in data fusion and transmission. Finally, a high performance network transmission path selection model is established to select the optimum path and complete the inter-cluster communication. Simulations show that this algorithm can effectively balance the energy consumption of the entire network while improving the real-time performance and reducing the problem of unstable data transmission in power communication network.

articleTitle: A Fully Convolutional Network based on Spatial Attention for Saliency Object Detection
abstract: The performance of the saliency object detection model is suppressed by the false and missed detections in saliency areas. How to effectively reduce the false predictions is an open issue. Unlike existing methods which add hand-craft features or post-processing steps, we propose a novel saliency object detection model based on the fully convolutional network and spatial attention. We first design a branch based on spatial attention which can enable the network to focus on the areas of saliency object. We further design a boundary branch aiming at get accurate object boundaries. Similar to spatial attention branch, we use one-dimensional convolution kernels to capture semantic information in different directions and reduce the number of parameters. We evaluate the model proposed in this paper on four common standard datasets with four common evaluation criteria. Experimental results show that the model we proposed outperforms the state-of-the-arts with less false predictions and accurate object boundaries.

articleTitle: Thrust Allocation for Dynamic Positioning Vessels with Switchboard Power Limit and Diving Forbidden Sectors
abstract: Thrust allocation is a challenging problem for dynamic positioning systems. In the literature, switchboard power limit is usually ignored, and only interact constraints are taken into account for azimuth thrusters. However, in practice, these are not the only constraints to be considered in thrust allocation. In this paper, switchboard power limit and azimuth thruster diving forbidden sectors are considered in addition to the common constraints. Simulation results are given to validate of the method.

articleTitle: Water Quality Monitoring Missing Data Filling Method Based on Improved OCS-FCM
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of filling missing data in water quality monitoring, an improved OCS-FCM (Fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm and Optimal Completion Strategy) method for filling missing data is proposed. The missing values of COD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Mn</sub>, DO, pH and TP measured by water quality monitoring stations in Hangzhou were filled in, and the comparative experiments were carried out in the case of single attribute and multiple attribute missing data set, as well as in the case of different missing rate. The results show that the improved OCS-FCM water quality monitoring missing data filling method with real-time updating membership matrix has better filling accuracy than the similar algorithm in the comparative experiment, especially in the case of high missing rate. In addition, the accuracy of filling missing values in multi-attribute datasets is significantly higher than that in single-attribute datasets. The improved OCS-FCM water quality monitoring missing data filling method has better filling effect to avoid large missing data rate and multi-attribute data sets.

articleTitle: Fully distributed robust consensus of LPV multi-agent systems
abstract: We consider the robust consensus problems of linear parameter varying (LPV) multi-agent systems in this paper. For multiple agents interplay on an undirected graph, sufficient conditions relating to the algebraic connectivity are provided for the robust consensus of the LPV system at first. Then, edge-based adaptive strategy and node-based adaptive one are both introduced to guarantee the robust consensus of the LPV multi-agent systems and simultaneously eliminate the dependence on the algebraic connectivity of the graph. Finally, numerical simulations will be given to prove the feasibility of the theoretical results obtained.

articleTitle: A Web Service and Embedded System Based hand dynamometer for Grip strength Assessment
abstract: Background: Gripping test is an effective evaluation tool for sarcopenia. Various methods for measuring grip strength were developed, however, some of them has certain defects, such as bulkiness, low autonomy. This article describes a new web service and embedded system based hand dynamometer for grip strength testing. Method: to achieve an easy to use, portable, accuracy grip strength dynamometer, a bridge force sensor ZNHM-III is used, the web technology and a STM32 micro-controller are also integrated into the system. After acquisition and preprocessing, the gripping data is sent and saved on the cloud server via the Bluetooth connected mobile phone, which is connected the public communication network. Then the user can check the result through a PC or APP. Results: Twelve healthy volunteers (25 ± 3 years old) participate in the grip strength experiments. All functions of the proposed system were testified, and the measurement results are compared with camry-EH101. The average error and standard deviation of the grip force are 0.187Kg and 0.158, respectively. The average grip strengths for male and female are 33.24kg and 19.2kg in our test, and the measurement variations between the tests are 6kg and 5.5kg, respectively. The results corresponds well to the Chinese youth gripping date from the literature review. Conclusion: The experiment result confirms the proposed dynamometer has good consistency. The proposed system has great potential in hand gripping strength testing.

articleTitle: Subspace method aided fault detection for distributed identical systems
abstract: This paper deals with data-driven subspace identification method based fault detection for homogeneous distributed system. Since there are complex connections between local subsystems of distributed identical systems, the fault detection problem is complex and difficult. To cope with this problem, the basic idea is to divide the spatially lifted large-scale homogeneous distributed systems into some independent subsystems by state, input and output transform. After that, data-driven SIM fault detection method is applied to distributed systems to identify residual generator from converted input and output data. The effectiveness of the proposed fault detection method is verified by a simulation example.

articleTitle: Learning Angular Reconstruction based Binary Descriptor for Face Recognition
abstract: In this work, a simple angular reconstruction based binary descriptor (ARBD) strategy is proposed for face recognition. Compared with previous learning-based hashing methods such as compact binary face descriptor (CBFD) and sparse projection matrix binary descriptor (SPMBD) which measure data similarity with the Euclidean distance, our ARBD focuses on using the cosine similarity to generate binary codes. Specifically, the angular reconstruction term is added to the objective function to minimize the reconstruction error. Furthermore, an efficient algorithm based on the augmented Lagrange method (ALM) is designed to explicitly address the discrete constraint in the Hamming space. We also perform pooling on the learned binary codes with the unsupervised clustering manner to improve their discriminative ability. The results on two face datasets (i.e., CAS-PEAL-R1 and PaSC) demonstrate the superior performance of our ARBD over other existing face recognition methods.

articleTitle: A Method for Massive Scientific Literature Clustering Based on Hadoop
abstract: With the development of science and technology and a large numbers of advanced vocabularies, the traditional classification of disciplines cannot meet the current needs of the subject division of scientific literature. At the same time, the clustering of the scientific literature put forward more requirements to the efficiency of the methods and the corresponding software and hardware facilities. In this paper, text features are extracted based on the TF-IDF method and the features of scientific literature. In Hadoop distributed environment, text clustering is carried out through Canopy-Kmeans algorithm, which achieved clustering of the massive scientific literature. As a result, our method proposed in this paper has improved key indicators compared to previous algorithms and greatly improved the efficiency of clustering.

articleTitle: Reconstruction to Power Quality Disturbance signal based on Iterative-Reweighed-Least-Squares Algorithm
abstract: Reconstruction search algorithm is one of the key problems of compressed sensing. The iterative reweighted least square (IRLS) algorithm is used to reconstruct the power quality disturbance signal. By Relaxing the discontinuity function into a smooth or continuous function, the P0 problem is turned into standard linear algebra and Lagrangian multiplier method. The simulation results show that the IRLS algorithm has similar SNR performance with the widely used Orthogonal Matching Pursuit algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Data Generation Technology of BIM Component Concrete pouring Control
abstract: In order to better promote the automation of production equipment of prefabricated components and provide data support for intelligent grid concreting and concreting path planning, an innovative design method was proposed to convert the BIM model data into the control data of concrete pouring machine path planning. Firstly, the precast concrete data information extraction and transformation in the component model diagram of BIM (building information model) is realized to provide the original data information of the component to the control system of the concrete pouring machine. Then, the movement process of concrete pouring machine is analyzed, and the filling nodes segmented in the plane area of each component are calculated by using the scanning filling principle of computer graphics to determine whether the filling nodes meet the filling requirements, so as to generate the data such as the switching state of the concrete pouring machine outlet, discharging speed, discharging time and earthwork volume. Experimental results show that this method effectively solves the problem of automatic generation of control data of the concrete pouring machine, and greatly improves the concreting efficiency and precision control of the concrete pouring machine. The generation technology of BIM component data to the control data of concrete pouring machine is creatively proposed, which enables the concrete pouring machine control system to quickly, accurately and intelligently realize the process from the analysis of BIM component diagram to the planning of grid concreting and the quality control of concreting process.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Quality Traceability System for Electric Porcelain Production Process
abstract: In view of the current chaotic information management of electric porcelain enterprises and the difficulty in traceability of product quality, this paper developed a quality traceability system based on the production process of electric porcelain enterprises. Collecting information in the production process of electric porcelain through the combination of RFID electronic tags, QR codes and OPC. This paper presents a way of tracing the quality of electric porcelain products so that quality problems in each link can be traced back to the process.Based on this, a quality traceability system based on B/S architecture is developed to integrate the relevant information in the production process into the client interface. Practice has proved that the quality traceability system developed in this paper can find out the quality problems in the production process in time, and effectively improve the production efficiency of electric porcelain enterprises.

articleTitle: Hybrid-Residual-Based Odometry for Camera-LiDAR Systems
abstract: In this paper, we present a hybrid-residual-based odometry approach using observations from a monocular camera and sparse depth information from LiDAR. Our approach takes full advantage of different types of complementary information from both, the image and the laser scan, to build an accurate odometry. The proposed approach utilizes both reprojected and photometric features, where the reprojected residuals and the photometric residuals are jointly minimized. To enhance the accuracy and robustness, the occluded points are explicitly filtered during the odometry process. Experiments are conducted both on real world data and open source datasets to show accuracy and robustness for odometry algorithm. The results suggest that our odometry approach can achieve competitive localization accuracy.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation Analysis of Power assembly of Series Electric Vehicles
abstract: Today, with the deepening of economic globalization, the economic level of the people of the world is constantly improving, and the problems of energy shortage and environmental pollution are becoming more and more prominent. Hybrid vehicles, which appear as substitutes for traditional internal combustion engine vehicles, have gradually become the focus of research and development in the world today. This design, on the basis of the existing models, by retrofitting the generator, motor and battery pack, is converted it into a series hybrid bus, and the parameter design of the power assembly is completed by determining the corresponding parameter matching principle.
