The main idea of sensor fault reconstruction is to introduce an appropriate filter and convert the sensor fault into a fictitious actuator fault form by constructing an augmentation system. Robust sliding mode observer is designed with convex optimization theory and linear matrix inequality (LMI) techniques. The sliding mode motion is maintained via equivalent output control method and the fault information is obtained directly to realize the fault information of the sensor. Finally, taking the parameters of the MMC system model as an example, the effectiveness and reliability of the proposed approach are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: A Finite-time Attitude Stabilization Control Approach for Spacecraft Based on Robust Adaptive Neural Network
abstract: In order to deal with the attitude stabilization control problem of spacecraft, a finite-time control approach based on robust adaptive neural network is developed. In detail, a modified terminal sliding surface is proposed so that singularity problem is avoided. In spacecraft dynamics, all terms except control torque are regarded as total disturbance, which is estimated by three groups of adaptive variables and approximated by Chebyshev neural network. Robust adaptive control and neural network control are connected by a switching function for better control performance and the finite-time attitude stabilization control approach is proposed based on that. Then, the finite-time stability of the controller is proved and finally, some illustrative numerical simulations are carried out to show the performance of the controller. The proposed controller has quick convergence speed and excellent control precision.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Safety and Anti-collision Strategy of Typical Intersection Based on Hazard Cognition
abstract: In order to enable the autonomous vehicle to pass safely through the intersection, this paper proposes an efficient anti-collision strategy of typical intersection based on hazard cognition. Considering the time-varying time-to-collision along the two directions of the intersection, the danger degree of collision between the autonomous vehicle and other vehicles is studied. The fuzzy control strategy is established to realize the collision avoidance function of the autonomous vehicle. This paper considers six conditions of other vehicles at intersection, constructs intersection model and sensor parameters in PreScan, and builds vehicle dynamics model and fuzzy control algorithm in MATLAB/Simulink. The joint simulation results show that even under complex traffic conditions, the autonomous vehicle can effectively avoid collision when the danger occurs, which confirms the proposed algorithm has high reliability.

articleTitle: Intelligent Plant Growth Water Supply System Based on Single-chip Microcomputer
abstract: By analyzing the demand of intelligent plant growth water supply, this paper combines the sensor, LCD display, automatic control principle and single-chip microcomputer control technology, according to the characteristics of plant growth and the needs of the growth process. An intelligent plant growth water supply system based on single-chip microcomputer is designed and developed in combination with real life environment. It can automatically detect the soil moisture and supply water automatically according to the detected humidity condition.

articleTitle: Modified Estimation of Distribution Algorithm for Solving Flow-shop Scheduling Problem with Setup Times
abstract: To solve the flow-shop scheduling problem with sequence dependent setup times, the modified estimation of distribution algorithm was proposed. Considering the setup times dependent on sequence, multi-probability matrixes are employed in the probability model to denote the relative information about jobs in this problem. Meanwhile, the updating mechanism and an automatically adjusting method are improved to adapt to the new probability. A local search is designed to be able to jump out of the local optimum and improve the global optimization ability. Finally, simulation results are compared with other algorithms to demonstrate the effectiveness of the modified EDA.

articleTitle: Event-triggered H∞ filter design for Markovian jump systems Under Unknown Periodic DoS Jamming Attacks
abstract: The problem of filtering design related to Markovian jump systems under unknown periodic Denial-of-Service (DoS) jamming attacks is investigated in this paper. Different from the design of the traditional filter, the effects of the malicious attacks and communication limitations, which appear typically in Markov jump systems, on the performance of a filtering error system are considered. A new dynamic event-triggering communication strategy is introduced to design the aforementioned DoS attacks and resource limitations. Then, the equation of the filter is established as a switching model. It considered the influences of the event-triggering mechanism and DoS signal at the same time. With the above derivation, sufficient conditions are formulated according to linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) for achieving the exponential mean-square stability (EMSS) and the stability of the filter equation under DoS attacks. Then the linear solution of the above model under different modes is obtained by LMI method. Finally, a numerical example is used to prove the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed theoretical method.

articleTitle: Conservative Policy Gradient in Multi-critic Setting
abstract: Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic policy gradient algorithm (TD3) addressed the overestimation bias problem by adopting a clipped Double Q-Learning method. As the two Q networks are different, the updation of a policy to maximize one Q function might minimize another, which is called inconsistency in this paper. Therefore, we propose an algorithm based on TD3, conservative policy gradient (CPG), that optimizes the policy with respect to the lower bound of the two Q functions to deal with the inconsistancy. In Q function learning, one-step estimate is usually used in target value estimation. However, due to the constantly changing target networks, there will be fluctuations in the estimation. As the target Q function is changing slowly, we combine the one-step estimate with zero-step estimate to avoid sharp changes. The experimental results illustrate that CPG outperforms TD3 and some other reinforcement learning methods on multiple MuJoCo benchmarks.

articleTitle: Design of Weight Matrices for Echo State Networks With Truncated Singular Values
abstract: As a special recurrent neural network, Echo State Network (ESN) has succeed best in the field of nonlinear time series prediction. The key part of ESN is a sparsely and randomly connected recurrent layer (reservoir) which leads to a large and sparse random weight matrix. However, sparse random weight matrices have too small singular values, which may cause the poor performance of ESNs. In order to solve the mentioned problem, this paper proposed a way to construct the reservoir weight matrices for ESNs using the truncated singular values. First, a sparse random weight matrix is generated under some given probability distribution. Second, replace the smaller singular values of the reservoir weight matrix with some larger ones. Third, the weight matrix is changed to the new one with the truncated singular values. Finally, the proposed method is valued on benchmark problems and the simulation results shows its super performance.

articleTitle: Monocular Visual Odometry Using Unsupervised Deep Learning
abstract: This paper proposes a new monocular visual odometry system based on unsupervised deep learning that can simultaneously estimate the relative 6-DoF (degree of freedom) poses and scene depth of monocular cameras from sequences of images. It jointly trains depth maps and relative camera poses without ground truth. The depth model uses the encoder-decoder architecture and the pose model uses RCNN (Recurrent Convolutional Neural Network) with attention mechanism innovatively. The system is trained by using stereo images and tested by using monocular images. Experiments show that this unsupervised monocular visual odometry system doesn't suffer from the scale ambiguity of monocular visual odometry and it outperforms some state of the art approaches.

articleTitle: Multi-carrier Differential Chaos Shift Keying Wireless Communication Based On Chaotic Shape-forming Filter
abstract: In recent years, chaotic communication has shown advantages, such as used the simplest matched filter to make signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) maximization and improve the resistance to multi-path interference. The chaotic shape-forming filter (CSF) has been proposed to generate the chaotic baseband signal in the wireless communication, the additional advantage of the chaotic shape-forming filter is able to generate the chaotic signal as spread sequence in Differential Chaotic Shift Key (DCSK), which encodes information in the sequence. In this paper, the chaotic signal generated by CSF is used in DCSK and combined with multi-carrier frequency to improve the bit transmission rate. Because of CSF used, it helps to improve both Bit Error Rate (BER) performance and provide an additional information flow in the spread sequence itself. Simulation results indicate that the proposed method is superior to other methods over the Addition White Gaussian Noise (AWGN) channel and wireless channel.

articleTitle: Research On Underwater Multi-clutter Data Association Based On Fuzzy Clustering
abstract: In this paper, a multi-target tracking association algorithm based on fuzzy clustering is proposed to cope with the multi-clutter phenomenon and large measurement error in underwater environment. The algorithm obtains the membership degree of each measurement to the clustering center point by using the Fuzzy Clustering (FCM) algorithm, and then weights the associated measurement values as a weight coefficient. Finally, the Kalman filter algorithm is used to obtain the estimated value of the state, so that multiple targets can be tracked. Simulation results show that the traditional algorithm is easy to generate false alarms or even filter divergence in the multi-clutter environment. However, the algorithm proposed in this paper takes all the measured values falling within the tracking gate into account, which greatly improves the tracking accuracy and stability. So that our method can be applied to actual engineering projects.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection of Industrial Control System Based on Stacked Auto-Encoder
abstract: With the deep integration of industrial control systems and Internet technologies, how to effectively detect whether industrial control systems are threatened by intrusion is a difficult problem in industrial security research. Aiming at the difficulty of high dimensionality and non-linearity of industrial control system network data, the stacked auto-encoder is used to extract the network data features, and the multi-classification support vector machine is used for classification. The research results show that the accuracy of the intrusion detection model reaches 95.8%.

articleTitle: Energy Management Strategy of CAES-BS-SC Hybrid Energy Storage System Based on EEMD
abstract: The inherent multi-time-scale fluctuation of renewable energy is the main reason that restricts its large-scale application. In order to improve the overall economic benefit and energy efficiency of the energy storage system. This paper proposes a hybrid energy storage system with compressed air energy storage, battery and supercapacitor. Firstly, analyzes the characteristics of supercapacitors and batteries, and the cooling and heating effects of compressed air system are also analyzed. Secondly, the energy management strategy of hybrid energy storage system using active energy storage strategy is studied. Using extreme leaning machine (ELM) to predict the distribute energy power generation in long time scale and determine the target power of HESS. EEMD method is used to distribute the target power of compressed air, battery and supercapacitor, then according to the constraints of energy storage frequency range, power range, state of energy and other conditions to select the optimal demarcation frequency. Finally, simulation, comparison and analysis are carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis and Verification of Influence Factors for Synchronization Precision of TTE
abstract: Time-triggered Ethernet (TTE) provides the solution for scenarios with high reliability requirements, which takes into account high bandwidth and compatibility of Ethernet as well as time-triggered network's high deterministic and real-time characteristics. Clock synchronization is the basis of reliability and real-time characteristic of TTE. This paper analyzes the factors affecting the synchronization precision of TTE network and simulates them with OPNET software. The simulation results show that the errors from transparent clock recording, stability and precision of crystal vibration will make the synchronization precision lower. The improved synchronization algorithm can suppress the influence of errors to some extent and keep the synchronization precision at a high level.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Robust H∞ Control For Ship Course Control System With Time-varying Uncertain Parameters
abstract: In this article, the nonlinear robust H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> control is investigated for ship course control system with time-varying uncertain parameters and external disturbance. Firstly, we suppose that both the parameters and its derivatives of system are unknown but within some ranges, due to the effect of different conditions such as the speed, loading of ship. Sequently, the ship course system is modeled as a polynomial one with time variant polytopic uncertainties. With the aid of parameter dependent Lyapunov function method and positive polynomial theory, the sufficient conditions are given for stability and stabilization with H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance. These conditions are formulated in terms of parameter-dependent nonlinear matrix inequalities which can be verified by semidefinite programming relaxations based on the sum of squares technique(SOS). Finally, simulation results show the effectiveness of the approach.

articleTitle: The design of controller in permanent magnet linear synchronous motor
abstract: In this paper, the q-d axis currents in the vector control of permanent magnet synchronous linear motor are coupled with each other, which affects the control performance of the motor. By establishing a model of permanent magnet synchronous linear motor and analyzing the coupling reasons, a feedforward decoupling method is proposed to realize the current control of motor. On this basis, an anti-saturation integration algorithm is proposed to solve the saturation integral problem in motor speed-loop control. The system simulation results show that the decoupling current control performance is significantly improved, and the speed response performance is good.

articleTitle: Design and Preliminary Implementation of Distributed Control System for Pipeline Detection Serpentine Robot Based on CAN Bus
abstract: Based on STM32F103 microcontroller, the design of the master-slave distributed control system of snake-like robot for pipeline detection is completed in this paper. Firstly, the application purpose and environment of snake-like robot are analyzed in detail, and then a master-slave distributed control system of snake-like robot based on CAN bus is built. Finally, through testing, the motion control of snake-like robot is preliminarily realized.

articleTitle: A Knowledge Discovery Method for Characteristics Extraction of Power Consumption Based on Cluster Analysis
abstract: Remote cost control is a new type of cost control that comes along with the construction of integrated service platform in power supply enterprises. It manages cost control information in a centralized way. However, the application of cost control strategy in remote cost control mode faces weak user-targeting of cost control strategy. To solve the problem mentioned above, we propose a knowledge discovery method for characteristics extraction of power consumption based on cluster analysis. The data of users' historical power consumption is modeled as matrix object set. K-means algorithm and matrix theory are adopted to obtain the similarity of two matrix by calculating the Euclidean norm of their differences. Moreover, the fine granularity classification of the types of users' power consumption characteristic is carried out. Finally, the effectiveness of the method is verified by using four individual-to-whole approaches.

articleTitle: Research of Model Reference Attack Angle Control Based on BP Natural Network
abstract: In this paper, the well-known design framework of model reference adaptive control is adopted to construct the adaptive attack angle controller of aircraft, where all the parameters of PID controller are adjusted by BP neural network. By using the reference model output and the actual object output as training signals, all the weights of the three-layer BP neural network are updated. The simulation results present that, the parameters of the PID controller can be adjusted autonomously by applying the BP neural network to the attack angle control system of the aircraft, which shows the excellent approximation property of the BP neural network. At the same time, the control scheme improves the performance indices of the aircraft attitude control system and also enhances the intelligent level of engineering design.

articleTitle: Measurement of Tree Barriers on Transmission Line Based on Binocular Vision and Steger Algorithm
abstract: The accurate and efficient measurement between the wire and the tree canopy can effectively prevent the vegetation-related failures and ensure the safe and stable operation of the power system. With regard to the difficulty in measuring the tree barriers in a power corridor, a method based on binocular vision is proposed. Based on Steger algorithm, an automatic detection algorithm is designed in this method, which can be used to automatically extract the center line of overhead power line and its pixel coordinates; based on the principle of binocular vision, the three-dimensional coordinates of the overhead power line and the contour line of the tree canopy are obtained respectively by the stereo matching algorithm, and then the values of the tree barrier are calculated. The experimental results show that the automatic measurement of the barrier value of the transmission line can be preliminarily realized with this algorithm, with the measurement error being within ±15cm.

articleTitle: Region of Interest Prediction Method under Dynamic Characteristics of Vehicles
abstract: This paper proposes a region of interest (ROI) prediction method that considers the dynamic characteristics of vehicles to address the inaccuracy of ROI detection with the lateral movement of vehicles. The scene and traffic system models are established through PreScan. An ROI prediction algorithm is designed in geodetic coordinate systems based on the system model and Kalman filter theory. The ROI is then converted into the pixel coordinate system through coordinate transformation. The proposed method can detect lane lines in the area in real-time. Simulation experiments under different working conditions show that the proposed method can accurately predict the ROI region and adjust the ROI position in real-time according to the vehicle motion state.

articleTitle: A thermal management method for lithium-ion battery based on fuzzy model predictive control
abstract: The lithium-ion battery has become one of the main power sources in electric vehicles (EVs) because of its great performance. In order to improve the safety and endurance, the temperature of the lithium-ion battery must be kept within a safe range. In this paper, a thermal management method for lithium-ion battery based on fuzzy model predictive control (FMPC) is proposed. Among various lithium-ion battery models, the equivalent circuit model is common-used for its simplicity and suitability. However, the effect of temperature is seldom considered. This paper comprehensively considers the influence of state of charge (SOC) and temperature on the parameters of equivalent circuit model. The simulation results show that the proposed lithium-ion battery thermal management method is effective, and has great performance.

articleTitle: Routing of a Multi-Robot System Using a Time-Space Network Model
abstract: In this paper, we study the collision-free routing of a multi-robot system to complete given tasks in the shortest time. In a robotic assembly unit, several stations work serially and in parallel. In a station, multiple robots share the same workspace and face the challenge of minimizing the cycle time and avoiding collisions at the same time. For this problem, we propose a new mathematical model that is the so-called time-space network (TSN) model. The TSN model can map the robot location constraints into the routing planning framework, leading to a mixed integer programming problem. By solving this mixed integer programming problem, the collision-free path of multiple robots can be determined. Finally, simulation results illustrate the proposed TSN model can obtain the collision-free route of the multi-robot system.

articleTitle: Integrated Navigation Analysis for Odometer-Aided SINS
abstract: In order to improve the vehicle positioning accuracy based on strapdown inertial navigation system(SINS), this paper researched the navigation method combining SINS and odometer. Firstly the error equation of SINS and the error model of odometer were established respectively. Then the integrated navigation state model and measurement model were deduced on positional combination mode. Finally the simulation between the method mentioned in this paper and single dead reckoning were carried out and compared, the results show that the accuracy of odometer-aided SINS is obviously better than that of single dead reckoning.

articleTitle: Design of Coil Winding Insulation Voltage Testing and Corona Signal Extraction System
abstract: With the wider and wider application of electrical equipment in aviation, aerospace, military, civil, agricultural and other fields, the requirements for safety and reliability of electrical equipment are becoming more and more stringent. Impulsive high voltage applied to the coil winding and corona signal extracted from the oscillation waveform are conducive to capturing the weak insulation defects of the coil, which plays an important role in the safety inspection of electrical facilities. This paper studies and develops a highspeed data acquisition and identification algorithm for corona signals, and designs an inter-turn withstand voltage test system for testing the insulation performance of coils.

articleTitle: Prediction of Wind Power Ramp Events Based on Deep Neural Network
abstract: Wind power ramps seriously threaten grid security due to the increase in the proportion of windpower generation to total power generation. In order to improve the prediction accuracy of wind power ramp events, an Empirical Mode Decomposition Deep Neural Network algorithm (EMDDNN) is proposed. First, the wind power data is preprocessed and the characteristics of the wind ramp event are analyzed. Then, the appropriate time window is selected and the empirical modal decomposition of the time series data is used as the input variable of the prediction model. Finally, a deep neural network is used to construct a wind power ramp prediction model. The experimental results based on actual production data show that the prediction accuracy of the EMDNN algorithm proposed in this paper is higher than other comparison algorithms.

articleTitle: Adaptive Fault-Tolerant Control of Flexible Mobile Manipulator
abstract: An adaptive fault-tolerant control algorithm is developed for a mobile manipulator system in the presence of actuator failures. The control is proposed based on a PDEODE model. Under proposed control laws, it guarantees that the vibration of the flexible manipulator can be restricted with actuation redundancy. Moreover, position regulation of the rigid mobile platform and joint can also be achieved in the case of actuator failures with the proposed control. The stability of the closed-loop mobile manipulator is demonstrated. Illustrative simulation results are carried out for confirming the correctness of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Application of Naive Bayesian Algorithms in E-mail Classification
abstract: In the context of the rapid development of today's society, high-tech information technology such as machine learning has played a very important role in promoting social, economic and technological development in all countries of the world. Bayesian classification algorithm is an important algorithm in the field of machine learning and data mining. Naive Bayesian algorithm is a basic and simple classification algorithm in Bayesian classification algorithm. The naive Bayesian algorithm has the advantages of high stability, simplicity, high efficiency and strong theoretical foundation. The classification quality of the naive Bayesian algorithm much depends on the choice of construction methods and the nature and quantity of the classification data. In fact, many problems in our life can be attributed to classification problems, such as risk prediction, medical diagnosis, e-mail classification, fraud detection, etc. [1]. Here, I will mainly explain the principle of naive Bayesian algorithm, classification process, the evaluation of classification results, and apply this algorithm to e-mail classification tasks. At the same time, I list some related examples. Finally, I will summarize the naive Bayesian algorithm.

articleTitle: Quick artificial bee colony algorithm with symbiotic search strategy for global optimization
abstract: Artificial bee colony (ABC) is a metaheuristic algorithm (MHA) which has received extensive attention. However, it often suffers from unsatisfactory exploitation. On the other hand, symbiosis organisms search (SOS) is a MHA which has good exploitation ability due to its mutualism search operator. In this paper, we employ the mutualism search operator to enhance the ABC’s exploitation ability, and thus propose a hybrid quick ABC algorithm with symbiotic search strategy (qABCSS). The performance of qABCSS is comprehensively compared with well-established SOS, ABC and other metaheuristic algorithms using the CEC2014 function. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of qABCSS in terms of solution accuracy and convergence, indicating the effectiveness of the hybridization.

articleTitle: Precise Iterative Closest Point Algrithm Based on Correntropy for 3-D Oral Data Registration
abstract: This paper proposes a new iterative closest point approach based on correntropy with feature guided. Iterative Closest Point (ICP) algorithm can deal with most rigid registration problems, but for point sets with lots of noise and outliers, ICP cannot achieve high precision. We introduce correntropy into ICP to handle this problem by suppressing the influence of the noise and outliers. In terms of point sets contain a large proportion of planes or a curved surface, and have single structure, such as a three-dimensional model of upper jaw, we propose a feature-guided model to solve the oral data registration problem, which uses both the feature and the original data to participate in the registration, but with different weights. Our method mainly deals with the point set registration which has single structure and contains outliers. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm is precise and robust.

articleTitle: An Electric Load Forecasting Model Based on BP Neural Network and Improved Bat Algorithm Hybridized with Extremal Optimization
abstract: Electric load forecasting is a vital role in obtaining effective management of modern power systems. The accuracy forecasting results will lead to the improvement of the energy efficiency and reduction of production cost. This paper presents a novel electric load forecasting model by using BP neural network and improved bat algorithm with extremal optimization called IBA-EO-BP model. First, to enhance the global search ability and diversity of original bat algorithm (BA), we propose IBA-EO by improving original BA and combining with extremal optimization. Then, considering traditional BP is more likely converge to local optimal values, the IBA-EO is employed to find out the optimal connection weight parameters in BP. Two datasets from energy market operation in Australia are selected as case study. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed IBA-EO-BP model is much more accurate than the traditional BP forecasting model and persistence model in terms of three widely used performance indices and two statistical tests.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Process Object Intelligent Model
abstract: Multi-order inertial system is a common controlled object in industrial field. The conventional modeling method is least squares identification algorithm. However, it is necessary to determine the order of the object model before using the excitation data to identify it. This requires prior knowledge, and the identified model is prone to large deviations. This paper presents an intelligent modeling method for multi-order inertial objects. Firstly, the third-order inertial objects are discretized and the DNN deep learning network is embedded in the discrete structure to establish the intelligent model structure. Secondly, in order to ensure that the third-order inertial system can contain the object’s inertial time, three third-order inertial systems are set up in the intelligent model to estimate the inertial time of the controlled object, and the inertial time of the intermediate inertial system is set to be close to the object’s inertial time. At the same time, a margin of (± 50%) is given and set in the other two inertial systems. Finally, the pseudo-random excitation signal is added to the open-loop or closed-loop system of the object, and the input and output data are sent to the intelligent model for training, so the accurate identification model can be obtained. The validity of the intelligent model is verified by testing the simulation data. This method has great practical significance for the design and application of intelligent model.

articleTitle: Application of Fractional-order Compound Control in Photoelectric Stable Platform
abstract: This paper studies the optical axis stable tracking of high-precision photoelectric stability platform system, and proposes fractional-order compound control proposes. Firstly, a fractional-order terminal sliding mode control (FO-TSMC) method is designed to enhance the tracking accuracy of the optical axis. Secondly, for the tracking accuracy affected by friction torque and nonlinear disturbance, the method of disturbance compensation is studied from the level of refinement anti-disturbance, and the compound fractional-order disturbance compensation control strategy is adopted. A fractional-order disturbance observer based on velocity (FO-VDOB) is designed with the equivalent disturbance of the systems. The disturbance is effectively estimated and compensated. A fractional-order sliding mode compensator (FO-SMCO) is designed for the unestimated state of the disturbance, further compensating for the unestimated disturbance. Finally, the finite-time stability is proved by Lyapunov and the finite-time control theory, and the effective validation of the protocol is in the MATLAB simulation environment.

articleTitle: Integrated Fault Estimation and Fault-tolerant Control for Discrete Lipschitz Nonlinear Systems
abstract: A method of integrated fault estimation(FE) and fault-tolerant control(FTC) for discrete nonlinear systems with actuator faults is proposed. Firstly, the observer is designed to get the error equation and the fault-tolerant controller is designed to obtain closed-loop control system. Then consider the coupling of them, an augmented system of system error and state are established. Secondly, the augmentation system can be design by H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> control to realize integrated FE/FTC. Finally, the proposed method is applied to by the flight control system.

articleTitle: Adaptive Fault Tolerant Controller Design for Linear Singularly Perturbed Systems
abstract: An active adaptive fault tolerant controller design method for a linear singularly perturbed system with actuator faults is presented. It is founded on the adaptive fault estimation and Youla controller parameterization. The controller is adapted with the estimated fault, working in such way that the reconfigurable parameterized matrix in the designed Youla controller. The theory of R-controllability and R-observability is used to deal with the small perturbation parameters in singularly perturbed systems. Since actuators suffer from faults, the proposed controller can track the fault parameters adaptively. Finally, a numerical example shows the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Fault Detection Filtering for Discrete-time Switched Systems with All Subsystems Unstable
abstract: In this paper, fault detection (FD) filter design for discrete-time switched system with all subsystems unstable is solved. By designing practical fault detection filters to track the residual signal, we finish the FD. For the existence of unstable subsystem, a proper switching rule is given via average dwell time. In light of the discretized Lyapunov function technology, the exponentially stability is firstly guaranteed. Then, under the stable condition, the L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-gain is obtained with the help of matrix augmented technique and linear matrix inequalities (LMIs).In addition, the desired parameters of the FD filters are easily acquired. Eventually, an example is put forward to verify the serviceability.

articleTitle: ADP-based active optimal fault-tolerant control for modular manipulator with multiple sensor failure
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel active fault-tolerant control (AFTC) method for modular manipulators with multiple sensor failure, which is based on adaptive dynamic programming (ADP). Combining the principle of diffeomorphism, a first-order filter is introduced to convert sensor faults into pseudo-actuator faults. Combine the sensor faults estimated by the adaptive sensor fault observer to establish the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation. Based on the ADP, the online policy iteration (PI) algorithm is applied to solve the HJB equation by establishing a critic neural network. It is proved that the closed-loop modular manipulators system is asymptotic stability according to the Lyapunov theory. Simulation results of 2-DOF modular manipulator systems with two configurations demonstrate the validity of the proposed algorithm finally.

articleTitle: Forecasting for Photovoltaic System Based on 6-Dimension Extreme Leaning Machine
abstract: Photovoltaic power generation technology is greatly influenced by weather. The higher the accuracy of power prediction is, the more beneficial it is. A 6-dimension one-hidden-layer neural network of Extreme Leaning Machine (ELM) method was proposed. A model considering solar irradiance, wind power, wind speed, temperature, humidity and pressure was established for predicting the output power of photovoltaic power generation system. Then, the model was predicted and verified by the data from a photovoltaic power station in Beijing. Finally, by comparing with BP neural network, it shows that the performance of extreme learning machine based on sigmoid function is optimal.

articleTitle: An Improved Firefly Algorithm Hybridized with Extremal optimization for Parameter Identification of Photovoltaic Models
abstract: Firefly algorithm (FA) has widely used to solve various complex optimization problems. However, FA has significant drawbacks in slow convergence rate and easily trapped into local optimum. To tackle these defects, this paper proposes an improved FA combined with extremal optimization (EO), named IFA-EO, where three strategies are incorporated. First, to balance tradeoff between exploration and exploitation, we adopt a new attraction model for FA operation, which combines the full attraction model and the single attraction model through the probability choice strategy. In single attraction model, inspired by the simulated annealing idea, small probability accepts the worse solution to improve the diversity of the offspring. Second, the adaptive step size is proposed according to the number of iterations. Third, we combine EO algorithm with powerful ability in local-search. IFA-EO is employed to handle three different parameters identification problems of photovoltaic model. For comparisons, we choose three swarm intelligence algorithms to compare with IFA-EO. Simulation results demonstrate the superiority of IFA-EO to other three competitors.

articleTitle: Image Processing Techniques for UAV Vision-Based River Floating Contaminant Detection
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are becoming more and more widely employed in environmental inspection. The low-flying UAV carrying a High Definition (HD) camera is very helpful for river surface inspection since manual patrolling rivers is time-consuming and labor-intensive. To intelligently detect floating contaminant through the riverine images taken by UAVs, a series of image preprocessing work are investigated in this paper to deal with the specific problems of UAV-vision. Different from existing object detection approaches, image registration is carried out before Region of Interest (ROI) segmentation and contaminant detection to ensure the matching of images captured by the UAV at different times. According to the image structure, the statistical features of pixel values is used to achieve the extraction of the river region. The detection of floating contaminant is realized by means of anomaly detection based on the combination of Temporal Differencing and Background Subtraction method. The differencing process is improved in our work by utilizing the difference of image texture features instead of pixel-wise value. Experiments demonstrate that our approach can effectively detect the floating contaminant on river surface through riverine images taken by the UAV and is of good practicability.

articleTitle: Thermal Model Identification of Commercial Building based on Genetic Algorithm
abstract: In recent years, there is dramatically increasing in energy consumption. As the main power consuming in demand side, buildings can distribute the thermal storage to help decreasing the peak loads. To predict the demand ability of the power grid, thermal storage model of commercial building is strongly needed. In the literatures, several researchers have presented many different approaches to model the thermal buildings for the estimation of heating/cooling loads. However, many of the models are complex and they are very difficult to be realized. Therefore, it is very essential to find a simple-to-implement building thermal model and it is an important part of building energy management system. A popular approach of building model is gray model, which combines the physical knowledge with the experimental data. One of most popular gray models, Resistance-Capacitance (RC) network can simplify the thermal model of commercial building in some cases. In this paper, we regard the building as a whole, and genetic algorithm is applied to the 2R2C network. The parameters of the 2R2C are optimized by historical data. Lastly, we verify the effectiveness of the proposed approach by the estimated indoor air and ambient temperatures.

articleTitle: An Online VCB’s Vacuum Degree Detecting Method Based on HFID
abstract: Vacuum degree is one of the important parameters of the working condition of the vacuum circuit breaker (VCB). The real-time detection of the vacuum degree is the guarantee of the safe and stable operation of the vacuum circuit breaker. A coupling capacitance method is proposed to detect the vacuum degree of the interrupter on line, which is based on the principle of partial discharge measurement. If the withstand voltage strength between the live contact of the vacuum interrupter to the middle shield decreases due to the decrease of vacuum degree, when the power frequency voltage rises from zero to a certain value, the equivalent capacitance between the live contact and the shield generates electricity. The partial discharge signal can be monitored online by two partial discharge probes located between the shield and the grounding box shell. By capturing the high frequency pulse of discharge, we can indirectly monitor the change of the potential at the shield of the interrupter, so as to accurately understand the vacuum condition of the interrupter. The on-line vacuum monitoring device designed in this paper can meet the requirements of DL/T 403, that is, to capture the discharge signal at the initial stage of pre discharge, and adjust the sensitivity switch of the front panel to make it suitable for the on-line vacuum monitoring of various high, medium and low voltage vacuum circuit breakers, with the monitoring range of more than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> Pa.

articleTitle: Optimized scheduling for flexibility improvement of energy interconnection microgrid
abstract: The stable operation of energy internet system is affected while renewable energy output and load fluctuations occur. In order to improve the anti-interference ability of the energy internet microgrid that combined heat and power(CHP), the research on the flexibility of system scheduling is studied. Firstly, the available flexibility that each micro-element can provide is analyzed, and the flexibility indicators of power and heating are proposed. Furthermore, a two-stage optimal scheduling model with flexibility improvement is proposed, and addressing uncertainty by scheduling flexible resources. In the day-ahead stage, the cost and flexibility are targeted for optimization. In the real-time adjustment stage, the power deviation caused by uncertainty is corrected by scheduling flexible resource and corrective cost is targeted for optimization. The results proved that the proposed optimal scheduling model can improve the scheduling flexibility and ensure that power fluctuations can be effectively eliminated.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Remote ATS Simulation System Based on WEB
abstract: With the development of Internet technology, Automatic Train Supervision (ATS) Simulation System with traditional C/S architecture is more and more inconvenient due to its incompatibility with Internet and high cost of maintenance and development. It is more practical to use B/S structure. SVG (Scalable Vector Graphics) is widely used in software with B/S structure because of its scalability, extendibility and dynamic. The paper demonstrates the technology of SVG is applied to achieve the function of remote access, management of trains and display of signal device.

articleTitle: IETM Data Module Editing
abstract: Data module editing is a key function of IETM production. The structure of IETM text content, and the interactive definition of text and model files, graphic files, multimedia, audio, video files are realized through data module editing. This paper designs the IETM data module editing software based on the Schema defined by GJB6600 and S1000D standards. According to the schema standard, the IETM data module editing software implements the data module editing of manual text content input, inserting form, inserting picture, inserting multimedia, inserting reference data module, inserting reuse unit, etc., realizes the interactive definition of text and entity file, and realizes the standard compliance verification, and produces data modules that conforms to corresponding standard.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Extracting Method for Motion-blurred Stars
abstract: In this paper, a novel method for extracting motion-blurred stars in high dynamic imaging environment affected by stray light is proposed. According to the characteristic of the background noise, an adaptive threshold estimation algorithm for each pixel with down sampling method and block weighted least squares fitting is presented. Furthermore, based on the scanning method and DBSCAN clustering, a new algorithm for extracting pixels of each star is also proposed. The experimental results indicate that the proposed method can improve the accuracy and real-time performance of star image processing even affected by inhomogeneous stray light under high dynamic conditions. The centroid error can be reduced to less than 1 pixel even if the star is motion-blurred to more than 30 pixels and the peak gray value is relatively low.

articleTitle: Brain Storm Optimization Algorithm based on adaptive inertial selection strategy for the RCPSP
abstract: RCPSP(Resource-constrained Project Scheduling Problem) that has been proved to be a NP-hard problem is a kind of combination optimization problem. With the problem scale becoming larger and larger, the problem will become more difficult to solve. A discussion mechanism based on brain storm optimization (DMBSO) for the RCPSP was presented. According to the characteristics of the RCPSP and the problem of poor accuracy and slow convergence in later period of algorithm. We proposed an adaptive inertial selection strategy based on DMBSO (AD-DMBSO) to solve the RCPSP. The algorithm can control the probability of inter-group and intra-group discussion by adjusting the probability of population grouping strategy, which can strengthen the global search in the early stage, and enhance the local search in the later stage. We test AD-DMBSO algorithm on four sets of problem from PSPLIB. The experimental result showed that the proposed algorithm is superior to the DMBSO and particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm in solving the local optimum problem and converging to better optimal values. The excellent performance of the AD-DMBSO algorithm shows its great potential in solving the RCPSP.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation on the Active Equalization for the Battery in the DC System
abstract: The battery system in the DC system is an important link to ensure the safe and stable operation of power plants and substations. The LiFePO4 battery will replacement of lead-acid batteries in the DC system is a trend in the future, because of its high energy density, wide operating temperature, long cycle life. The battery system in the DC system is consisted of a large number of cells, and the capacity is high, due to individual differences, will cause the battery imbalanced, resulting in a reduction in the usable capacity of the battery pack. This may cause battery pack life to decrease or damage the battery. In this article, a switching matrix type active equalization topology and its equalization strategy are designed, which is easy to be modular, simple and efficient. The experimental results verify the feasibility of the design.

articleTitle: Web-based management and visualization of myocardial ischemia data
abstract: Data visualization provides a way to receive information from the massive disordered medical data intuitively. In this paper, a web-based visualization system for myocardial ischemia information is established. On one hand, we use the ECharts to express different types of medical information, including medical records, and medical graphs. Based on this, the medical information can be represented in a novel way. On the other hand, we advance the existing health figures (hFigures). With the improved hFigures, an overview of a patient’s health evolution can be visualized. The proposed web-based visualization system can be helpful to achieve the collaborative work between the medical data management and the medical data visualization.

articleTitle: Research on Internal Temperature Distribution of Crystals in CZ Silicon Single Crystal Growth Process Based on Finite Element Model
abstract: Aiming at the control problem of crystal micro-defects in the growth process of Cz crystal growth, this paper proposes a new solution strategy, which is to reduce crystal micro-defects by optimizing the internal temperature distribution of the crystal. The strategy uses the internal heat transfer formula of the crystal to establish a finite element numerical model, and considers the radiant heating power and temperature gradient constraints, and then optimizes the optimal temperature distribution inside the crystal by the ant lion algorithm (ALO) to meet the desired size requirements. The simulation optimization results show that the proposed method is reasonable and reliable, and meets the requirements of radial micro-defects for radial temperature gradient.

articleTitle: State Difference Sensitivity-based Control Vector Parameterization Refinement Approach for Optimal Control Problems
abstract: To improve the optimization performance of control vector parameterization (CVP) method for optimal control problems, a refinement CVP method based on the state difference sensitivity is proposed. According to the influence of the state vector on the control vector, the state difference of the adjacent time grid nodes makes the control vector sensitive, so new time grid nodes can be selected. Finally, the control parameters obtained with the non-uniform grid are analyzed accordingly. A new NLP problem is obtained with the refined time grid and simulation tests are carried out on a classical optimal control problem. The results show that the proposed method can effectively shorten the calculation time and increase the calculation accuracy compared with the traditional CVP method.

articleTitle: Fault Estimation Scheme for Linear Interconnected Systems with Generalized Perturbations
abstract: In this study, an unknown input observer-based fault estimation strategy is proposed for a class of linear interconnected systems with the generalized perturbation including external disturbance and/or system uncertainty. The mathematical model of the considered linear interconnected systems with actuator and sensor faults are firstly given. By designing an augmented unknown input observer for the faulty systems, the desired fault estimations could be readily obtained. Meanwhile, based on Lyapunov stability theory, the stability of the derived estimated error systems of observer is analyzed. Finally, simulation results are provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed fault estimation scheme.

articleTitle: An Effective Principal Singular Feature Information Extracting Algorithm
abstract: In this paper, a effective algorithm to effectively estimate the singular component and value from the cross-covariance kind of matrix from two data streams by using the neural network approach. Different from traditional algorithms, the newly proposed algorithm can estimate not only the principal singular vectors (PSVRs) but also the principal singular values (PSVEs). First, a dynamical system is obtained from the gradient flow, which is obtained from the optimization of a novel information criterion. Then, based on the dynamical system, a stable neural network algorithm, which can extract the left and right PSVRs, is obtained. Moreover, the PSVE can also be obtained based on the estimated left or (and) right singular vectors (SVRs), because the norm of the SVRs mainly depends on the corresponding singular value (SVE) of the cross-covariance matrix. In this case, the principal singular triplet (PST, PSVRs and the corresponding SVE) of the cross-covariance matrix can be extracted by using the algorithm proposed in this paper. What's more, the algorithm proposed in this paper can also be used for multiple PSTs extractions on the basis of the sequential method. Then, the convergence of the algorithm is analyzed, and the result illustrates that the algorithm proposed in this paper converges to the stable equilibrium point with probability 1. Last, experiment results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper is fast and stable in convergence, and can also extract multiple PSTs efficiently.

articleTitle: An Novel Integrated Iterative Dynamic Programming Control Strategy for Batch Processes
abstract: A novel iterative dynamic programming (IDP) control strategy combined with a novel model predictive control(MPC) strategy which has a decreasing time field is proposed in this paper. It uses our previous neuro fuzzy model (NFM) to predict output values of batch processes. A control law is obtained through a iterative dynamic programming controller based on the neuro fuzzy model in the domain of batch-axis, then the control value of each moment is successively adjusted by a model predictive controller which has a time-decreasing prediction horizon in the domain of time-axis. Therefore, the control law of batch process can be adjusted on the time-axis when there is internal disturbance or external disturbance occurs. The convergence of the proposed control strategy is described and proved. Lastly, in order to verify the applicability of the novel method, two examples are simulated.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Learning of Monocular Depth from Videos
abstract: To estimate single-view depth, a novel unsupervised framework is designed in this paper. In addition, the proposed model outputs optical flow and camera motion from monocular video sequences simultaneously. Without any additional extra annotations, the three components are predicted jointly from their individual networks. In our work, view synthesis losses are employed as primary supervision for training the three components. Moreover, to handle the existences of moving objects in the scene, we segment the scene into static and dynamic parts by comparing the full optical flow and 2D rigid flow resulted from camera ego-motion. Only static regions is considered when computing the view synthesis losses. Experimental results on KITTI dataset reveal that proposed algorithm in this paper excels previous unsupervised approaches, and perform comparbaly with supervised ones.

articleTitle: Sparse dynamic inner principal component analysis for process monitoring
abstract: In this paper, a novel sparse dynamic inner principal component analysis (SDiPCA) method is proposed for process monitoring. First, a simple regression-type approach of dynamic inner principal component analysis (DiPCA) is discussed. To derive sparse principal components, an elastic net regularization is imposed on this regression-type problem. Then a new optimization criterion is established and solved through an alternating algorithm. On the basis of the SDiPCA model, four monitoring statistics are constructed to reflect the process status. Also, the reconstruction-based contribution (RBC) method is employed to isolate faulty variables. Finally, a case study on the Tennessee Eastman process is conducted to illustrate the superior performance of the proposed SDiPCA method compared with DiPCA method.

articleTitle: Event-triggered Model-free Adaptive Control of Networked Nonlinear Systems with Packet Dropouts Compensation
abstract: This paper focuses on the event-triggered data-driven control problem for a class of networked nonlinear systems with packet dropouts. First, a novel event-triggered model-free adaptive control (MFAC) approach is proposed to improve the utilization of communication resources and prolong the lifetime of network components, where the data transmission instants are triggered only when particular event-triggering conditions are satisfied. Furthermore, in order to achieve a satisfactory control performance subject to packet dropouts while reducing the transmission burden, a special event-triggered MFAC scheme combined with the packet dropouts compensation is proposed which merely depends on the input and output data of the underlying systems. Under the proposed design framework, neither the mathematical model nor the model parameters of the system are needed. Then, sufficient conditions are established to guarantee that the tracking error is uniformly ultimately bounded and the ultimate bound depends on the event-triggering error. Finally, a simulation example is carried out to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Gesture recognition based on transfer learning
abstract: At present, the general methods of gesture recognition are machine learning method and deep learning method. However, machine learning method has the disadvantage of extracting image features manually, while deep learning method requires high hardware requirements and is easy to over-fitting in small samples. To solve above problems, this paper proposes gesture recognition based on transfer learning. Firstly, transfer the pre-trained model and convolutional layer parameters on the Image-Net dataset to the gesture dataset with small samples. And then frozen the convolution layer as the feature extractor and fine-tune the output layer of the network to fit the target data. Finally, initialize the 3 fully connection layer of the network with improved normal distribution initialization method and retrain the net again. The simulation results show that the proposed method has a good recognition rate in the small sample gesture image dataset and avoid the over-fitting, which has a great significance for gesture recognition.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Wavelet-Kalman Filter Method for FOG Random Noise
abstract: This paper presents a hybrid wavelet-Kalman filter method to suppress the fiber optic gyro (FOG) random noise which can potentially reduce the accuracy of inertial navigation system. Our approach starts with wavelet threshold filtering for FOG signal preprocess, and post-processes the wavelet-reconstructed signal using Kalman filtering based on improved AR model. The proposed method can not only analyze the signal with multi-resolution, but also estimate the signal optimally. We validate the performance of the proposed method in simulation experiments and compare against wavelet threshold filtering.

articleTitle: Rule and Q-learning based Hybrid Energy Management for Electric Vehicle
abstract: To allocate the power between lithium battery and ultracapacitor in electric vehicle optimally, a new energy management strategy (EMS) is proposed based on the power manage rules and Q Reinforcement learning (RQL) strategy. In this hybrid energy management strategy, when the car is in a braking state or the lithium battery and the ultracapacitor energy are not enough, the output power of the lithium battery and the ultracapacitor is directly allocated based on the rules. Otherwise, an energy management strategy based on RQL is adopted, and the output power of the lithium battery is obtained through $Q$ value table. The performances of the proposed strategy are tested on the simulated electric vehicle experimental platform by 3 typical driving conditions, i.e., ECE condition, UDDS condition and HWFET condition. The results show that in contrast to the rule-based control strategy, the proposed strategy can better adapt to real-time power allocation, reduce the use of lithium batteries, and improve the efficiency of the hybrid energy system.

articleTitle: Design of Tissue Culture Plantlets Transplanting Robot and Control System
abstract: To reduce the cost of labor in the transplanting operation of tissue culture, a vision-guided tissue culture plantlets transplant robot (TCPTR) is developed in this paper. The TCPTR adopted the embedded control system based on ARM+ DSP architecture, which included ARM motion control system and DSP machine vision system, the serial data chain was used to share information between motion control and machine vision. A fast refinement algorithm was employed to extract the skeleton of the tissue culture plantlet, and the template matching was adopted to identify nodes of tissue culture plantlet. Combined with manual transplantation process, the control strategy of TCPTR was designed on the system hardware platform. The experimental results indicated that TCPTR designed can complete the transplant operation of the tissue culture plantlets, and control system had good real-time performance and high stability.

articleTitle: Iterative Unit-based Adaptive Dynamic Programming with Application to Fluid Catalytic Cracker Unit
abstract: Model predictive control(MPC) poses an significant role in process industry. However, due to the characteristics of difficult to solve and poor control performance of nonlinear MPC with disturbances, this paper proposes an iterative unit-based adaptive dynamic programming (IU-ADP) aiming to solve the nonlinear MPC problem with disturbances. In the IU-ADP structure, an actor-critic scheme is adopted together with the iterative method, in which the critic network intends to approximate the performance index, the actor network with an iterative method aims to approximate the optimal control. Moreover, IU-ADP with data parallelization can achieve fast time efficiency. Finally, it is tested on the fluid catalytic cracker unit (FCCU) plant compared with the traditional MPC method. The results illustrate that IU-ADP obtains a little better control performance.

articleTitle: Measurement Method of the Least Mean Square Adaptive Filtering Parameters for Gas-solid Flow
abstract: With regard to the unknown prior knowledge of signal noise in the parameter measurement of gas-solid flow, the present paper puts forward the AC signal processing method based on the least mean square (LMS) adaptive filtering. In addition, the floating processor DSP-TMS320F28335 is employed to collect AC signal of electrostatic sensors and the acquired signals are processed by the aid of LMS adaptive filtering algorithm which adjusts the filter weights according to the criterion of the least mean square error to achieve the optimal filtering. Drawing on the experimental platform, the solid-phase velocity is measured online in real time for the gas-solid flow. The results show that the method can improve the accuracy and stability for the velocity measurement of gas-solid flow.

Author Keywords: the least mean square adaptive filtering

articleTitle: Based on RBF Neural Network Adaptive Sliding Mode Shore Power Grid-connected Control Strategy
abstract: In order to solve the Instability of uninterrupted ship power connect to shore power and increase shore power usage, this paper adopts a strategy called RBF neural network adaptive sliding mode control. It can improve the large error of the traditional sliding mode control. The strategy adopted can suppress the occurrence of large disturbance of the system and improve the stability of the grid-connected inverter output during the process of grid connection. The simulation model is built in MATLAB/SIMULINK. Under the condition of low voltage 440V, the simulation results are compared with the results of traditional sliding mode control without RBF neural network. It verifies the effectiveness of sliding mode control and enhances its reliability.

articleTitle: Research on the Failure Mode Analysis and Countermeasures of the Speed Control System of Motor-driven Feedwater Pump in Nuclear Power Plant
abstract: This thesis analysis the failure mode of Speed Control System from two dimensions (systematic design and equipment design) after learning the functions and construction of the Speed Control System of Motor-Driven Feedwater Pump in nuclear power plant. Then giving solutions and handling methods in allusion to different failure modes from the two dimensions referred above, and presenting the idea of problem-solving for potential faults of Speed System of Feedwater Pump in nuclear power plant.

articleTitle: A Deep learning based evaluation method for feature detectors using satellite images
abstract: Feature detectors play an important role on computer vision. So far, feature-based and region-based methods, such as the repeatability, have been used to evaluate the performance of these detectors. Although these methods can provide an evaluation measure about the detection repeatability, they do not consider the informative part of the detected features as a whole set. In this work, we propose a novel method to evaluate feature detectors using a classification-based application. Kernel density estimation is used to represent the features sets and an effective SVM-based method is used to increase the number of variables on the feature space. An SVM classifier is then trained on the deep learning features which are generated using sparse autoencoders. Experimental results on satellite images show great difference among some common detectors and reveal the effect of their spaces on the classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Point Flow Edge Detection Method Based on Phase Congruency
abstract: This paper aims to detect image edges based on the Point Flow (PF) theory [14]. in the original PF model in [14], the vector field is built on image gradient. However, due to the noise sensitivity and weak edges confusion of local image gradients, the PF model might fail in detecting low-contrast edges. In this paper, we propose to build the vector field based on phase congruency (PC), which exploits image non-continuities (e.g., edges) in frequency domain instead of image domain. Since the phase of each frequency component at signal non-continuities is identical, e.g., after Fourier transform, the phase of all sinusoidal wave at rising edges of the square wave is 0<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">circ</sup>, phase congruency indicates the image edges in frequency domain and avoids the effect of signal local contrast. Natural and synthetic images are tested to investigate the effectiveness of the proposed phase congruency based point flow model (PCPF). Compared with the classical Canny operator, the gpb-ucm detector and the original point flow model [14], our method yields higher detection accuracy and more detail edges.

articleTitle: Object Detection Based On Decision Level Fusion
abstract: Object detection is widely used in different fields. In this paper, a new object detection model of decision level fusion based on Mask R-CNN is proposed. The model fuses the infrared images and the visible images at decision-making level. It is called as IVF-Mask R-CNN. In order to improve the stability and the accuracy of the IVF-Mask R-CNN model, the partial network freeze strategy, learning rate reduction strategy and test image up-sizing strategy are used. The fuse model IVF-Mask R-CNN compensates the limitation of single imaging model of object detection. It improves the accuracy of the detection. The experimental results show that IVF-Mask R-CNN model contributes to a better object detection effect compared with the single visible detection model and the infrared detection model.

articleTitle: Research on A Fruit Fly Optimization Algorithm for OFDM Modulation System
abstract: the allocation of bit and power in OFDM system is realized by a improved discrete fruit fly optimization algorithm proposed in this paper. Firstly, the swap operator and swap sequence are introduced into the algorithm, which solves that the traditional fruit fly algorithm is only suitable for the optimization of continuous solutions; the fruit fly algorithm is then improved from the search step length and the update strategy; finally, the OFDM system meets the requirements of power minimization and throughput maximization by the algorithm. The simulation results by MATLAB prove that the improved algorithm is superior to traditional algorithms such as Chow.

articleTitle: Design of IETM Making Platform
abstract: Based on GJB6600 standard, this paper designs the IETM making platform, and realizes the management of manual projects, manual data planning, data module/data entity/basis data and other manual data management, manual editing, multi-form manual release and delivery management. And realize the data exchange in the making process of upstream and downstream manufacturers' manuals, realize the task assignment, proofreading, approval and finalization in the manual compilation process, realize data version management and security control, and provide a collaborative working environment for the development of IETM. The system is implemented with J2EE and Web Service technologies.

articleTitle: Lower Limbs Gait Rehabilitation System Based on Regression Analysis
abstract: Based on online machine learning, the automatic control system for lower limbs gait rehabilitation is designed. The system structure design, motion signal acquisition and rehabilitation analysis processing technology are introduced. The software architecture of the distributed control system, kinematical modeling of the lower limbs exoskeleton, implementation of fundamental motion control algorithm and the design of gait rehabilitation system are expounded. This paper illustrates the software architecture of distributed control system, and the design of motion sensing and controlling algorithm. The system utilizes polynomial regression and online gradient descent to analyze customers' lower limbs gait, these results are used by motion control system to generate more accurate motion parameter; and has the function of perceiving, recording, and remotely monitoring customers' motion. The system has friendly interactive interface for staffs of monitor center or relatives of patients to supervise state of patients' motion and information of environment in real time. Experimental results prove that the system could reliably help customers' lower limbs gait rehabilitation, possessing some practical value.

articleTitle: Sampled-data stabilization for a kind of stochastic nonlinear systems driven by G-Brownian motion
abstract: In this paper, we analyzed the mean-square exponential stability of controlled stochastic differential equations driven by G-Brownian motion(G-SDEs) based on their approximate discrete-time models. Firstly, Euler-Maruyama(EM) approximation model is established for such systems. Meanwhile, we investigated the one-step consistency between exact discrete-time model and EM approximation model of the original system. Then, the stability relationship between the EM approximation model and its exact model is studied. Finally, a numerical simulation is presented to verify the effect of our results.

articleTitle: Data-driven model-free adaptive sliding mode control for melt surface temperature of Czochralski silicon monocrystal growth process
abstract: Heat is the driving force of solid-liquid phase transformation in Czochralski silicon monocrystal growth process, and melt surface temperature directly affects the quality of silicon monocrystal. Due to the complex physical changes, multi-field and multi-phase coupling, uncertain model and time-varying and nonlinear characteristics of the silicon monocrystal growth process, which makes the mechanism model difficult to obtain. This paper presents a model free adaptive discrete sliding mode control (MFASMC) method for melt surface temperature control. Firstly, the thermal system model between heater power and melt surface temperature is established based on data using ELM. Secondly, design of controller with compact dynamic linearization by I/O data of the system. Meanwhile, the idea of discrete sliding mode is to enhance the tracking performance and robustness of model free adaptive control (MFAC). Finally, The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Design of Secondary Water Supply System Based on Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
abstract: A superimposed water supply method is proposed for secondary water supply system. Adopting the method of pressure superposed water supply. The surplus pressure of municipal pipe network is fully utilized. At the same time, permanent magnet synchronous motor drive is employed. It improves the running efficiency of water pump; Simulation results show the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Consensus analysis for linear multi-agent systems with protocol failure
abstract: It deals with reaching consensus multi-agent systems reaching consensus with protocol failure in the paper. A kind of link failure or not multi-agent system whose dwell time are constant is mentioned. A method based on these cases is proposed to analyze their consensus. The simple conditions with low computational complexity are proposed and the residence time is determined according to these conditions. At last, an example is given to verify the availability.

articleTitle: Gyro Denoising and Fusion Quaternion Attitude Estimation Based on Improved Least Squares
abstract: Attitude estimation can obtain the three-dimensional attitude information of the carrier, so it has its unique importance in navigation and positioning. In order to effectively improve the accuracy of pose estimation, the article mainly does two parts of work. First, the gyroscope is denoised using an improved least squares method to make the gyroscope output more accurate and smoother. Then use a quaternion filtering structure that combines an accelerometer with a gyroscope to improve attitude accuracy. Finally, the paper designs two parts of the experiment, which verify the noise reduction performance of the gyroscope and the accuracy of the attitude estimation. It can be seen from the experimental results that the method described in this paper can effectively reduce the influence of the constant drift of the gyroscope on the attitude estimation, making the attitude estimation convergence faster and the solution accuracy higher.

articleTitle: The Simplification of the MMG Model of Ship Motion With the Method for Parameter Calculation
abstract: As a simplified MMG (Manoeuvring Model Group) model, the ship motion model proposed in the standard of the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC62065) has limitation of imprecise motion simulation for atypical ship, because of the simplification of some physical quantity such as propeller thrust and fluid resistance. To keep the concision of the IEC62065 model and address the issues of inaccuracy of atypical ship, this paper proposed a method of simplifying the complex MMG model with considerable accuracy for atypical ship into IEC62065 model. By designing motion simulation experiment of the complex MMG model for atypical ship, the relevant parameters in the IEC62065 model for the atypical ship will be calculated. Comparing the simulation results of the IEC62065 model with complex MMG model for the same atypical ship, it shows a high fitting degree between them. By using the method, a good model simplification effect can be obtained.

articleTitle: Terrain Traversability Classification Based on SVDD
abstract: Terrain travel classification is one of the most important content for robot autonomous navigation, especially in terms of following robots. For this reason, a novel travel ability classification method which is suitable for following robots are studied in this paper. First, slope, roughness, and step height of elevation map are used to describe terrain features. Then, robots will acquire these parameters by means of leader track during following behind, and mark these parameters as terrain travel positive samples. By this, the terrain travel ability classification turns into one-class classification only with positive samples, because the robot may not get the full negative samples and it is dangerous for robots to acquire these samples. At last, the SVDD algorithm is used to train terrain classification model, which enables the robot to have the ability of terrain recognition and learning. The experiment results illustrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.

articleTitle: Stacked Particle Size Measurement Method Based on Data Processing
abstract: In order to obtain accurate measurement results of particle size, the watershed algorithm is used to segment the image after steps including the median filtering, binaryzation, expansion and corrosion, distance transformation and seed point marking. Then the segmented image is data filtered and errors and data with large deviations are eliminated. The result with data filtering is compared with result without data filtering. The result with data filtering is verified. Finally, the precise particle size is obtained. The experiments show the proposed method can accurately measure the size of overlapped particles.

articleTitle: A Multi-granulariry Chinese Word Segmentation Method Based on Semantic Similarity for Risk Sources
abstract: This paper presents a multi-granularity Chinese word segmentation method based on semantic similarity for risk sources. Based on expert knowledge, a risk source root dictionary and a risk source extension dictionary were established, and the risk source extension dictionary was trained using the LDA model. Firstly, the sentence containing the root vocabulary was divided into two sentences using root dictionary. Two semantic segment Word next to the root vocabulary were combined into two new extension vocabulary, which were calculated semantic similarity by Latent Dirichlet Allocation model together with the root vocabulary. Finally, the word with the largest similarity was used as the extension risk word. Experiment show that the average success rate of our method reached 94.19%, and can be used for text segmentation of criminal cases.

articleTitle: Online Monitoring and Routing Algorithm for WSN in Smart Distribution Network Based on Quantum Ant Colony
abstract: Aiming at the high requirements of real-time reliability of data transmission in some monitoring and management equipments in smart distribution network, a routing protocol based on quantum ant colony is proposed to improve real-time reliability by balancing network energy consumption. The probability position of the qubit is used to represent the current position information of the ant, the quantum revolving gate is used to update the qubits carried by the ant, and the quantum non-gate is used to realize the variation of the position of the ant, which makes full use of the quantum ant colony algorithm for global optimization and fast convergence. Simulation experiments show that this method has more uniform energy consumption, shorter search path and the data transmission is more reliable, compared with traditional LEACH algorithm and ant colony algorithm, which provides a new idea for online monitoring of WSN in smart distribution network.

articleTitle: Fixed-time Nonsingular Backstepping Control of Photovoltaic Systems
abstract: In this paper, the nonlinear photovoltaic system is studied. In order to make full use of photovoltaic energy, it is necessary to maintain maximum power output under each condition.
