First, apply incremental conductance algorithm to get the desired voltage under various conditions. Then, a fixed-time nonsingular backstepping controller is be present to ensure that the photovoltaic output voltage follows the desired voltage to reach the maximum photovoltaic power point. Moreover, there is no nonsingular phenomenon and the upper bound of the convergence time is determined by the control parameters and does not follow the initial value of the system. Further, the control strategy is theoretically proved by the Lyapunov stability theory. Finally, the effectiveness and efficiency of the designed controller are verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Design And Application Of Transmission Line Monitoring System
abstract: In this paper, based on the common external force damage of power transmission lines, the online monitoring system of transmission lines based on Gaussian model is studied. The system uses radar sensor, video tool as the signal acquisition unit, DSP chip as the core operation unit, and the corresponding hardware circuit and software flow are designed. The monitoring system can effectively distinguish the moving objects in the area around the transmission line by Gaussian distribution method, and effectively calculate the distance and speed of the intruding object. Through the on-site installation test data, the system can accurately judge the distance and speed of simulating intruding objects and verify the accuracy and effectiveness of the designed system according to the timely warning of the design alarm system.

articleTitle: A 3D Palmprint Recognition Method based on Local Sparse Representation and Weighted Shape Index Feature
abstract: A palmprint recognition method is proposed by local sparse representation. The method consists of two problems: palmprint feature extraction problem and palmprint recognition problem. In the aspect of feature extraction, the weighted shape index feature is adopted to describe three-dimensional surface. As for the recognition problem, the two-stage classification method is proposed by local sparse representation. Firstly, the similarity is used to construct the sample subset, which reserves candidate classed of the test data set. Secondly, the sparse coding classifier is used to obtain the palmprint category. The experimental results and comparisons on the Hong Polytechnic University palm data set verify that the proposed approach has better effectiveness than the traditional methods.

articleTitle: Research on guidance method based on angle description
abstract: Based on the derivation of optimal proportional navigation, the new expressions with line of sight angle and trajectory angle for proportional navigation, integral proportional navigation and velocity pursuit are proposed. The guidance model with initial heading error is developed when considering a high order dynamics system for the integral proportional navigation and velocity pursuit. Comparative analysis results of miss distance demonstrate the guidance performance of integral proportional navigation and velocity pursuit.

articleTitle: Design of a Variable Buoyancy System for the Hybrid Crawler-Flyer Underwater Vehicle
abstract: The Hybrid Crawler-Flyer Underwater Vehicle (HUV) is the development trend of underwater robot in recent theoretical research and engineering practice. Buoyancy control is one of the key issues in order to be able to freely switch between crawler and flyer mode. This paper proposed a variable buoyancy system for the HUV. Including piston, transmission system, motor, the sealed cabin and electronic approach switch, the mechanical structure was implemented to control the volume of HUV. Simulations underwater were performed to ensure the its performance under high pressure. The control system was designed to obtain a variable buoyancy. Prototype was built to realize the method proposed.

articleTitle: Fixed-time Nonsingular Terminal Sliding Mode Control for MPPT in Stand-alone Photovoltaic Systems
abstract: Fixed-time controller is applied to stand-alone photovoltaic systems to achieve maximum power point tracking. To avoid singularity in controller and ease implement, a new fixed-time reaching law is proposed. And then, a new maximum power point tracking algorithm based on fixed-time nonsingular terminal sliding mode control is proposed. The proposed algorithm can achieve maximum power point tracking with varying irradiance and load within a constant fixed time. Finally, simulation results verify that our fixed-time scheme leads to more excellent performance than classic PID control and works effectively under rapidly varying irradiance and load.

articleTitle: The improved dehazing method fusion-based
abstract: This paper proposes a new way to clear up the fog which softly combines dark channel with color attenuation, namely DCP and CAP. The main task is to solve the bad performance in the sky and white bright regions based on the DCP and the problem of incomplete defogging near the object of the foreground based on the CAP. A quad-tree search method is applied to look for the atmospheric light A. We can choose the pixel average of the last image block as A to solve the problem of excessive saturation. The guided filter is applied to adjust the final medium transmission. By experiments, the results can prove that the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: Humanoid robot shadow system based on kinect depth camera detection
abstract: The growing development of 5G technology and artificial intelligence seems to bring infinite possibilities to the robotics field. However, there is currently no humanoid robot in the world that can be completely controlled by humans and has the same mobility as humans. This paper proposes a completely new structural design designed to give the robot the same articulated joint as humans. And through the kinect depth camera, it can accurately capture the movement angle of each joint of the human body based on the human bone joint motion detection algorithm. Through the angle remapping and correction, the final angle information is sent to the steering gear through the serial port, so that the humanoid robot can perform the same action as the human being in real time.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Scene Text Detection Based on Convolutional Neural Network
abstract: Faster R-CNN has advantages in object detection task. But in face of the variability of text and interference of the external factors, it cannot achieve perfect detection results in natural scene text detection. Moreover, the text detection algorithms based on deep learning need to use large data sets to train the network, while in some special scenarios where a mass of samples cannot be obtained, the performance of these algorithms is likely to be limited. How to accurately detect text in natural scene based on small data sets is a challenging issue. To address this issue, a multi-scale text feature extraction network with feature pyramid based on Faster R-CNN is proposed, which can accurately and comprehensively express complex and changeable text features in natural scenes even in the small data cases. Experiment results show that the proposed MSTD method is very competitive with existing related architectures.

articleTitle: Four-flywheel Human Body Balance Aid Based on Sliding Mode Variable Structure Control
abstract: Recently, the increasing degree of social aging has aroused more and more attention for elderly walking assistance. In view of the lack of balance assistive technology, this paper introduces a four-flywheel human body balance aided device on account of gyroscopic torque theory. In this paper, the mechanical analysis of the four flywheel structures is firstly carried out, the system state variables are embedded in the sliding mode surface, and the Lyapunov second method is used to determine the system input. Then, MATLAB is applied for the simulation of the dynamic model of this mechanism. The simulation results reveal that this balance assisting device can assist in human balance in all directions, which is able to respond quickly. Furthermore, even if the object is tilted at an angle of 30 degrees, it can quickly return the object to its vertical position.

articleTitle: Visual Detection Method for Spatial Transverse Vibration Displacement of Wire Rope in Multi-point Synchronous Hoisting System
abstract: In order to detect the healthy running state of wire rope efficiently and accurately in multi-point synchronous hoisting system, this paper proposed a method based on orthogonal image technology to detect the spatial transverse vibration displacement of wire rope. Firstly, two sets of images were captured synchronously at the same frequency by two high-speed video cameras where set vertically each other. Secondly, binarization and calculation of actual vibration displacement of wire rope were carried out with LabVIEW, and recording the real-time vibration of wire rope. At last, empirical mode decomposition method was used to remove the periodic excitation caused by the displacement of rope-arranging. The spatial vibration shape of the wire rope and the vibration trajectory in the cross section of the wire rope were obtained by fitting these data on Matlab. The experimental results show that this method can accurately reflect the law of the spatial transverse vibration of wire rope. It can provide technical support for the study of the detection and evaluation of the safety parameters of the hoisting system.

articleTitle: An Online-Offline Computing Mode based on Apache Storm for Text Classification
abstract: Text classification technologies such as SVM, Naïve Bayes and Random Forest has been widely used in many scientific research fields. However, with the rapid development of computer science, especially in social networking, the volume of data needed to be analyzed in real-time. So these renders traditional classification algorithms are unable to fulfill the real-time analysis requirement directly. In this paper, an online-offline computing mode based on Apache Storm is proposed to support classification for high-volume continuous text. In the offline part, text classifiers are trained in a traditional manner, to create highly accurate models. These text classifiers are then serialized and submitted onto Apache Storm. Finally, in the online part, high-volume continuous textual data can be fed into and analyzed by the Storm platform to provide the analysis in a relatively short time. Experimental results show that the text classification based on the proposed mode is over fifteen times faster than traditional mode.

articleTitle: Non-collocated Output Tracking Control for 1-D Wave Equation with Unknown Disturbance and Non-differentiable Reference Signal
abstract: In text research, the output tracking problem of the left endpoint of one-dimensional wave equation with the control input at the opposite is considered, with non-differentiable reference signal and boundary disturbance. the output tracking problem of one-dimensional wave equation is considered to adopt the Auto disturbance rejection control(ADRC) technology. Firstly, an infinite order disturbance observer is designed. Secondly, we use the linear third-order Tracking Differentiator that used to extract the approximate derivatives of the reference signal. Then, constructing an auxiliary system which the right boundary condition is 0 and the reference signal is posed as the left boundary condition. The right boundary hidden regularity of the auxiliary system is used as the right boundary condition and the estimated value of the disturbance is posed as the left boundary condition to design the servo system, The problem studied in this paper that the control inputs and outputs are non-collocated. Finally, the numerical simulation verifies the theoretical analysis results.

articleTitle: Damage Feature Extraction Method of CFRP Structure Based on Wavelet Transform in Noisy Environment
abstract: Damage feature extraction is a prerequisite for identifying carbon fiber reinforced plastics (CFRP) structural damage. In order to accurately identify structural damage, it is necessary to carry out damage feature extraction of CFRP structures. Firstly, the CFRP structure was actively excited, and the structural dynamic response signal was detected. To simulate the effect of noise on the signal, Gaussian white noise was added to the structural dynamic response signal. Then, the wavelet threshold denoising method was used to remove the noise in the signal. After that, the signal after denoising was wavelet transformed, and the wavelet time-frequency characteristics were extracted as damage features. Finally, the experimental verification was carried out, and the results verify the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An Improved Method of ADHDP for Optimal Control in Wiped Film Molecular Distillation
abstract: The wiped film molecular distiller is a complex system which has features of multivariate, nonlinearity, strong coupling and large time delay. It's production adjustment is mainly based on artificial experience. In order to improve the purification rate of molecular distillation and increase productivity, the paper proposes to adopt extreme learning machine to improve action-dependent heuristic dynamic programming algorithm. Through constructing three kinds of network, the paper gives the specific theoretical realization process of ADHDP based on ELM network. For the purpose of verifying the effectiveness of the algorithm, the algorithm is applied to the optimal control of wiped film molecular distillation. By comparing with BP-ADHDP and BP-HDP, the simulation results indicate that the controller based on ELMADHDP can realize better optimizing control and improve the stability of the molecular distillation process.

articleTitle: Study on Simulation of Asynchronous Motor Rotor Broken Bar Fault
abstract: Rotor broken strip of asynchronous motor is not obvious and usually cannot be judged accurately because of on-site noise, equipment installation and other various interferences. In this paper, a simulation of rotor broken bar fault is conducted in SIMULINK environment, and the motor fault is simulated by changing the external resistance of the wound asynchronous motor. Through simulation and analysis of various combinations of several external resistors, the variation law of stator current frequency under varying fault degree is revealed. This model is feasible and can simulate different degrees of broken bar fault in order to approximate various working conditions. The simulation results show that the spectrum analysis method can be effectively applied to the diagnosis of motor rotor broken bar fault, and the correctness of the simulation model is verified.

articleTitle: A Novel Probabilistic Matrix F actorization for Personal Recommendation
abstract: Matrix Factorization (MF) is a well-known method which is to predict users' preference in recommender systems. This method has the advantage of reducing data sparsity and cold start problem. Probabilistic matrix factorization (PMF) is an improved method of matrix factorization. Recommender system can efficiently reduce the information overload problem. However, it is bound by the recommended accuracy. In this paper we introduce Bayesian distribution to improve accuracy and design our novel probabilistic matrix factorization (NPMF) proved to have better performance. In addition, we also use K nearest neighbor method and stochastic gradient descent to further improve our method. The experimental studies using two different datasets including MovieLens 100k and MovieLens 1M, show that the proposed methods already have comparable and better performance.

articleTitle: State Feedback Regulation of Nonlinear Systems with Unmodeled Dynamics
abstract: This paper studies the state feedback control problem for a class of nonlinear systems with integral input-to-state stability (iISS) unmodeled dynamics and unknown control direction. By using the properties of iISS and the backstepping technique, the design function of the state feedback controller and the updating rule of parameters are selected to obtain the appropriate controller. Theoretical analysis proves that the designed controller can ensure that all signals of the system are bounded and the state can be gradually adjusted to zero. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Channel Allocation Optimization of Hybrid Wireless Mesh Protocol
abstract: As the number of nodes increases, the signal interference of the wireless Mesh network increases, causing the end-to-end delay of the network to increase and the throughput to decrease. The use of multiple interfaces reduces interference between nodes. The multi-channel multi-radio channel allocation strategy can reduce inter-node interference and allocate limited channel resources more reasonably. Unfortunately, although hybrid wireless mesh protocol (HWMP) supports multiple interfaces, it cannot allocate channels effectively due to fixed channel allocation. In this paper, we present a honeycomb topology that we developed to decrease the interference. We also present a method based on the depth of the routing tree where the node is located with the aim of addressing the ripple effect caused by channel switching. We discuss the proactive routing discovery of HWMP, and we describe in detail the implement of the method as well as the modification of HWMP. Finally, we report some performance evaluation results which show that the proposed solution can achieve a good throughput with a large increase of network load.

articleTitle: Discovering the Lead-Lag Relationships in Financial Markets: A Method based on DTW
abstract: The lead-lag relationships of stock prices are of great importance for its effectiveness in the fields of risk control and the portfolio investments. In this paper, we propose a new method to analyze the inherent lead-lag relationships of stocks in financial market. Considering the “golden crosses” and the “death crosses”. we represent multivariable stock time series as dynamic competitivity graph series to capture the meaningful signals of the changing trends. Inspired by the corresponding relation of optimal path in the process of calculating Dynamic Time Warping, we propose a new method called LLR to detect the dynamic time evolution of the lead-lag structure between two dynamic competitivity graph series. Finally, we verify the obtained relationships in Chinese A-share market. The experimental results demonstrate that it is effective to use the relationships revealed by LLR to make prediction of stock trend and explain the financial law of stock market.

articleTitle: A VR-based Complex Equipment Maintenance Training System
abstract: In order to enhance the interactive reality between user and virtual objects in virtual maintenance training of complex equipment, the hybrid driving simulation which combined geometric constraints and physical simulation, and the virtual reality environment interaction technologies are studied. The system is implemented with PhysX and UE4 which are widely used open source engines. The application and evaluation results show that the proposed system can provide trainees with effective, immersive and risk-free training.

articleTitle: Research on Wind / PV / Storage Hybrid Microgrid and Grid/Islanded Switching Based on Neural Network
abstract: In the process of control mode switching of the micro-grid controlled by the master-slave, the output value of the controller will be abruptly changed, causing voltage and current shock and waveform distortion. For this problem, a neural-based control strategy and improved loop controller, realizes the smooth transition of the micro-grid and off-grid, ensures stable operation of the important load. The traditional PI controller has a simple structure, but has limitations: when the controlled object is too complicated, the parameters of the PI controller are difficult to adjust. The self-tuning of PI parameters is realized by combining BP neural network with traditional PI controllers. Finally, the switch between the grid connection and islanding is simulated by Matlab to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Real-time Classification of Ship Cabins Fire Hazard Levels Based on CNN
abstract: In order to evaluate the hazard level of fire cabins in real time and solve the problem of excessive BP neural network parameters, a lightweight evaluation model based on convolutional neural network is proposed. Firstly, a simulation platform was designed by Pyrosim. Then, for the problem of too many parameters of the fully connected neural network, the 1×1 convolution, multi-size convolution kernels and SE block method in the image domain were used to improve it. A multi-layers convolutional neural network was designed. The test results show that, compared with the fully connected neural network, the classification accuracy is improved by 2.1%, reaching 91.25%, and the parameter quantity is only 1/10 of the former, which reduces the storage overhead and provides a certain foundation for the development of embedded platforms.

articleTitle: HDFS Efficiency Storage Strategy for Big Data in Smart City
abstract: With the rapid development of smart city and artificial intelligence technology, massive city-related information has been increased. The traditional storage strategy for big data can easily lead to hot nodes, which makes it difficult to meet requirement of big data storage efficiency. A Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) storage strategy for data based on the response time of data nodes (DNs) is proposed. Four parameters of memory utilization, network distance, bandwidth utilization and CPU utilization of DNs are token as evaluation indicators of the strategy. Then the master node evaluates the response time of each data node (DN) based on BP neural network. Finally, the DNs with shorter response time would be chosen for data storage. The simulation results show that the proposed strategy can realize the distributed storage for big data and avoid the emergence of hot nodes. Furthermore, the strategy can effectively improve the response time of DNs and the load balancing of cluster.

articleTitle: Precise Point Set Registration Algorithm for Indoor Scene Reconstruction
abstract: In this paper, we propose a precise point set registration algorithm for indoor scene reconstruction. Firstly, as for the problem that sensor samples unevenly, point-to-plane metric is introduced into our model, which effectively makes use of the surface structure information of point set and improves registration result. Secondly, to handle with noises and outliers in indoor scene, correntropy is introduced. To solve our model, we propose a variant of Iterative Closest Point (ICP) algorithm, which iteratively establishes point-to-point correspondence and calculates rigid transformation parameters. After that, the simulated experiments demonstrate the accuracy and robustness of the proposed algorithm compared with other methods. Besides, it is also used to indoor scene reconstruction and the result is satisfying.

articleTitle: Identifying mental workload using EEG and deep learning
abstract: Mental workload (MWL) is the occupancy rate of mental resource under working condition. MWL has a strong impact on human performance. Electroencephalogram (EEG) is one of the most potential psychophysiological measures to identify the level of MWL and to investigate the neural mechanism of MWL. Deep learning (DL) techniques have made tremendous progress, and are expected to solve the problem of MWL identification. However the representation of EEG data can be handicap when applying DL to EEG analysis. This paper proposes a MWL identification method based on recurrence plot (RP) and DL. The MWL data is scarce, so the transfer learning was used to build the DL model. EEG signals were converted into RPs as the input to the DL model. The results showed that this method reached an accuracy of 87.6 ⊥ 2.82 %, which outperformed the existed method. This study provided methodological contribution to the identification of WML.

articleTitle: Particle Swarm Optimization based Optimization for Batch Processes
abstract: Considering trajectory optimization and local extremum problems, a 2D batch process optimization method with initial state optimization is proposed in this paper. It integrates the information of time axis and batch axis unique to batch process. Particle swarm optimization (PSO), which is used to optimize the initial value so that it has good tracking performance and the ability to avoid falling into local optimum. At the same time, model identification and dynamic R parameter compensation are used to compensate the mismatch between the model and the controlled object, so that it has zero error tracking ability. By solving MPC optimization problem with time-varying predictive horizon, the control law is obtained, which has good tracking performance and robustness against disturbance and uncertainty. In addition, model identification and dynamic R parameters are used to compensate model mismatch, which makes zero error tracking possible. Secondly, the convergence analysis and tracking performance of the proposed integrated model predictive learning control system are strictly proved. Finally, the effectiveness of this method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: A Lunar Robot Obstacle Avoidance Planning Method Using Deep Reinforcement Learning for Data Fusion
abstract: In future exploration and base construction on the moon, obstacle avoidance planning of lunar robots in an uncertain environment is critical for their autonomous movements and operations, with no precise location information of obstacles. In the present work, an obstacle avoidance planning method using deep reinforcement learning with a double-channel Q network is proposed, by which local surveillance video images and navigating data are merged for action value estimation. Through simulation, our method is turned out to achieve motion planning effectively from raw sensing data, and learn faster than the methods using single type of data.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Cable Tunnel Inspection Robot
abstract: Aiming at the key technical problems of cable tunnel inspection robot, this paper builds the control system of cable tunnel inspection robot based on NVIDIA Jetson TX2 and STM32F407. By designing a motion mechanical structure to meet the requirements of the inspection robot walking freely on the fixed track of the tunnel, designing a positioning scheme based on Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) to enable the robot to quickly and accurately acquire the location information, and designing a multi-channel audio and video processing scheme to enable the robot to have online diagnosis, video coding, audio coding and decoding and multimedia streaming capabilities. The experimental results confirm the feasibility of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Nondestructive Detection of Apple Mouldy Core Disease Based on Unbalanced Dielectric Data
abstract: In order to establish a nondestructive detection model for mouldy core disease in apples, 265 samples of healthy and suspected disease fruits were tested for 11 dielectric parameters in the 100hz - 3.98Mhz frequency. After dissection, the 17 diseased apples were observed. The Extra-Tree algorithm was used to extract the characteristics of samples. It found that the parameters of loss factor, conductance, negative impedance phase, parallel resistance, series resistance, and admittance in the low-frequency band of 100hz-1580hz had strong discriminability. As the number of healthy fruits and diseased fruits are unbalanced, using the SMOTE and other sampling techniques. Then, six classifiers were used to build the discriminant models. Experiments show that SMOTE-Tomek Link technique maintains the data distribution better, and GBDT classifier has the highest accuracy of detection, up to 95.97%. Thus, verifying the effectiveness of apple mouldy core disease nondestructive detection model based on unbalanced dielectric data.

articleTitle: A brake disc character recognition method based on photometric stereo and surface curvature extraction
abstract: In view of the situation that the batch number characters of the break disc casting parts are the same color as the background area, and the contrast is low, and the recognition effect of the traditional method based on gray value is poor, the method combining photometric stereo technology and surface curvature extraction is adopted to reconstruct the surface of the disc casting parts to obtain high quality images for subsequent processing. A method based on subpixel contour to calculate disk centroid is proposed to correct image rotation after reconstruction. In the aspect of denoising, morphological methods are used to further optimize the image and remove the disturbing noises such as holes. At last, the characters are extracted and recognized by SVM classifier. Through experimental verification, the recognition speed of this method is fast, and the recognition accuracy is more than 98%, which can fully meet the actual needs of industrial field.

articleTitle: Optimal Control for Robotic Manipulators With Input Saturation Using Single Critic Network
abstract: This paper proposes an optimal control scheme for complex robotic manipulators with input saturation and dynamical disturbances. A single critic neural network(NN) is adopted in the controller design. In addition, a suitable nonquadratic function is provided to tackle the problems of constrained inputs and system uncertainties. Furthermore, an updating law for critic NN is used to guarantee that the closed-loop robotic system is ultimately bounded. The stability analysis is also addressed based on the direct Lyapunov method. Finally, the simulation is conducted on a two degree-of-freedom(DOF) robotic manipulator to verify the effectiveness of the proposed optimal control scheme.

articleTitle: Control of Quadrotor Drone with Partial State Observation via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: In this paper, we propose a quadrotor control algorithm which use the historical strengthened partial state observations as input information to control the quadrotor drone using reinforcement learning algorithm. Reinforcement learning method could enable the agent to learn a policy which could map the observations to control commands, which, in our work, is the actuator command of the quadrotor. Besides, we conduct our method in the control task via simulation, the results of which show excellent performance.

articleTitle: Obstacle Detection and Path Planning Based On Monocular Vision for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
abstract: This article mainly introduces the algorithm design and simulation process of unmanned aerial vehicle obstacle detection and path planning based on monocular vision. In this article, we will first explain the basics of image processing, with focus on the design algorithms and the operations and principles that will be used in simulation experiments in the second half of the article. The subject is the obstacle detection and path planning of drones, so the article divides this topic into two sub-topics. Subtask 1 focuses on solving obstacle detection problems for drones. This paper will use the method of contour detection. Subtask 2 focuses on solving the problem of path planning after unmanned aerial vehicles detect obstacles. This paper uses A* path search algorithm. The simulation results show that the algorithm has a good degree of completion, and all the materials used can basically avoid obstacles accurately and plan the relatively safe and shortest optimal path.

articleTitle: Integral Sliding Mode Active Fault-Tolerant Control for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
abstract: In this paper, active fault tolerant control (AFTC) of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) with bounded disturbances and an actuator fault is studied. Firstly, the system state variable and an unknown actuator fault are obtained through adaptive fault estimation (FE), then, it is proved that the estimation error of the dynamic system is asymptotically stable. Secondly, an active fault-tolerant control (AFTC) scheme combining integral sliding mode (ISM) and fault estimation is proposed. Under this scheme, the influence of disturbance and unknown actuator fault can be eliminated simultaneously in a finite time. Finally, we can illustrate the effectiveness of AFTC scheme by an example.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis and design for NOx sensor pump units decoupling control
abstract: NOx sensors capable of accurately and quickly detecting oxygen concentration and achieving air-fuel ratio and nitrogen oxide concentration measurement play a key role in controlling exhaust emissions. Due to the coupling relationship between the chambers and the large thermal shock environment, the NOx sensor is difficult to achieve high-precision and rapid measurement under complex conditions. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a cascade fuzzy feedforward control algorithm for nitrogenoxygen sensors. On the one hand, the algorithm uses cascade control to complete the control of the main atmosphere influence unit. On the other hand, it is based on the fuzzy control of deviation, and does not need to establish an accurate mathematical model for the controlled object. The analysis shows that the design of the nitrogen-oxygen sensor control system proposed in this paper is feasible, and its response speed is fast and has good control effect.

articleTitle: The Classification Detection Technology of Car Quarter Glass Based on the Feature Parameter
abstract: Background: At present, the classification detection of car quarter glass is mainly depends on human's experiences for some factories. However, some kinds of car quarter glass are not only very similar in black-band contour but also very similar in terms of material (color). This manual method for identification is prone to make mistakes. Although people have done large amounts of research on the defect detection of car glass, there are few studies on the classification detection of the car quarter glass with black band. In this paper, we innovatively propose the use of machine vision technology and feature parameter (e.g., perimeter, area and HU moment) comparison to realize the contour detection of the quarter glass. Then, by using the light transmittance as characteristic parameter, the material detection of the quarter glass can be realized by combining this characteristic parameter with the using of rejecting abnormal values. A combined utilization of contour detection and material detection can effectively guarantee the reliability of quarter glass classification detection. By using different materials and specifications quarter glass to test in the experiments, the experimental results show that almost all of the correct detection can be obtained no matter what position and angle of the glass be placed. Even if an incorrect glass which is much similar to the standard glass can still detected to show as error. The quarter glass classification detection above prove that this method has a nearly 100% accuracy and the robustness of algorithm are significant.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Tolerant Control of Guidance System of High Speed Maglev Train
abstract: In this paper, the guidance system of high-speed maglev train is taken as the research object, and the mathematical model of the guidance unit is established based on the structure and working principle. The linear quadratic optimal guidance controller is designed by using differential control scheme. Aiming at the problem of high failure rate of accelerometer in guidance sensor, a fault-tolerant control scheme based on signal reconstruction is designed. The traditional tracking differentiator is improved, and the velocity signal is obtained by differentiating the gap signal, which constitutes the analytical redundancy of the velocity signal. The simulation results show that the fault-tolerant controller designed in this paper can stabilize the guidance system without overshoot and has good anti-interference ability. The fault diagnosis of accelerometer can be realized, and signal switching can be carried out in time after the fault occurs, so that the guidance system still has good performance after the fault occurs.

Author Keywords: guidance system of high speed maglev train

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Rainwater Detection Window Based on STM32 Single-Chip Microcomputer
abstract: Nowadays, most of windows are closed manually. As summer approaches, and the indoor temperature gradually increases, it brings uncomfortable life experience to people coming home from work; At ordinary times, we often forget to close the window when we go out. When it rains, the rain will enter the room and cause unnecessary damage to the interior lighting appliances, furnishings and other items.This device can prevent the rain from entering the room in rainy season in summer and damaging the family property. When the rain detection module outdoors detects rain, the signal will be converted from digital signal to the single-chip microcomputer to make the circuit conductive. The window is automatically turned off driven by the deceleration motor under the control of the relay. The indoor temperature sensor can detect that the single-chip microcomputer sends a signal to control the deceleration motor to close the window when the room temperature is too high. The device adopts a modular design, which is easy to install. The circuit part can be placed indoors, to prevent various losses caused by rain into the room.

articleTitle: Modeling and Quantitative Assessment of Fundamental Environment Complexity for Autonomous and Electric Vehicles
abstract: Current challenges for autonomous and electric vehicle (AEV) technology derives from the complex road traffic environments and the requirement of efficient methods for their modeling and quantitative assessment. A review of literature indicates that the development of AEV technologies, i.e., environmental perception, path planning and tracking control, modeling and quantitative assessment of environment complexity are exceedingly little. In this research, in view of information theory, a hierarchical model is designed to explicitly consider the fundamental environment complexity (FEC) and based on it, a novel quantitative assessment approach is proposed. In particular, the amount of information is calculated from the probability of each information source together with the identified weighting factors of category elements and the information coefficients of environment complexity. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed FEC model and quantitative assessment method is examined with a practical analysis over two sections of traffic road.

articleTitle: Research on fusion diagnosis method of thermal fault of Marine diesel engine
abstract: In order to avoid the situation that the diagnosis model based on single sensor data is easily disturbed by environmental noise and the diagnosis accuracy is low, an intelligent fault fusion diagnosis method for marine diesel engine is proposed. Firstly, the support vector machine which is optimized by genetic algorithm is used to learn the fault sample data from different sensors, then multiple fault diagnosis models and results can be got. After that, multiple groups of diagnosis results are taken as evidence bodies and fused by evidence theory to obtain more accurate diagnosis results. By analyzing the sample data obtained from the fault simulation experiment of marine diesel engine based on AVL BOOST software, the proposed method can improve the fault diagnosis accuracy of marine diesel engine and reduce the uncertainty value of diagnosis results.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Attention Networks for Image Classification of Remote Sensing Images Based on Visual Q&A Methods
abstract: This paper provides a mixed attention network for remote sensing image classification whose idea comes from VQA methods. In this way, it could deal with more complex requests beyond just identifying what is in the picture. The HAN (Hierarchial Attention Network) consists of an attention model to detect details on one hand and a self-attention model to detect global information on the other hand. Through attention heat maps we could see division of work is really effective and the HAN has a great performance on NWPU-RESISC45 data set. Furthermore, we may add some other subnetworks to reinforce this ability in the future.

articleTitle: Distributed Actuator Fault Estimation Approach for Multi-agent Systems Using Related Information
abstract: In this paper, the actuator fault estimation problem is investigated for a multi-agent systems. Fault estimation plays a vital role in the field of fault tolerant control or fault accommodation. Firstly, the multi-agent system model with unknown additive actuator faults based on leader-follower structure is given. To get the estimated value of unknown fault, an unknown input observer is designed in this study, by selecting the appropriate gain parameter matrices, the desired fault estimation aim could be achieved. And then the stability of fault estimation observer error systems is guaranteed according to Lyapunov approach. Finally, simulation example is used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Time-Varying Formation for Second Order Nonlinear Multi-agent System with Switching Topology and Time Delay
abstract: In this paper, time-varying formation problem for nonlinear second order multi-agent system in existence of switching directed topology and time delay is investigated. First, we design an reduced-order extended state observer (ESO) to estimate the nonlinear dynamics, then we construct a time-varying formation protocol. After that we prove that the ESO estimation error can be arbitrarily small. Sufficient conditions for the system to form the desired formation are obtained by using Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional approach and Linear Matrix Inequality (LMI) technique. Then we present an explicit expression of the time-varying formation reference function. Finally, we use numerical simulation to verify the validity of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Intelligent Vehicle Trajectory Tracking Algorithm Based on MPC Using Laguerre Functions
abstract: A trajectory tracking control algorithm is designed for the front wheel steering of the intelligent vehicle. The state space equation of vehicle trajectory tracking is established on the strength of the vehicle kinematics model. The model predictive control algorithm using Laguerre functions is used for realizing the optimal control of intelligent vehicle trajectory tracking. The orderd number of parameters in the algorithm is less than the ordered number of parameters in the conventional method(LQR), and a limited parameters number are focus on achieving a long control horizon. In order to check on the effect of the algorithm, it is simulated on MATLAB and compared with the traditional approach. The results show that the algorithm has superior performance and can be effectively and accurately applied to the trajectory tracking control of the intelligent vehicle.

articleTitle: Research on Operational State Monitoring of Maglev Train Based on Machine Learning
abstract: Maglev train is a modern rail vehicle with low energy consumption, low noise and high comfort. Due to the monitoring of the running state of the train during the operation and commissioning of the maglev train, there are some problems, such as large amount of data to be processed, long time spent, poor real-time performance, and low accuracy of monitoring. There are many stages of changes in the state of the train during normal operation, and abnormal operating conditions may occur. The data obtained by the sensors in different states have significant distinguishing characteristics, so the data collected by the maglev train suspension control system can be used to train the machine learning model, and then based on the data to determine the actual running state of the maglev train, can facilitate the debugging work of the train during operation. If the state of the train operation can achieve the effect of real-time monitoring, the suspension control system of the maglev train can adjust the control strategy according to the current running state, so that the control effect of the train can reach a better state.

articleTitle: Research on Reactive Power Optimization Control Strategy of Distribution Network with Photovoltaic Generation
abstract: What the thesis studies is the active and reactive decoupling control method of photovoltaic grid-connected inverter, and then the reactive power of grid-connected inverter is optimized by genetic algorithm with the objective of minimizing network loss, So as to realize reactive power optimization control of the photovoltaic power generation system. An algorithm based on genetic algorithm for reactive power optimization of photovoltaic power generation and distribution network is proposed. A mathematical model for reactive power optimization of distribution network has been established. The mathematical model includes those of photovoltaic power generation system Considering the limits of not only minimum network loss but also node voltage, what is used to optimize the reactive power of photovoltaic power generation is genetic algorithm. The example simulation results indicate the designed optimization algorithm is effective and correct in reducing power loss and improving voltage quality.

articleTitle: Operation Optimization of Combined Cooling, Heating, and Power Systems Based on Model Predictive Control
abstract: The combined cooling, heating, and power (CCHP) system is a type of distributed energy system. The realization of cascade utilization of energy can effectively improve the primary energy utilization rate. Many researches on the optimal operation of the CCHP systems have been considered in many literatures. However the prediction error of renewable energy and load has an impact on the operation of the system. This paper proposes an optimization operational strategy for renewable energy CCHP systems based on model predictive control. The optimization operational strategy consists of three parts: prediction of source and load, rolling optimization and feedback correction. ARIMA model and grey theory is used in prediction section. Rolling optimization aims to maximize primary energy saving rate, cost saving rate, and carbon dioxide emission reduction rate combining the full working condition characteristics of the generator unit to optimize the renewable energy CCHP systems. Feedback correction can reduce the volatility of the predicted data. The genetic algorithm is introduced to solve the optimal operation mode of CCHP systems. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the method are verified by simulations.

articleTitle: A distributed alternating direction method of multipliers algorithm for consensus optimization
abstract: The Alternating Directions Methods of Multipliers (ADMM) are widely used in many fields of scientific computing in recent years. This method applies iterative computation to the information exchange between individual agent and neighbor. However, despite the success of traditional centralized ADMM in some application environments, its applicability is limited in global convergence center by its communication requirements. In our paper, we provide the linear convergence rate for this distributed consensus optimization problem, which satisfies strongly convex local objective functions. Then, the properties of the local objective function and the parameters of the algorithm, the theoretical convergence rate is given according to the network topology.

articleTitle: Predictive control of stable standing of three-legged robot
abstract: The stability margin of multi-legged robots will be significantly reduced on changing ground, such as the ground of an earthquake or the deck of a surface ship. In this paper, a new type of three-legged robot prototype is taken as the research object. Aiming at the stable standing of the three-legged robot under different terrains, this paper proposes a predictive control method for online planning reference trajectories. Through the angle data obtained by the gyroscope, the ground condition of the robot is evaluated online, and the reference trajectory is generated in real time. In this paper, the predictive control method is used to control the virtual leg elongation length to track the reference trajectory so that the robot body is parallel to the horizontal plane. The simulation and prototype experiments prove that the three-legged robot can obtain high stability on the changing ground by this algorithm.

articleTitle: Kinematics Analysis of Walking Robot Based on Double Stewart Parallel Mechanism
abstract: Parallel mobile robots have recently attracted wide attention due to their strong load capacity, high running stability and rapid response speed. This paper conducts the kinematics research based on a pair of novel mobile legs that consist of a dual Stewart parallel mechanism. Firstly, we describe its motion mechanism and analyze the DOF of the mechanism in detail. Secondly, the forward and inverse kinematic solutions of the mechanism are computed and analyzed, and then the workspace is obtained by Matlab simulation. Thirdly, according to the principle of kinematics, we carry out dynamic performance optimization research to analyze and compare various motion control rules. Finally, the human-computer interface is designed for ease of analysis and displaying the kinematic rules of robot motion.

articleTitle: Input-observer Event-based Secure Consensus Control of A Linear Multi-agent System under Deception Attacks
abstract: An input-observer event-based secure consensus control strategy is designed for a linear multi-agent system (MAS) under deception attacks in this paper. A novel input-observer is proposed to estimate the sum of errors among agents, and then, based on the estimation signal from this input-observer, the consensus control strategy with the event-triggered mechanism is introduced for reduction of unnecessary communications. It is proven that the MAS achieves secure consensus control in mean square sense, and the Zeno behavior is ruled out. Finally, the simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed secure strategy.

articleTitle: Application of neural network based on Caffe framework for object detection in Hilens
abstract: The semantic analysis of computer vision is to let the machine automatically understand, analyze and generate reasonable semantic concepts for the content contained in visual signals such as images or videos. At present, many experts and scholars have carried out in-depth and extensive research on image recognition, and with the rise of neural networks, the use of deep learning should become the current research trend. In this paper, we use the industry-wide deep learning framework caffe training data set, and the results are deployed to Huawei's latest product, hilens, to obtain the final result through the startup file, and display the image and accuracy.

articleTitle: An efficient pedestrian detection network on mobile GPU with millisecond scale
abstract: With a certain number of architectural improvements in deep networks, the real-time object detection on mobile devices especially for human beings has gradually become the basis of many downstream visual applications, such as segmentation, tracking, or high-level object-based reasoning. Therefore, there is an urgent need for the object detection model to have higher performance than a standard real-time benchmark. In our study, we proposed a new light-weighted model with a self-designed feature extractor that is based on Resnet18, and using special anchor and loss scheme to eliminate small-sized persons, according to the practical need of subsequent applications to only detect large-sized persons. At the same time, we put forward a newly-designed weighted-NMS method to remove the highly redundant bounding boxes on the same person. The final result outperforms other tiny networks, for example modified ShuffleNet and PeleeNet with nearly the same speed of 5 ms, by achieving 43.3% mAP on person category of COCO-2017 dataset on MI8 GPU with at least 90% in detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Path Tracking with Nonlinear Model Predictive Control Based on Tire Adhesion Margin
abstract: This paper presents a nonlinear model predictive path tracking control method based on tire adhesion margin. The proposed method considers a vehicle's tire adhesion margin and introduces it into an objective function, which can effectively improve the safety of automobiles. Moreover, autonomous vehicles would have increased more maneuverability to enable them to deal with some emergencies when their tire adhesion margin is large. To confirm the feasibility and effectiveness of the controller, Simulation experiments are performed on MATLAB and CarSim/Simulink under diverse scenarios.

articleTitle: Intelligent logistics system architecture design based on edge computing
abstract: Nowadays, the era of Internet of Everything has quietly come, and the application of Internet of Things and the application of big data analysis in the architecture design of network systems is growing at an unprecedented rate. Applying edge computing in an IoT system is the processing of data done at or near the lowest sensor data source in the IoT system. In the modern logistics system, efficient and rapid data information analysis and the corresponding speed of the business have become an urgent need. We design a smart logistics system architecture based on edge computing, and applies the edge computing model to the intelligent logistics system. The edge computing is used to preprocess the data, distribute the tasks, and ensure the security of sensitive data to realize the business security and data security of the intelligent logistics system.

articleTitle: An In-Motion Initial Alignment Algorithm for SINS Using Lie Group Matrix Kalman Filter
abstract: In this paper, an in-motion initial alignment algorithm based on Lie group matrix kalman filter is proposed. According to the Lie group's properties and the attitude optimization-based initial alignment idea, the attitude matrix is decomposed into three continuous special orthogonal matrices to separate the rotation information and motion information under the in-motion conditions. A linear system model is established based on the differential equation of Lie group, which can replace the traditional quaternion model and avoid the non-uniqueness of unit quaternion representation. Then the Lie Group Matrix Kalman Filter is proposed for estimating the initial inertial matrix directly. And the Simplified Lie Group Matrix Kalman Filter with special process noise is proposed in some specific situations. From the simulation, the alignment accuracy and stability of the two algorithms satisfies the SINS navigation requirements. These two methods have good application prospects for the in-motion initial alignment of SINS.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Fault Detection Algorithm Based On Resampling
abstract: Fault detection plays an increasingly important role in the reliability of integrated navigation systems. Aiming at the problem of fewer fault samples and non-linearity of data in integrated navigation system, a fault detection algorithm based on resampling One-Class SVM (a kind of support vector machine) is proposed. Firstly, the data is preprocessed by the re-sampling algorithm-kernel fisher discriminant analysis (]CFDA) to achieve the balance of the model data. Then, the data is machine-learned. Finally, the failure of the non-linear data is detected by using the kernel technique. The simulation shows that the method can effectively detect the abrupt and soft faults of the small sample integrated navigation system and improve the detection rate of the integrated navigation system.

articleTitle: Error-based Feedforward Control for Photoelectric Tracking System
abstract: In this paper, an approach to enhance the tracking performance of charge-coupled device (CCD)-based photoelectric tracking system (PTS) is proposed. The CCD sensor is usually utilized to provide the line of sight (LOS) errors directly, by which the PTS is widely used for visual fine tracking control. Generally speaking, the higher the closed-loop bandwidth of the system, the better the closed-loop performance of the system. However, the tracking performance of PTS is greatly limited by a low CCD sampling rate, which causes insufficient error attenuation performance when tracking maneuvering targets or suffering platform disturbances. In order to extend the tracking error attenuation bandwidth, especially at middle frequency, an error-based feedforward control (EBFC) method is recommended. Combining the LOS error from CCD and the controller output, the relative position of target can be estimated, which is helpful for producing a high-gain controller to suppress LOS errors. The feedforward node is designed before the inner loop to construct a pure and novel forward route, which makes the feedforward controller acting as a lead-lag controller to ensure the stability of system, actually. Simultaneously, the control bandwidth and controller design analysis of this method is presented. A few comparative experimental results show that the improved control method can effectively enhance the error attenuation performance of the LOS for the CCD-based PTS.

articleTitle: Transformer Equipment Temperature Monitoring Based on the Network Framework of Django
abstract: In order to improve the visualization and efficiency of transformer temperature monitoring, a real-time transformer temperature detection system based on Django network framework is designed, in which the temperature acquisition module is composed of temperature sensor and zigbee network module and is controlled by Raspberry Pi microcomputer. The server and the monitoring system are partly based on the B / S architecture design, and the python language is used to collect, store, send and display the data. Users through the web browser to view the data displayed in the form of charts to facilitate data analysis and warning of transformer equipment.

articleTitle: The Study of The Combustion Control System of Biomass Boiler
abstract: This paper aims to solve problems in the combustion process of biomass boiler, such as incomplete combustion and lack concentration of firepower. In the process of production, manual feeding mechanism was changed to automatic feeding device. Fuzzy adaptive PID is used to adjust boiler pressure value in real time. This makes the furnace combustion more full and combustion efficiency improved by adjusting the motor. The study makes the boiler control system have the characteristics of automatic regulation and short adjustment time.

articleTitle: Research On System Structure and Strategy Design of Nuclear Island Fire Protection Automatic Control in Nuclear Power Plant
abstract: This paper is analyzed nuclear power plant fire protection design specification, standards and fire control requirement. By comparing different type of domestic nuclear power plant fire protection automatic control system structure and strategy, raise some questions whether the fire monitoring platform is independent or integrated in plant control system. Finally gives the optimized integrated platform strategy for fire protection automatic control, which meet the fire industry standards and control requirements.

articleTitle: A Stereo-Based Visual-Inertial Odometry for SLAM
abstract: It is becoming more and more popular to combine vision and inertial units in mobile robots, because these two kinds of sensors can complement each other and achieve good results in calculating incremental motion of sensors. SLAM algorithm based on pure vision, do not apply to the carrier fast movement, not a good deal with environmental degradation problem, so the current research focus is to do the camera and innovative marketing combination to SLAM, there are quite a good monocular visual inertial navigation system, but a lack of direct monocular vision inertial navigation of distance measurement, monocular vision is difficult to directly with inertial measurement data fusion structure, need very strict initialization process.Therefore, this paper proposes an improved binocular vision inertial navigation system for SLAM.

articleTitle: Hardware Development of Flue Gas Acquisition Monitoring and Control System for Incineration Equipment
abstract: This paper designs and develops a remote acquisition and monitoring system which is compatible with multichannel gas sensors with different signals and wiring types. The configuration structure of the system adopts dual STM32 chip system and 4G transmission module. The system realizes remote collection of the incineration equipment flue gas parameters. At the same time, it realizes the remote control of the acquisition and monitoring system to the field execution equipment. The validity and reliability of the acquisition and control system are verified by experiments. The acquisition and monitoring system provides a convenient and effective scheme for the information acquisition of flue gas parameters.

articleTitle: Design of an Intelligent Composite-switch for Reactive Power Compensation
abstract: This paper formulates the compound switch's working principle, compensation mode and implementation, it also expounds the design of hardware circuit structure. Aimed at the problems exist in the application of contactor and the power electronic device in the reactive power compensation equipment lonely, a kind of capacitance casting-chipping composite switch which is using the parallel connection of thyristor and magnetic latching relay as the main loop was designed to be applied in reactive power compensation equipment based on PIC When the equipment is switch-on, the electric current is taken on by the magnetic latching relay lonely, the advantages are that the power consumption of touch point is low and the capability of the anti-interference to harmonic is strong. The surging current at operating capacitor by thyristor passing zero is small and the reaction of compensate is quickly by the concerted action between the magnetic latching relay and thyristor, during the switching process. The PIC can monitor the multiplex signal circuit and control the magnetic latching relay and thyristor reliably. This equipment can successfully achieve in the trouble shooting, trouble removal and trouble indicator.

articleTitle: Sliding Mode Control of Upper Limb Rehabilitation Robot Based on Fuzzy Compensation
abstract: In order to solve the problem of model nonlinearity and strong external disturbance of rehabilitation robot. This paper presents a sliding mode control algorithm for upper limb rehabilitation robot based on fuzzy compensation. First of all, the upper limb rehabilitation robot dynamics equation modeling is introduced, then, analyses the upper limb rehabilitation robot based on fuzzy compensation the derivation process of the sliding mode control algorithm, and according to the Lyapunov stability criterion, system stability is proved. Finally, the case simulation is carried out on the basis of the existing upper limb rehabilitation robot model, and the simulation results are compared with those of ordinary PD controller. Simulation results show that the control algorithm has better robustness and tracking accuracy when the parameters of the joint robot are uncertain and there are forces and external disturbances imposed by the motion of the patient. The proposed method can meet the training needs of paralyzed patients.

articleTitle: Application of Proportional-Integral Control plus Generalized Predictive Control algorithm in the Control of Cement Particle Size
abstract: Cement grinding is a non-linear, large lag and strong coupling production process, the traditional PID control effect is general. Therefore, in this paper, Forgetting Factor Recursive Least Squares (FFRLS) algorithm is used to model speed of separator and the size of cement particle. Then according to the model, the controller is designed by Proportional-Integral Control plus Generalized Predictive Control algorithm, which is used to control the size of cement particle. The simulation results show that the control algorithm has faster tracking performance and better anti-jamming performance than PID control and GPC control.

articleTitle: Analysis of containment control for multi-agent systems based on broadcast gossip algorithm
abstract: This paper investigates the containment control problem for multi-agent systems based on the broadcast gossip algorithm, in which only one agent wakes up in the light of the asynchronous time model at each time and sends its information, and one part of the remaining agents get the message to update their states while the other part keep the states unchanged. We equivalently transform the algorithm into a mathematical model with the matrix-vector form, then conduct a detailed theoretical analysis for the mathematical model by utilizing tools including graph theory and stochastic matrix. Then, we establish a necessary and sufficient algebraic graph condition to ensure that every follower gradually enters the convex hull spanned by the leaders. Finally, we give a numerical example to argument the validity of theoretical result.

articleTitle: A caching strategy for industrial edge networks
abstract: For a successful industrial edge network implementation, data services must provide real-time capabilities to the end users of industrial automation applications. Caching strategies might be beneficial to improve the overall latency, yet they are not common in industrial networks. In this paper, industrial traffic is defined using a SNM model, taking into consideration that content popularity dynamically changes as control tasks are update via the industrial applications. We then propose a new cache replacement algorithm with a dynamic aging threshold. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Sub-Optimal Output Tracking Control for Singularly Perturbed Systems
abstract: In this paper, the problem of sub-optimal output tracking control of singularly perturbed systems is considered. The necessary and sufficient condition for the existence of sub-optimal output tracking controller is given in terms of matrix inequalities, such that the tracking system achieves the asymptotic tracking and the minimum value of quadratic performance index can be obtained. Furthermore, the controller design method is presented in the form of LMI for the case that the controller has an approximate solution of the generalized Riccati equation. Finally, one numerical example is given to illustrate the correctness and feasibility of the proposed results.

articleTitle: Body Part Level Attention Model For Skeleton-Based Action Recognition
abstract: Skeleton-based action recognition has catched more eyes recently. Many approaches model the human skeleton sequences spatio-temporal representation by Recurrent Neural Networks, while RNNs-based approaches don't explicitly have the attention scheme. In this paper, a body part level attention method is proposed for determining which parts are discriminative. On the basis of human joints natural connection, human body is divided to disjoint parts which then are fed into corresponding modules to generate action scores. A body part level attention module which distributes different importance to different action scores is proposed to adaptively learn informative body parts. The final representative of the action video is produced in a weighted average way and it will be fed into DNNs for classification. Out method outperforms other attention model and we obtain the state-of-the-art performance compared to other methods on two popularly used benchmark NTU dataset and UT Kinect dataset.

articleTitle: Speech Emotion Recognition based on Multiple Feature Fusion
abstract: In speech emotion recognition,the extraction of Mel-frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) will lose many useful spectral feature information,resulting in low recognition accuracy. Therefore,a method for combining MFCC and Mel spectrum for speech emotion recognition is proposed. First,M FCC are extracted from the audio signal,and then the Mel spectrum is extracted from the audio signal. Finally,the fused audio features are used to support vector machine classification. The experimental results in the EMODB data set show that the fusion of multiple features has higher classification accuracy than the classifier using single feature,and the proposed method can effectively improve the recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of Dynamic Data Acquisition System of Virtual Reality Webpage
abstract: To improve the rate of dynamic data automated acquisition of virtual reality webpage, we design a dynamic data automated acquisition system of virtual reality webpage. We connect the LPC2292 controller pin and webpage extender, extract the webpage data initially, construct the RS485 data bus structure, perform the data transmission, design the system data intelligent conditioner, convert the webpage text data into signal data in the bus, and design the Modbus protocol as the communication protocol of the above two kinds of data. And at last, the network delay algorithm is used to eliminate the data acquisition delay and realize automatic data acquisition. The experimental data shows that after the acquisition system is applied, the acquisition time is reduced by 14% per data volume and the data acquisition volume is increased by 19% data per unit time. It can be proved that the system can improve data acquisition speed.

articleTitle: Hybrid Solar Power System Optimization based on Multi-Objective PSO Algorithm
abstract: Nowadays, with the rapid development of related technologies, the solar power become an important component of the whole energy system. At present, there are two main forms of solar power generation: photovoltaics (PV) and concentrated solar power (CSP). Among them, PV is much cheaper, but more susceptible to resource conditions, while CSP is more controllable based on the thermal storage section, but still expensive. To integrate the advantages of these two kinds of technologies, the hybrid solar power system is proposed by many researchers. Some single objective optimization algorithms are used in the process of design such systems. However, it is still a dilemma to deal with the cost and stability in the hybrid system. In this paper, we try to propose an Multi-Objective Particle Swarm Optimization (MO_PSO) algorithm to solve this problem, which can consider the performance and cost of the project at the same time. The experimental result based on the real data shown that this algorithm can provide a feasible solution of the hybrid power system with stable output and acceptable cost. Furthermore, this method based on artificial intelligence can be used in other hybrid systems optimization in the smart grid.

articleTitle: Support Vector Machines based Rotor Fault Diagnosis with Improved Particle Swarm optimization
abstract: Artificial intelligence methods such as support vector machines (SVM) are widely used in fault diagnosis of mechanical rotors. SVM is a general machine-learning tool based on structural risk minimisation principle that performs good generalisation. Many studies have shown that the performance of SVM classifiers in fault diagnosis can be improved by optimizing parameters. For easy implemention, intelligent optimization methods are often used to optimize complex engineering problems. In this work, two improved particle swarm optimization algorithms are used to optimize parameters of SVM classifiers to improve identification rate of mechanical rotor faults. The basic particle swarm optimization (PSO) is also discussed for comparisons. Simulation shows the performance of SVM classifiers can be improved in rotor fault diagnosis by using the two improved PSO.

articleTitle: A Study on Cosine Efficiency in a Tower Reflector Solar Power System
abstract: Different from the conventional solar tower power system, the receiver in a tower reflector system is located on the ground and a mirror is introduced to reflect the ray from the heliostat field downwards to the receiver. The mathematical model of cosine efficiency in process of two reflections is established. The simulation and calculation of cosine efficiency in a tower reflector system with a circle heliostat field at different time of the vernal equinox is presented in the form of three-dimensional grid. Moreover, the effect of the height of the reflective tower on the cosine efficiency and the differences of cosine efficiencies between the conventional tower power system and the tower reflector system are studied, providing theory basis for the generalization and application of the tower reflector system.

articleTitle: Decoupling Control of Multi-dimensional Piezodriven Stages Based on Sandwich Model
abstract: For compensating the interactive effects and perform the target tracking control in the multi-dimensional piezo-driven stage, a hybrid decoupling control strategy based on the special sandwich model is presented in this paper. In the proposed decoupling control scheme, the coupling effects of each axis in multi-dimensional piezo-driven stages are firstly eliminated by the nonlinear coupling model. Then, the proposed control schemes based on the obtained sandwich model are developed to enable the displacement of each piezo-driven substage to track the modified reference signal. Besides, the robust controller is design to perform the tracking and decoupling control in the piezo-driven. Finally, the control experimental results on the X-Y piezo-driven stages are also presented to verify the proposed hybrid decoupling control scheme.

articleTitle: Vehicle Automatic Iterative Learning Control based on Drivers’ Starting Behavior
abstract: Early studies on intelligent control methods for automatic starting control for vehicles mainly focus on traditional parametric adjustment. However, attempts toward the combination of learning algorithms and models are rare. When drivers' starting behavior is not considered and tedious parameters are merely used for drive control, the effects result in discomfort for drivers. Therefore, to imitate drivers' starting behavior when dealing with automatic drive control in vehicles, we must first develop an acceleration fitting based on DFT by analyzing the starting characteristics. Then, we design an iterative learning algorithm to achieve automatic starting control of vehicles. Finally, a simulation test is conducted based on CARSIM to verify the validity and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Improved variable step size perturbation observation MPPT algorithm based on linear auto disturbance rejection
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low tracking accuracy and slow speed in the maximum power point tracking of photovoltaic power generation system, an improved variable step size MPPT control strategy based on linear auto-disturbance voltage closed-loop control is proposed. Taking the maximum power point tracking of the photovoltaic power generation system as the research object, the variable power step observation method is used as the power outer loop to track the maximum power point, linear auto-disturbance is used as a voltage inner loop to implement voltage feedback control. The MATLAB modeling and simulation analysis of the maximum power point tracking of the photovoltaic power generation system is carried out, and compared with the variable step size perturbation method. The research results show that the method has good adaptability, and it can improve the tracking speed and steady-state accuracy of the system in both the standard condition and the environmental abrupt situation, and greatly improve the solar energy utilization rate.

articleTitle: Spatial Registration Model of TOF Camera Depth Data based on BP Algorithm
abstract: For the errors in the original depth data obtained by TOF depth camera, which lead to image distortion, the method of establishing BP neural network space registration model was proposed to calibrate the depth data deviation caused by non-systematic random error in the process of TOF camera depth data measurement and systematic error of TOF camera measurement principle. The results are compared and analyzed with the calibration results based on the principle of keyhole imaging, BP algorithm is adopted to establish the space registration of BP neural network model, and its precision is higher than the calibration results based on the principle of keyhole imaging, stronger generalization ability, better able to recover the real scene depth data. It provides a new idea and method for the calibration of depth data measured by TOF camera.

articleTitle: Robust Sliding Mode Controller with Suppressor for DC Motor System with Disturbances
abstract: In this paper, the tracking control problem of DC motor vertical lift system under pendulum disturbance is studied. A robust sliding mode tracking control scheme based on improved reaching law approach is designed. Firstly, DC motor lifting system mathematical model is derived. Secondly, a novel sliding function is designed. Thirdly, in order to compensate for disturbances, a sliding mode controller with suppressor (SMCS) is proposed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control method is verified by the simulations results.

articleTitle: CQDW: A Cyclic-Queue-based Dynamic Watermarking Mechanism for WSNs
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) are data-centric and self-organized, so data security is a major concern in WSNs which relies heavily on key-based cryptography. However, data integrity and authenticity cannot be guaranteed. In this paper, we propose a lightweight watermarking security mechanism, cyclic-queue-based dynamic watermarking mechanism(CQDW) to ensure data transmission integrity in WSNs. The proposed watermarking mechanism analyzes the original collective data and dynamically generates watermarks based on the cyclic queues. Then the order and location of watermark embedding are determined by the wake-up time of the sensor nodes and the secret data queue. Therefore, the watermarking mechanism provides greater security performance at a lower resource cost to protect data integrity and authenticity. Compared with the previous watermarking mechanisms, the simulation results show that it has obvious superiority in detection accuracy and operation efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Method of Wire and Cable Extrusion Control System
abstract: For the characteristics of nonlinearity, time lag and coupling of wire and cable extrusion control system, the current modeling method is difficult to achieve good results.
